translation: THE Gods drew waters with their store of sweetness, succulent and observant, king-creating, Wherewith they sprinkled Varuna and Mitra, wherewith they guided Indra past his foemen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृष्णऽऊर्मिरसि राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे देहि स्वाहा वृष्णऽऊर्मिरसि राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै देहि वृषसेनोऽसि राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे देहि स्वाहा वृषसेनोऽसि राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै देहि ॥२॥
translation: Wave of the male art thou, giver of kingship. Do thou— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. Wave of the male art thou, giver of kingship. Do thou on So-and-So bestow the kingdom. Thou hast a host of males, giver of kingship. Do thou— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. A host of males hast thou, giver of kingship. Do thou on So-and-So bestow the kingdom.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्थेत स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहार्थेत स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्तौजस्वती स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहौजस्वती स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्तापः परिवाहिणी स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहापः परिवाहिणी स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्तापां पतिरसि राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे देहि स्वाहाऽपां पतिरसि राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै देह्यपां गर्भोऽसि राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे देहि स्वाहाऽपां गर्भोऽसि राष्ट्र्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै देहि ॥३॥
translation: Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye on So-and-So bestow the kingdom. Endowed with strength are ye, givers of kingship, etc. O’erflowing floods are ye, etc. The Waters’ Lord art thou, giver of kingship. Do thou, etc. The Waters’ Child art thou, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सूर्यत्वचस स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा सूर्यत्वचस स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त सूर्यवर्चस स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा सूर्यवर्चस स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त मान्दा स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा मान्दा स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त व्रजक्षित स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा व्रजक्षित स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त वाशा स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा वाशा स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त शविष्ठा स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा शविष्ठा स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त शक्वरी स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा शक्वरी स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त जनभृत स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा जनभृत स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त विश्वभृत स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रं मे दत्त स्वाहा विश्वभृत स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्तापः स्वराज स्थ राष्ट्रदा राष्ट्रममुष्मै दत्त। मधुमतीर्मधुमतीभिः पृच्यन्तां महि क्षत्रं क्षत्रियाय वन्वानाऽअनाधृष्टाः सीदत सहौजसो महि क्षत्रं क्षत्रियाय दधतीः ॥४॥
translation: With sun-bright skins are ye, givers, etc. Brilliant as Suns are ye, etc. Bringers of joy are ye, etc. Dwellers in cloud are ye, etc Desirable are ye, etc. Most powerful are ye, etc. Endowed with might are ye, etc. Man-nourishing are ye, etc. All-nourishing are ye, etc. Self-ruling Waters are ye, giving kingship. On So-and-So do ye bestow the kingdom. Together with the sweet let sweet ones mingle, obtaining for the Kshatriya mighty power. Rest in your place inviolate and potent, bestowing on the Kshatriya mighty power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमस्य त्विषिरसि तवेव मे त्विषिभूर्यात्। अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहा सवित्रे स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा पूष्णे स्वाहा बृहस्पतये स्वाहेन्द्राय स्वाहा घोषाय स्वाहा श्लोकाय स्वाहाशाय स्वाहा भगाय स्वाहार्यम्णे स्वाहा ॥५॥
translation: Brilliance of Soma art thou: may my brilliance grow like thine. To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! To Savitar Hail! To Sarasvatî Hail! To Pûshan Hail! To Brihaspati Hail! To Indra Hail! To the Noise Hail! To Fame Hail To Amsa Hail! To Bhaga Hail! To Aryaman Hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवित्रे स्थो वैष्णव्यौ सविर्तुवः प्रसवऽउत्पुनाम्यच्छिद्रेण पवित्रेण सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः। अनिभृष्टमसि वाचो बन्धुस्तपोजाः सोमस्य दात्रमसि स्वाहा राजस्वः ॥६॥
translation: Ye are two strainers, Varuna’s own possession. I make you pure at Savitar’s impulsion, with flawless strainer, with the beams of Sûrya. Thou, friend of speech, heat-born, art undefeated. Soma’s share art thou. Hail, ye king producers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सधमादो द्युम्निनीरापऽएताऽअनाधृष्टाऽअपस्यो वसानाः। पस्त्यासु चक्रे वरुणः सधस्थमपा शिशुर्मातृतमास्वन्तः ॥७॥
translation: Sharers in joy are these majestic Waters, inviolate, industrious, investing. In these as homes hath Varuna made his dwelling, he, Child of Waters, in the best of mothers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्षत्रस्योल्बमसि क्षत्रस्य जराय्वसि क्षत्रस्य योनिरसि क्षत्रस्य नाभिरसीन्द्रस्य वार्त्रघ्नमसि मित्रस्यासि वरुणस्यासि त्वयायं वृत्रं वधेत्। दृवासि रुजासि क्षुमासि। पातैनं प्राञ्चं पातैनं प्रत्यञ्चं पातैनं तिर्यञ्चं दिग्भ्यः पात ॥८॥
translation: Thou art the inner caul of princely power, Thou art the outer caul of princely power. Of princely power thou art the womb, the navel. Thou art the Vritra-slaying arm of Indra. Mitra’s art thou, thou Varuna’s possession. With thee to aid may this man slaughter Vritra. Cleaver art thou; thou Render; thou art Shaker. Protect him ye in front, protect him rearwards; protect him sidewards; from all quarters guard him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आविर्मर्याऽआवित्तोऽअग्निर्गृहपतिरावित्तऽइन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाऽआवित्तौ मित्रावरुणौ धृतव्रतावावित्तः पूषा विश्ववेदाऽआवित्ते द्यावापृथिवी विश्वशम्भुवावावित्तादितिरुरुशर्मा ॥९॥
translation: Visible, O ye men, Informed is Agni, Master of the House. hold. Informed is Indra of exalted glory. Informed are Mitra-Varuna, Law-Maintainers. Informed is Pûshan, Lord of all Possessions. Informed are Heaven and Earth, the All-propitious. Informed is Aditi who gives wide shelter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवेष्टा दन्दशूकाः प्राचीमारोह गायत्री त्वावतु रथन्तरꣳ साम त्रिवृत् स्तोमो वसन्तऽऋतुर्ब्रह्म द्रविणम् ॥१०॥
translation: Appeased by sacrifice are biting creatures, Ascend the East. May Gâyatrî protect thee, the psalm Rathantara, the triple praise-song, the season Spring, and the rich treasure, Priesthood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दक्षिणामारोह त्रिष्टुप् त्वावतु बृहत्साम पञ्चदश स्तोमो ग्रीष्मऽऋतुः क्षत्रं द्रविणम् ॥११॥
translation: Ascend the South. Be thy protectors Trishtup, the Brihat Sâman, the fifteenfold praise- song, the Reason Summer, and the treasure Kingship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रतीचीमारोह जगती त्वावतु वैरूपꣳ साम सप्तदश स्तोमो वर्षाऽऋतुर्विड् द्रविणम् ॥१२॥
translation: Ascend the West. May Jagatî protect thee, the psalm Vairûpa, the seventeenfold praise- song, the Rain-time, and that store of wealth, the People. 35
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदीचीमारोहानुष्टुप् त्वावतु वैराजꣳ सामैकविꣳश स्तोमः शरदृतुः फलं द्रविणम् ॥१३॥
translation: Ascend the North. Thy guardians be Anushtup, Vairâja psalm, the twenty-onefold praise- song, the season Autumn, that rich treasure Fruitage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वामारोह पङ्क्तिस्त्वावतु शाक्वररैवते सामनी त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रिꣳशौ स्तोमौ हेमन्तशिशिरावृतू वर्चो द्रविणं प्रत्यस्तं नमुचेः शिरः ॥१४॥
translation: Ascend the Zenith. Pankti be thy keeper, Sâkvara, Raivata the pair of Sâmans, Praise- songs the thirty-threefold and thrice-ninefold, both seasons, Winter, Dews, that treasure lustre. The head of Namuchi hath been cast from me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमस्य त्विषिरसि तवेव मे त्विषिर्भूयात्। मृत्योः पाह्योजोऽसि सहोऽस्यमृतमसि ॥१५॥
translation: Brilliance of Soma art thou, may my brilliance grow like thine. Save me from death. Vigour art thou, victory, everlasting life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्यरूपाऽउषसो विरोकऽउभाविन्द्राऽउदिथः सूर्यश्च। आरोहतं वरुण मित्र गर्त्तं ततश्चक्षाथामदितिं दितिं च। मित्रोऽसि वरुणोऽसि ॥१६॥
translation: With golden bodies, at the flush of morning, ye rise on high, two Sovran Lords, and Sûrya. Ascend your car, O Varuna and Mitra: thence view infinity and limitation. Thou art Mitra, thou art Varuna.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमस्य त्वा द्युम्नेनाभिषिञ्चाम्यग्नेर्भ्राजसा सूर्यस्य वर्चसेन्द्रस्येन्द्रियेण। क्षत्राणां क्षत्रपतिरेध्यति दिद्यून् पाहि ॥१७॥
translation: Thee with the strength of Soma, Agni’s lustre, with Sûrya’s splendour, Indra’s might I sprinkle. Be Lord of princes: safe past arrows guard him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं देवाऽअसपत्नꣳ सुवध्वं महते क्षत्राय महते ज्यैष्ठ्याय महते जानराज्यायेन्द्रस्येन्द्रियाय। इमममुष्य पुत्रममुष्यै पुत्रमस्यै विशऽएष वोऽमी राजा सोमोऽस्माकं ब्राह्मणाना राजा ॥१८॥
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र पर्वतस्य वृषभस्य पृष्ठान्नावश्चरन्ति स्वसिचऽइयानाः। ताऽआववृत्रन्नधरागुदक्ताऽअहिं बुध्न्यमनु रीयमाणाः। विष्णोर्विक्रमणमसि विष्णोर्विक्रान्तमसि विष्णोः क्रान्तमसि ॥१९॥
translation: Forth from the summit of the bull, the mountain, pouring spontaneously, the ships keep moving. They, lifted up, have turned them back and downward, still flowing onward, after Ahibudhnya. Thou art the stepping-forth of Vishnu: thou art Vishnu’s outstep; Vishnu’s step art thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा रूपाणि परि ता बभूव। यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नोऽअस्त्वयममुष्य पिताऽसावस्य पिता वयꣳ स्याम पतयो रयीणा स्वाहा। रुद्र यत्ते क्रिवि परं नाम तस्मिन् हुतमस्यमेष्टमसि स्वाहा ॥२०॥
translation: Prajâpati, thou only comprehendest all these created forms, and none beside thee. Give us our heart’s desire when we invoke thee. So-and-So’s father is this man. Sire of this man is So-and-So. May we—All-hail!—be lords of rich possessions. What active highest name thou hast, O Rudra, therein thou art an offering, art an offering at home. All-hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वज्रोऽसि मित्रावरुणयोस्त्वा प्रशास्त्रोः प्रशिषा युनज्मि। अव्यथायै त्वा स्वधायै त्वाऽरिष्टो अर्जुनो मरुतां प्रसवेन जयापाम मनसा समिन्द्रियेण ॥२१॥
translation: Indra’s bolt art thou. I by the direction of Mitra-Varuna, Directors, yoke thee. I, the uninjured Arjuna, mount thee for firmness, thee for food. By quickening of the Maruts be thou victor. May we obtain by mind: with power united.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा तऽइन्द्र ते वयं तुराषाडयुक्तासोऽअब्रह्मता विदसाम। तिष्ठा रथमधि यं वज्रहस्ता रश्मीन् देव यमसे स्वश्वान् ॥२२॥
translation: Let us not, Indra, conqueror of the mighty, unfit through lack of prayer fail to obtain thee. Ascend the car which thou whose hand bears thunder controllest, and the reins with noble horses.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्नये गृहपतये स्वाहा सोमाय वनस्पतये स्वाहा मरुतामोजसे स्वाहेन्द्रस्येन्द्रियाय स्वाहा। पृथिवि मातर्मा मा हिꣳसीर्मोऽअहं त्वाम् ॥२३॥
translation: All hail to Agni, Master of the Household! All-hail to Soma, Sovran of the Forest! All-hail to the great vigour of the Maruts! All-hail to the effectual might of Indra! Injure me not, O Mother Earth, and may I never injure thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हꣳसः शुचिषद् वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषदतिथिर्दुरोणसत्। नृषद्वरसदृतसद् व्योमसदब्जा गोजाऽऋतजाऽअद्रिजाऽऋतं बृहत् ॥२४॥
translation: The Hamsa throned in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest beside the altar, Guest within the house, Dwelling in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, be is mighty Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इयदस्यायुरस्यायुर्मयि धेहि युङ्ङसि वर्चोऽसि वर्चो मयि धेह्यूर्गस्यूर्जं मयि धेहि। इन्द्रस्य वां वीर्यकृतो बाहूऽअभ्युपावहरामि ॥२५॥
translation: So great art thou: life art thou; give me life, Mate art thou: thou art splendour; give me splendour. Strength art thou: give me strength. I draw you downward, two arms of Indra mighty in achievement.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्योनासि सुषदासि क्षत्रस्य योनिरसि। स्योनामासीद सुषदामासीद क्षत्रस्य योनिमासीद ॥२६॥
translation: Fair art thou, good to sit on, womb of kingship. Sit on the fair one, sit on that which offers a pleasant seat: sit in the womb of kingship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: निषसाद धृतव्रतो वरुणः पस्त्यास्वा। साम्राज्याय सुक्रतुः ॥२७॥
translation: Varuna, Law’s maintainer, hath sat down among his people, he Most wise, for universal sway.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभिभूरस्येतास्ते पञ्च दिशः कल्पन्तां ब्रह्मँस्त्वं ब्रह्मासि सवितासि सत्यप्रसवो वरुणोऽसि सत्यौजाऽइन्द्रोऽसि विशौजा रुद्रोऽसि सुशेवः। बहुकार श्रेयस्कर भूयस्करेन्द्रस्य वज्रोऽसि तेन मे रध्य ॥२८॥
translation: Supreme Lord art thou. May these five regions of thine be prosperous. Brahman! Thou art Brahman, Savitar art thou, faithful in impulsion, Varuna art thou, he whose power is real. Indra art thou, whose strength is of the people. Rudra art thou, the very kind and gracious. Doer of much, Improver, Wealth-increaser! Indra’s holt art thou. Be therewith my vassal. 36
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निः पृथुर्धर्मणस्पतिर्जुषाणोऽअग्निः पृथुर्धर्मणस्पतिराज्यस्य वेतु स्वाहा। स्वाहाकृताः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्यतध्वꣳ सजातानां मध्यमेष्ठ्याय ॥२९॥
translation: May spacious Agni, Lord of Duty, gladly, vast Agni, Duty’s Lord, accept the butter. All- hail! Hallowed by Svâhâ, with the beams of Sûrya, strive for his central place among the kinsmen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सवित्रा प्रसवित्रा सरस्वत्या वाचा त्वष्ट्रा रूपैः पूष्णा पशुभिरिन्द्रेणास्मे बृहस्पतिना ब्रह्मणा वरुणेनौजसाऽग्निना तेजसा सोमेन राज्ञा विष्णुना दशम्या देवतया प्रसूतः प्रसर्पामि ॥३०॥
translation: I creep forth urged onward by Savitar the Impeller; by Sarasvatî, Speech; by Tvashtar, created forms; by Pûshan, cattle; by this Indra; by Brihaspati, Devotion; by Varuna, Power; by Agni, Brilliance; by Soma, the King; by Vishnu the tenth Deity.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विभ्यां पच्यस्व सरस्वत्यै पच्यस्वेन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे पच्यस्व। वायुःपूतः पवित्रेण प्रत्यङ्क्सोमो अतिस्रुतः। इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ॥३१॥
translation: Get dressed for the Asvins. Get dressed for Sarasvatî: Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer: Soma the Wind, purified by the strainer, Indra’s meet friend, hath gone o’erflowing backward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद्यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय। इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नमउक्तिं यजन्ति। उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यश्विभ्यां त्वा सरस्वत्यै त्वेन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्णे ॥३२॥
translation: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn, removing it in order, So bring the food of these men, bring it hither, who pay the Sacred Grass their spoken homage. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. Thee for Sarasvatî, and thee for Indra, for the Excellent Protector.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवꣳ सुराममश्विना नमुचावासुरे सचा। विपिपाना शुभस्पतीऽइन्द्रं कर्मस्वावतम् ॥३३॥
translation: Ye Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Soma juice, And aided Indra in his deeds with Namuchi of Asura birth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुत्रमिव पितरावश्विनोभेन्द्रावथुः काव्यैर्दꣳसनाभिः। यत्सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक् ॥३४॥
translation: As parents aid a son, both Asvins aided thee, Indra, with their wondrous powers and wisdom. When thou with might hadst drunk the draught that gladdens, Sarasvatî, O Bounteous Lord, refreshed thee. 37
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जानः प्रथमं मनस्तत्त्वाय सविता धियः। अग्नेर्ज्योतिर्निचाय्य पृथिव्याऽअध्याभरत् ॥१ ॥
translation: HARNESSING, first of all, the mind, Savitar having stretched the thought With reverent look upon the light of Agni bore them up from earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युक्तेन मनसा वयं देवस्य सवितुः सवे। स्वर्ग्याय शक्त्या ॥२ ॥
translation: By impulse of God Savitar we with our spirit harnessed strive With might to win the heavenly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युक्त्वाय सविता देवान्त्स्वर्यतो धिया दिवम्। बृहज्ज्योतिः करिष्यतः सविता प्रसुवाति तान् ॥३ ॥
translation: Savitar, having harnessed Gods who go to light and heavenly thought, Who will create the lofty light—Savitar urge them on their way!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जते मनऽउत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः। वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेकऽइन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः ॥४ ॥
translation: The priests of him the lofty priest well skilled in hymns, harness their spirit, yea, harness their holy thoughts. He only, skilled in rules, assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर्वि श्लोकऽएतु पथ्येव सूरेः। शृण्वन्तु विश्वेऽअमृतस्य पुत्राऽआ ये धामानि दिव्यानि तस्थुः ॥५ ॥
translation: I yoke with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince’s pathway. All Sons of the Immortal One shall hear it, who have resorted to celestial dwellings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य प्रयाणमन्वन्यऽइद्ययुर्देवा देवस्य महिमानमोजसा। यः पार्थिवानि विममे सऽएतशो रजासि देवः सविता महित्वना ॥६ ॥
translation: Even he, the God whose going forth and majesty the other Deities have followed with their might, He who hath measured the celestial regions out by his great power, he is the Courser Savitar.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देव सवितः प्रसुव यज्ञं प्रसुव यज्ञपतिं भगाय। दिव्यो गन्धर्वः केतपूः केतन्नः पुनातु वाचस्पतिर्वाचं नः स्वदतु ॥७ ॥
translation: Our sacrifice, God Savitar! speed forward: speed to his share the sacrifice’s patron. May the celestial Gandharva, Cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes. The Lord of Speech sweeten the words we utter!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं नो देव सवितर्यज्ञं प्रणय देवाव्यꣳ सखिविदꣳ सत्राजितं धनजितꣳ स्वर्जितम्। ऋचा स्तोमꣳ समर्धय गायत्रेण रथन्तरं बृहद् गायत्रवर्त्तनि स्वाहा ॥८ ॥
translation: God Savitar, speed this God-loved sacrifice of ours, friend-finding, ever-conquering, winning wealth and heaven. Speed praise-song with the sacred verse, Rathantara with Gâyatra, Brihat that runs in Gâyatra. All-hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आददे गायत्रेण छन्दसाङ्गिरस्वत् पृथिव्याः सधस्थादग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वदाभर त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसाङ्गिरस्वत् ॥९ ॥
translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, in Angiras’ manner, with Gâyatrî metre. From the earth’s seat bring thou Purîshya Agni, as Angiras was wont, with Trishtup metre.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्रिरसि नार्यसि त्वया वयमग्निꣳ शकेम खनितुꣳ सधस्थ आ। जागतेन छन्दसाङ्गिरस्वत् ॥१० ॥
translation: Spade art thou; woman art thou. Ours be power with thee to dig out Agni in his dwelling, as Angiras was wont, with Jagatî metre.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हस्तऽआधाय सविता बिभ्रदभ्रिꣳ हिरण्ययीम्। अग्नेर्ज्योतिर्निचाय्य पृथिव्याऽअध्याभरदानुष्टुभेन छन्दसाङ्गिरस्वत् ॥११ ॥
translation: Savitar, bearing in his hand the gold spade which he took therewith, Looking with reverence on the light of Agni, raised it from the earth, With the Anushtup metre and as Angiras was wont to do.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रतूर्त्तं वाजिन्नाद्रव वरिष्ठामनु संवतम्। दिवि ते जन्म परममन्तरिक्षे तव नाभिः पृथिव्यामधि योनिरित् ॥१२ ॥
translation: Run hither, urged to speed, O Horse, along the most extended space. Thy loftiest birthplace is in heaven. thy navel is in air’s mid-realm, the womb that bare thee is on earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जाथा रासभं युवमस्मिन् यामे वृषण्वसू। अग्निं भरन्तमस्मयुम् ॥१३ ॥
translation: Upon this course, O lords of wealth, harness; ye twain, the Ass who bears Agni, and kindly favours us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे। सखायऽइन्द्रमूतये ॥१४ ॥
translation: In every need, in every race we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रतूर्वन्नेह्यवक्रामन्नशस्ती रुद्रस्य गाणपत्यं मयोभूरेहि। उर्वन्तरिक्षं वीहि स्वस्तिगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन् पूष्णा सयुजा सह ॥१५ ॥
translation: Come speeding on and trampling imprecations; come gladdening to the chieftainship of Rudra. Speed through the wide air thou whose paths are pleasant, with Pûshan for thy mate, providing safety.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पृथिव्याः सधस्थादग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वदाभराग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वदच्छेमोऽग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वद्भरिष्यामः ॥१६ ॥
translation: From the Earth’s seat, like Anginas, bring thou Purîshya Agni forth. After the wont of Angiras we to Purîshya Agni go. Agni Purîshya we will bear after the went of Angiras. 38
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्वग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यदन्वहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः। अनु सूर्यस्य पुरुत्रा च रश्मीननु द्यावापृथिवीऽआततन्थ ॥१७ ॥
translation: Agni hath looked along the van of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jâtavedas, And many a time along the beams of Sûrya: along the heaven and earth hast thou extended.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आगत्य वाज्यध्वानꣳ सर्वा मृधो विधूनुते। अग्निꣳ सधस्थे महति चक्षुषा निचिकीषते ॥१८ ॥
translation: The Courser, started on his way, shakes from him all hostilities. He longs to look with reverent eye on Agni is the mighty. seat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आक्रम्य वाजिन् पृथिवीमग्निमिच्छ रुचा त्वम्। भूम्या वृत्वाय नो ब्रूहि यतः खनेम तं वयम् ॥१९ ॥
translation: O Courser, having come to earth, seek Agni with a longing wish. Tell us by trampling on the ground where we may dig him from the earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्यौस्ते पृष्ठं पृथिवी सधस्थमात्मान्तरिक्षꣳ समुद्रो योनिः। विख्याय चक्षुषा त्वमभि तिष्ठ पृतन्यतः ॥२० ॥
translation: Heaven is thy back, the earth thy seat, the air thy soul, the sea thy womb. Looking around thee with thine eye trample the adversaries down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्क्राम महते सौभगायास्मादास्थानाद् द्रविणोदा वाजिन्। वयꣳ स्याम सुमतौ पृथिव्याऽअग्निं खनन्तऽउपस्थेऽअस्याः ॥२१ ॥
translation: Wealth-giver, Courser, from this place step forth to great felicity. May we enjoy Earth’s favour while we dig forth Agni from her
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदक्रमीद् द्रविणोदा वाज्यर्वाकः सुलोकꣳ सुकृतं पृथिव्याम्। ततः खनेम सुप्रतीकमग्निꣳ स्वो रुहाणाऽअधि नाकमुत्तमम् ॥२२ ॥
translation: Down hath he stepped, wealth-giver, racer, courser. Good and auspicious room on earth thou madest. Thence let us dig forth Agni, fair to look on, while to the loftiest vault we mount, to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा जिघर्मि मनसा घृतेन प्रतिक्षियन्तं भुवनानि विश्वा। पृथुं तिरश्चा वयसा बृहन्तं व्यचिष्ठमन्नै रभसं दृशानम् ॥२३ ॥
translation: I thoughtfully besprinkle thee with butter, thee dwelling near to all existing creatures. Broad, vast through vital power that moves transversely, conspicuous, strong with all the food that feeds thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चं जिघर्म्यरक्षसा मनसा तज्जुषेत। मर्य्यश्रीः स्पृहयद्वर्णोऽअग्निर्नाभिमृशे तन्वा जर्भुराणः ॥२४ ॥
translation: I sprinkle him who moves in all directions: may he accept it with a friendly spirit. Agni with bridegroom’s face and lovely colour may not be touched when all his form is fury.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि वाजपतिः कविरग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत्। दधद् रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥२५ ॥
translation: Round the oblation bath he paced, Agni the wise, the Lord of Strength, Giving the offerer precious boons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रꣳ सहस्य धीमहि। धृषद्वर्णं दिवेदिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावताम् ॥२६ ॥
translation: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage, Of hero lineage, day by day destroyer of our treacherous foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने द्युभिस्त्वमाशुशुक्षणिस्त्वमद्भ्यस्त्वमश्मनस्परि। त्वं वनेभ्यस्त्वमोषधीभ्यस्त्वं नृणां नृपते जायसे शुचिः ॥२७ ॥
translation: Thou, Agni, with the days, fain to shine hitherward, art brought to life from out the waters, from the stone, From out the forest trees and herbs that grow on ground. thou, Sovran Lord of men, art generated pure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। पृथिव्याः सधस्थादग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वत् खनामि। ज्योतिष्मन्तं त्वाग्ने सुप्रतीकमजस्रेण भानुना दीद्यतम्। शिवं प्रजाभ्योऽहिꣳसन्तं पृथिव्याः सधस्थादग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वत् खनामः ॥२८ ॥
translation: At Savitar’s, the Shining One’s, impulsion, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan, As Angiras was wont to do, I dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purîshya. Thee, Agni, luminous and fair of aspect, resplendent with imperishable lustre, gracious to living creatures, never harming, As Angiras was wont to do, we dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purîshya.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपां पृष्ठमसि योनिरग्नेः समुद्रमभितः पिन्वमानम्। वर्धमानो महाँ२ऽआ च पुष्करे दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथस्व ॥२९ ॥
translation: Thou art the Waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread thou in amplitude with heaven’s own measure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शर्म च स्थो वर्म च स्थोऽछिद्रे बहुलेऽउभे। व्यचस्वती संवसाथां भृतमग्निं पुरीष्यम् ॥३० ॥
translation: Yea are a shelter and a shield, uninjured both, and widely spread. Do ye; expansive, cover him: bear ye Purîshya Agni up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: संवसाथास्वर्विदा समीचीऽउरसा त्मना। अग्निमन्तर्भरिष्यन्ती ज्योतिष्मन्तमजस्रमित् ॥३१ ॥
translation: Cover him, finders of the light, united both with breast and self, Bearing between you Agni, the refulgent, everlasting One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरीष्योऽसि विश्वभराऽअथर्वा त्वा प्रथमो निरमन्थदग्ने। त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत ॥ मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः ॥३२ ॥
translation: Thou art Purîshya, thou support of all. Atharvan was the first, Agni, who rubbed thee into life. Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus, from The head of Visva, of the Priest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु त्वा दध्यङ्ङृषिः पुत्रऽईधेऽअथर्वणः। वृत्रहणं पुरन्दरम् ॥३३ ॥
translation: Thee too as Vritra-slayer, thee breaker of forts, the Sage Dadhyach, Son of Atharvan, lighted up. 39
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु त्वा पाथ्यो वृषा समीधे दस्युहन्तमम्। धनञ्जयꣳ रणेरणे ॥३४ ॥
translation: Pâthya the Bull, too, kindled thee the Dasyus’ most destructive foe, Winner of spoil in every fight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सीद होतः स्वऽउ लोके चिकित्वान्त्सादया यज्ञꣳ सुकृतस्य योनौ। देवावीर्देवान् हविषा यजास्यग्ने बृहद्यजमाने वयो धाः ॥३५ ॥
translation: Sit, Hotar, in the Hotar’s place, observant: lay down the sacrifice in the place of worship. Thou, dear to Go is, shalt serve them with oblation. Agni, give long life to the Sacrificer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि होता होतृषदने विदानस्त्वेषो दीदिवाँ२ऽअसदत् सुदक्षः। अदब्धव्रतप्रमतिर्वसिष्ठः सहस्रम्भरः शुचिजिह्वोऽअग्निः ॥३६ ॥
translation: Accustomed to the Hotar’s place, the Hotar hath seated him, bright, splendid, passing mighty, Whose foresight keeps the Law from violation, excellent, pure-tongued, bringing thousands, Agni.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सꣳसीदस्व महाँ२ऽअसि शोचस्व देववीतमः। वि धूममग्नेऽअरुषं मियेध्य सृज प्रशस्त दर्शतम् ॥३७ ॥
translation: Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke, ruddy and beautiful to see.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपो देवीरुपसृज मधुमतीरयक्ष्माय प्रजाभ्यः। तासामास्थानादुज्जिहतामोषधयः सुपिप्पलाः ॥३८ ॥
translation: Pour heavenly Waters honey-sweet here for our health, for progeny. Forth from the place whereon they fall let plants with goodly berries spring.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं ते वायुर्मातरिश्वा दधातूत्तानाया हृदयं यद्विकस्तम्। यो देवानां चरसि प्राणथेन कस्मै देव वषडस्तु तुभ्यम् ॥३९ ॥
translation: May Vâyu Mâtarisvan heal and comfort thy broken heart as there supine thou liest. Thou unto whom the breath of Gods gives motion, to Ka, yea, unto thee, O God, be Vashat!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुजातो ज्योतिषा सह शर्म वरूथमासदत् स्वः। वासोऽअग्ने विश्वरूपꣳ संव्ययस्व विभावसो ॥४० ॥
translation: He, nobly born with lustre, shield and refuge, hath sat down in light. O Agni, Rich in Splendour, robe thyself in many-hued attire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु तिष्ठ स्वध्वरावा नो देव्या धिया। दृशे च भासा बृहता सुशुक्वनिराग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिः ॥४१ ॥
translation: Lord of fair sacrifice; arise! With Godlike thought protect us well. With great light splendid to behold come, Agni, through sweet hymns of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वऽऊ षु णऽऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता। ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे ॥४२ ॥
translation: Rise up erect to give us aid, stand up like Savitar the God; Erect as strength-bestower when we call aloud, with unguents and with priests on thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स जातो गर्भोऽअसि रोदस्योरग्ने चारुर्विभृतऽओषधीषु। चित्रः शिशुः परि तमास्यक्तून् प्र मातृभ्योऽअधि कनिक्रदद् गाः ॥४३ ॥
translation: Thou, being horn, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted, fair Babe, among the plants, O Agni. The glooms of night thou, brilliant child, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from the Mothers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्थिरो भव वीड्वङ्गऽआशुर्भव वाज्यर्वन्। पृथुर्भव सुषदस्त्वमग्नेः पुरीषवाहणः ॥४४ ॥
translation: Steady be thou, and firm of limb. Steed, be a racer fleet of foot. Broad be thou, pleasant as a seat, bearing the store which Agni needs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिवो भव प्रजाभ्यो मानुषीभ्यस्त्वमङ्गिरः। मा द्यावापृथिवीऽअभि शोचीर्मान्तरिक्षं मा वनस्पतीन् ॥४५ ॥
translation: Be thou propitious, Angiras, to creatures of the human race. Set not on fire the heaven and earth, nor air’s mid-region, nor the trees.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रैतु वाजी कनिक्रदन्नानदद्रासभः पत्वा। भरन्नग्निं पुरीष्यं मा पाद्यायुषः पुरा। वृषाग्निं वृषणं भरन्नपां गर्भꣳ समुद्रियम्। अग्नऽआयाहि वीतये ॥४६ ॥
translation: Forth with loud neighing go the Steed, the Ass that shouteth as he runs. Bearing Purîshya Agni on, let him not perish ere his time, Male bearer of male Agni, Child of Waters, Offspring of the Sea. Agni, come hither to the feast.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतꣳ सत्यमृतꣳ सत्यमग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वद्भरामः। ओषधयः प्रतिमोदध्वमग्निमेतꣳ शिवमायन्तमभ्यत्र युष्माः। व्यस्यन् विश्वाऽअनिराऽअमीवा निषीदन्नोऽअप दुर्मतिं जहि ॥४७ ॥
translation: The Law the Truth, the Law the Truth. As Angiras was wont to do, we bear Purîshya Agni on. Ye Plants, with joyous welcome greet this Agni, auspicious One who cometh on to meet you. Removing all distresses and afflictions, here settle down and banish evil purpose.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओषधयः प्रतिगृभ्णीत पुष्पवतीः सुपिप्पलाः। अयं वो गर्भऽऋत्वियः प्रत्नꣳ सधस्थमासदत् ॥४८ ॥
translation: Welcome him joyfully, ye Plants, laden with bloom and goodly fruit. This seasonable Child of yours hath settled in his ancient seat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि पाजसा पृथुना शोशुचानो बाधस्व द्विषो रक्षसोऽअमीवाः। सुशर्मणो बृहतः शर्मणि स्यामग्नेरहꣳ सुहवस्य प्रणीतौ ॥४९ ॥
translation: Resplendent with thy wide-extending lustre dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us. May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, ready to hear our call, the good Protector.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता नऽऊर्जे दधातन। महे रणाय चक्षसे ॥५० ॥
translation: Ye, Waters, are beneficent, so help ye us to energy That we may look on great delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः। उशतीरिव मातरः ॥५१ ॥
translation: Give us a portion of the sap, the most propitious that ye have. Like mothers in their longing love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्माऽअंर गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ। आपो जनयथा च नः ॥५२ ॥
translation: To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye lead us on: And, Waters, give us procreant strength. 40
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रः सꣳसृज्य पृथिवीं भूमिं च ज्योतिषा सह। सुजातं जातवेदसमयक्ष्माय त्वा सꣳसृजामि प्रजाभ्यः ॥५३ ॥
translation: Mitra, having commingled earth and ground together with the light For health to creatures mix I thee Omniscient and nobly born.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रुद्राः सꣳसृज्य पृथिवीं बृहज्ज्योतिः समीधिरे। तेषां भानुरजस्रऽइच्छुक्रो देवेषु रोचते ॥५४ ॥
translation: The Rudras, having mixed the earth, set all aglow the lofty light. Bright and perpetual their light verily shines among the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सꣳसृष्टां वसुभी रुद्रैर्धीरैः कर्मण्यां मृदम्। हस्ताभ्यां मृद्वीं कृत्वा सिनीवाली कृणोतु ताम् ॥५५ ॥
translation: The lump of clay that hath been mixed by Vasus, Rudras, by the wise, May Sinîvâlî with her hands soften and fit it for the work.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सिनीवाली सुकपर्दा सुकुरीरा स्वौपशा। सा तुभ्यमदिते मह्योखां दधातु हस्तयोः ॥५६ ॥
translation: May Sinîvâlî with fair braids, with beauteous crest, with lovely locks, May she, O mighty Aditi, bestow the Fire-pan in thy hands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उखां कृणोतु शक्त्या बाहुभ्यामदितिर्धिया। माता पुत्रं यथोपस्थे साग्निं बिभर्त्तु गर्भऽआ। मखस्य शिरोऽसि ॥५७ ॥
translation: Aditi shape the Fire-pan with her power, her arms, her intellect, And in her womb bear Agni as a mother, in her lap, her son.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसवस्त्वा कृण्वन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवासि पृथिव्यसि धारया मयि प्रजा रायस्पोषं गौपत्यꣳ सुवीर्यꣳ सजातान् यजमानाय रुद्रास्त्वा कृण्वन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवास्यन्तरिक्षमसि धारया मयि प्रजा रायस्पोषं गौपत्यꣳ सुवीर्यꣳ सजातान् यजमानायाऽऽदित्यास्त्वा कृण्वन्तु जागतेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवासि द्यौरसि धारया मयि प्रजा रायस्पोषं गौपत्यꣳ सुवीर्यꣳ सजातान् यजमानाय विश्वे त्वा देवाः वैश्वानराः कृण्वन्त्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवासि दिशोऽसि धारया मयि प्रजा रायस्पोषं गौपत्यꣳ सुवीर्यꣳ सजातान् यजमानाय ॥५८ ॥
translation: With Gâyatrî, like Angiras the Vasus form and fashion thee! Stedfast art then, thou art the Earth. Establish in me progeny, command of cattle, growth of wealth, kinsmen for me the worshipper. With Trishtup may the Rudras, like Angiras, form and fashion thee. Stedfast art thou, thou art the Air. Establish in me, etc., as above. With Jagatî, like Angiras, Âdityas form and fashion thee! Stedfast art thou, thou art the Sky. Establish in me, etc. Friends of all men, the All-Gods with Anushtup form thee Angiras-like. Stedfast art thou, thou art the Quarters. Establish in me, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदित्यै रास्नास्यदितिष्टे बिलं गृभ्णातु। कृत्वाय सा महीमुखां मृन्मयीं योनिमग्नये। पुत्रेभ्यः प्रायच्छददितिः श्रपयानिति ॥५९ ॥
translation: The zone of Aditi art thou. Aditi seize thy hollow space. She, having made the great Fire- pan, a womb for Agni, formed of clay, Aditi, gave it to her Sons and, Let them bake it, were her words.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसवस्त्वा धूपयन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसाङ्गिरस्वद् रुद्रास्त्वा धूपयन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसाङ्गिरस्वदादित्यास्त्वा धूपयन्तु जागतेन छन्दसाङ्गिरस्वद् विश्वे त्वा देवा वैश्वानरा धूपयन्त्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसाङ्गिरस्वदिन्द्रस्त्वा धूपयतु वरुणस्त्वा धूपयतु विष्णुस्त्वा धूपयतु ॥६० ॥
translation: The Vasus make thee fragrant, as Angiras did, with Gâyatrî! The Rudras make thee fragrant with the Trishtup, as did Angiras! With Gâyatrî, like Angiras, may the Âdityas perfume thee. Dear to all men, may the All-Gods with the Anushtup sweeten thee, as Angiras was wont to do. May Indra make thee odorous. May Varuna make thee odorous. May Vishnu make thee odorous.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदितिष्ट्वा देवी विश्वदेव्यावती पृथिव्याः सधस्थेऽअङ्गिरस्वत् खनत्ववट देवानां त्वा पत्नीर्देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थेऽअङ्गिरस्वद् दधतूखे धिषणास्त्वा देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थेऽअङ्गिरस्वदभीन्धतामुखे वरूत्रीष्ट्वा देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थेऽअङ्गिरस्वच्छ्रपयन्तूखे ग्नास्त्वा देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थेऽअङ्गिरस्वत् पचन्तूखे जनयस्त्वाऽछिन्नपत्रा देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थेऽअङ्गिरस्वत् पचन्तूखे ॥६१ ॥
translation: Pit! Angiras-like may Aditi the Goddess, beloved by all Gods, dig thee in Earth’s bosom. Pan! Angiras-like may the Gods’ heavenly Consorts, dear to all Gads, in the Earth’s bosom place thee. Pan! Angiras-like may Dhishanâs, Divine Ones, dear to alt Gods, in the Earth’s bosom light thee. Pan! Angiras-like may the divine Varûtrîs, dear to all Gods, in the earth’s bosom heat thee, Pan! Angiras-like may the celestial Ladies, dear to all Gods, in the earth’s bosom bake thee. Angiras-like may the celestial Matrons, beloved by all the Gods, with unclipped pinions, within the lap of Earth, O Fire pan, bake thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृतोऽवो देवस्य सानसि। द्युम्नं चित्रश्रवस्तमम् ॥६२ ॥
translation: The gainful grace of Mitra, God, supporter of the race of man, Is glorious, of most wondrous fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवस्त्वा सवितोद्वपतु सुपाणिः स्वङ्गुरिः सुबाहुरुत शक्त्या। अव्यथमाना पृथिव्यामाशा दिशऽआपृण ॥६३ ॥
translation: With lovely arms, with lovely hands, with lovely fingers may the God Savitar make thee clean, yea, by the power be hath. Not trembling on the earth fill thou the regions, fill the Quarters full.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्थाय बृहती भवोदु तिष्ठ ध्रुवा त्वम्। मित्रैतां तऽउखां परि ददाम्यभित्याऽएषा मा भेदि ॥६४ ॥
translation: Having arisen wax thou great, yea, stand thou up immovable. To thee, O Mitra, I entrust this Fire-pan for security. May it remain without a break.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसवस्त्वाऽऽछृन्दन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद् रुद्रास्त्वाऽऽछृन्दन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वदादित्यास्त्वाऽऽछृन्दन्तु जागतेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद् विश्वे त्वा देवा वैश्वानराऽऽआछृन्दन्त्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वत् ॥६५ ॥
translation: Thee may the Vasus, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Gâyatrî. Thee may the Rudras, Angiras-like, fill with the Trishtup metre full. Thee may Âdityas, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Jagatî. With the Anushtup metre may the All-Gods, dear to all men, fill thee full, as Angiras was wont. 41
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आकूतिमग्निं प्रयुजꣳ स्वाहा मनो मेधामग्निं प्रयुजꣳ स्वाहा चित्तं विज्ञातमग्निं प्रयुजꣳ स्वाहा वाचो विधृतिमग्निं प्रयुजꣳ स्वाहा प्रजापतये मनवे स्वाहाऽग्नये वैश्वानराय स्वाहा ॥६६ ॥
translation: Intention, Agni. Motive, Hail! Mind, Wisdom, Agni, Motive, Hail! Thought, Knowledge, Agni, Motive, Hail! Rule of Speech, Agni, Motive, Hail! To Manu Lord of creatures, Hail! To Agni dear to all men, Hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर्मर्तो वुरीत सख्यम्। विश्वो रायऽइषुध्यति द्युम्नं वृणीत पुष्यसे स्वाहा ॥६७ ॥
translation: May every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God. Each one solicits him for wealth: let him seek fame to prosper him. All-hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा सु भित्था मा सु रिषोऽम्ब धृष्णु वीरयस्व सु। अग्निश्चेदं करिष्यथः ॥६८ ॥
translation: Break not, nor suffer any harm. Endure, O Mother, and be brave; This work will thou and Agni do.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दृꣳहस्व देवि पृथिवि स्वस्तयऽआसुरी माया स्वधया कृतासि। जुष्टं देवेभ्यऽइदमस्तु हव्यमरिष्टा त्वमुदिहि यज्ञेऽअस्मिन् ॥६९ ॥
translation: Be firm for weal, O Goddess Earth. Made in the wonted manner thou Art a celestial design. Acceptable to Gods he this oblation. Arise thou in this sacrifice uninjured.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्र्वन्नः सर्पिरासुतिः प्रत्नो होता वरेण्यः। सहसस्पुत्रोऽअद्भुतः ॥७० ॥
translation: Wood-fed, bedewed with sacred oil, ancient, Invoker, excellent, The Son of Strength, the Wonderful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परस्याऽअधि संवतोऽवराँ२ऽअभ्यातर। यत्राहमस्मि ताँ२ऽअव ॥७१ ॥
translation: Abandoning the foeman’s host, pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परमस्याः परावतो रोहिदश्वऽइहागहि। पुरीष्यः पुरुप्रियोऽग्ने त्वं तरा मृधः ॥७२ ॥
translation: From the remotest distance come, Lord of the Red Steeds, hitherward. Do thou Purîshya, Agni, loved of many, overcome our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारुणि दध्मसि। सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतं तज्जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥७३ ॥
translation: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay on thee, May that he butter unto thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदत्त्युपजिह्विका यद्वम्रोऽअतिसर्पति। सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतं तज्जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥७४ ॥
translation: That which the termite eats away, that over which the emmet crawls— Butter be all of this to thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहरहरप्रयावं भरन्तोऽश्वायेव तिष्ठते घासमस्मै। रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदन्तोऽग्ने मा ते प्रतिवेशा रिषाम ॥७५ ॥
translation: Bringing to him, with care unceasing, fodder day after day as to a stabled courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni, ne’er be injured.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाभा पृथिव्याः समिधानेऽअग्नौ रायस्पोषाय बृहते हवामहे। इरम्मदं बृहदुक्थं यजत्रं जेतारमग्निं पृतनासु सासहिम् ॥७६ ॥
translation: While on earth’s navel Agni is enkindled, we call, for ample increase of our riches, On Agni joying in the draught, much-lauded, worshipful; victor conquering in battle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याः सेनाऽअभीत्वरीराव्याधिनीरुगणाऽउत। ये स्तेना ये च तस्करास्ताँस्तेऽअग्नेऽपिदधाम्यास्ये ॥७७ ॥
translation: Whatever hosts there are, fiercely assailant, charging in lengthened lines, drawn up in order, Whatever thieves there are, whatever robbers, all these I cast into thy mouth, O Agni.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दꣳष्ट्राभ्यां मलिम्लूञ्जम्भ्यैस्तस्कराँ२ऽउत। हनुभ्या स्तेनान् भगवस्ताँस्त्वं खाद सुखादितान् ॥७८ ॥
translation: Devour the burglars with both tusks, destroy the robbers with thy teeth. With both thy jaws, thou Holy One, eat up those thieves well champed and chewed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये जनेषु मलिम्लव स्तेनासस्तस्करा वने। ये कक्षेष्वघायवस्ताँस्ते दधामि जम्भयोः ॥७९ ॥
translation: The burglars living among men, the thieves and robbers in the wood, Criminals lurking in their lairs, these do I lay between thy jaws.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योऽअस्मभ्यमरातीयाद्यश्च नो द्वेषते जनः। निन्दाद्योऽअस्मान् धिप्साच्च सर्वं तं भस्मसा कुरु ॥८० ॥
translation: Him who would seek to injure us, the man who looks oh us with hate Turn thou to ashes, and the man who slanders and would injure us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सꣳशितं मे ब्रह्म सꣳशितं वीर्यं बलम्। सꣳशितं क्षत्रं जिष्णु यस्याहमस्मि पुरोहितः ॥८१ ॥
translation: Quickened is this my priestly rank, quickened is manly strength and force, Quickened is his victorious power of whom I am the Household priest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदेषां बाहूऽअतिरमुद्वर्चोऽअथो बलम्। क्षिणोमि ब्रह्मणामित्रानुन्नयामि स्वाँ२अहम् ॥८२ ॥
translation: The arms of these men have I raised, have raised their lustre and their strength With priestly power I ruin foes and lift my friends to high estate.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्नपतेऽन्नस्य नो देह्यनमीवस्य शुष्मिणः। प्रप्र दातारं तारिषऽऊर्जं नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ॥८३ ॥
translation: A share of food, O Lord of Food, vouchsafe us, invigorating food that brings no sickness. Onward, still onward lead the giver. Grant us maintenance both for quadruped and biped. 42
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दृशानो रुक्मऽउर्व्या व्यद्यौद् दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः। अग्निरमृतोऽअभवद् वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौरजनयत् सुरेताः ॥१ ॥
translation: FAR hath he shone abroad like gold to look on, beaming imperishable life for glory. Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे धापयेते शिशुमेकंꣳ समीची। द्यावाक्षामा रुक्मोऽअन्तर्विभाति देवाऽअग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाः ॥२ ॥
translation: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, meeting together, suckle one same infant. Golden between the heaven and earth he shineth. The wealth-possessing Gods supported Agni.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वा रूपाणि प्रतिमुञ्चते कविः प्रासावीद् भद्रं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे। वि नाकमख्यत् सविता वरेण्योऽनु प्रयाणमुषसो विराजति ॥३ ॥
translation: The Sapient One arrays himself in every form: for quadruped and biped he hath brought forth good. Excellent Savitar hath looked on heaven’s high vault: he shineth after the outgoings of the Dawn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुपर्णोऽसि गरुत्माँस्त्रिवृत्ते शिरो गायत्रं चक्षुर्बृहद्रथन्तरे पक्षौ। स्तोमऽआत्मा छन्दास्यङ्गानि यजूषि नाम। साम ते तनूर्वामदेव्यं यज्ञायज्ञियं पुच्छं धिष्ण्याः शफाः। सुपर्णोऽसि गरुत्मान् दिवं गच्छ स्वः पत ॥४ ॥
translation: Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: thou hast the Trivrit for thy head. Gâyatra is thine eye, thy wings are Brihat and Rathantara. The hymn is self, the metres are his limbs, the formulas his name. The Vâmadevya Sâman is thy form, the Yajñâyajñiya thy tail, the fire-hearths are thy hooves. Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: go skyward, soar to heavenly light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा गायत्रं छन्दऽआरोह पृथिवीमनु विक्रमस्व विष्णोः क्रमोऽस्यभिमातिहा त्रैष्टुभं छन्दऽआरोहान्तरिक्षमनु विक्रमस्व विष्णोः क्रमोऽस्यरातीयतो हन्ता जागतं छन्दऽआरोह दिवमनु विक्रमस्व विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि शत्रूयतो हन्तानुष्टुभं छन्दऽआरोह दिशोऽनु विक्रमस्व ॥५ ॥
translation: Thou art the riyal-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Gâyatra metre: stride along the earth. Thou art the foe-destroying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Trishtup metre: stride along mid-air. Thou art the traitor-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Jagatî metre: stride along the sky. Thou art the foeman-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount Anushtup metre: stride along the Quarters.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अक्रन्ददग्नि स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद् वीरुधः समञ्जन्। सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धोऽअख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः ॥६ ॥
translation: Agni roared out like Dyaus what time he thunders: licking full oft the earth round plants he flickered. At once, when born, he looked about, enkindled: he shineth forth between the earth and heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्नेऽभ्यावर्त्तिन्नभि मा निवर्त्तस्वायुषा वर्चसा प्रजया धनेन। सन्या मेधया रय्या पोषेण ॥७ ॥
translation: Return to me, thou still-returning Agni, with life, with lustre, progeny, and treasure, With profit, wisdom, riches, and abundance.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्नेऽअङ्गिरः शतं ते सन्त्वावृतः सहस्रं तऽउपावृतः। अधा पोषस्य पोषेण पुनर्नो नष्टमाकृधि पुनर्नो रयिमाकृधि ॥८ ॥
translation: A hundred, Agni Angiras! be thy ways, a thousand thy returns. With increment of increase bring thou back to us what we have lost. Again bring hitherward our wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनरूर्जा निवर्त्तस्व पुनरग्नऽइषायुषा। पुनर्नः पाह्यꣳहसः ॥९ ॥
translation: Return again with nourishment; Agni, again with food and life. Again preserve us from distress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सह रय्या निवर्त्तस्वाग्ने पिन्वस्व धारया। विश्वप्स्न्या विश्वतस्परि ॥१० ॥
translation: Agni, return with store of wealth. Swell with thine overflowing stream that feedeth all on every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वाहार्षमन्तरभूर्ध्रुवस्तिष्ठाविचाचलिः। विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद्राष्ट्रमधिभ्रशत् ॥११ ॥
translation: I brought thee: thou hast entered in. Stand stedfast and immovable. Lot all the people long for thee. Let not thy kingship fall away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमꣳ श्रथाय। अथा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसोऽअदितये स्याम ॥१२ ॥
translation: Varuna, from the upmost bond release us, let down the lowest and remove the midmost. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Âditya.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्रे बृहन्नुषसामूर्ध्वोऽअस्थान्निर्जगन्वान् तमसो ज्योतिषागात्। अग्निर्भानुना रुशता स्वङ्गऽआ जातो विश्वा सद्मान्यप्राः ॥१३ ॥
translation: High hath the Mighty risen before the Mornings, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हꣳसः शुचिषद् वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषदतिथिर्दुरोणसत्। नृषद् वरसदृतसद् व्योमसदब्जा गोजाऽऋतजाऽअद्रिजाऽऋतं बृहत् ॥१४ ॥
translation: The Hamsa homed in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest beside the altar, Guest within the house, Dweller in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, he is holy Law. The Great.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सीद त्वं मातुरस्याऽउपस्थे विश्वान्यग्ने वयुनानि विद्वान्। मैनां तपसा मार्चिषाऽभिशोचीरन्तरस्या शुक्रज्योतिर्विभाहि ॥१५ ॥
translation: Knowing all holy ordinances, Agni, be seated in the lap of this thy mother. Do not with heat or glowing flame consume her: shine thou within her with refulgent lustre. 43
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्तरग्ने रुचा त्वमुखायाः सदने स्वे। तस्यास्त्वꣳ हरसा तपञ्जातवेदः शिवो भव ॥१६ ॥
translation: Within this Fire-pan with thy light, O Agni, in thy proper seat, Glowing with warmth, be gracious thou, O Jâtavedas, unto her.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिवो भूत्वा मह्यमग्नेऽअथो सीद शिवस्त्वम्। शिवाः कृत्वा दिशः सर्वाः स्वं योनिमिहासदः ॥१७ ॥
translation: Being propitious unto me, O Agni, sit propitiously. Having made all the regions blest, in thine own dwelling seat thyself.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवस्परि प्रथमं जज्ञेऽअग्निरस्मद् द्वितीयं परि जातवेदाः। तृतीयमप्सु नृमणाऽअजस्रमिन्धानऽएनं जरते स्वाधीः ॥१८ ॥
translation: First Agni sprang to life from out of heaven, the second time from us came Jâtavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him Eternal.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा तेऽअग्ने त्रेधा त्रयाणि विद्मा ते धाम विभृता पुरुत्रा। विद्मा ते नाम परमं गुहा यद्विद्मा तमुत्सं यतऽआजगन्थ ॥१९ ॥
translation: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रे त्वा नृमणाऽअप्स्वन्तर्नृचक्षाऽईधे दिवो अग्नऽऊधन्। तृतीये त्वा रजसि तस्थिवासमपामुपस्थे महिषाऽअवर्धन् ॥२० ॥
translation: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, Man’s Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven. There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Bulls increased thee in the waters’ bosom.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अक्रन्ददग्नि स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद् वीरुधः समञ्जन्। सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धोऽअख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः ॥२१ ॥
translation: Agni roared out, etc. (verse 6 repeated).
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रीणामुदारो धरुणो रयीणां मनीषाणां प्रार्पणः सोमगोपाः। वसुः सूनुः सहसोऽअप्सु राजा विभात्यग्रऽउषसामिधानः ॥२२ ॥
translation: The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma, Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वस्य केतुर्भुवनस्य गर्भऽआ रोदसीऽअपृणाज्जायमानः। वीडुं चिदद्रिमभिनत् परायञ्जना यदग्निमयजन्त पञ्च ॥२३ ॥
translation: Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, he sprang to life and filled the earth and heaven. Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उशिक् पावको अरतिः सुमेधा मर्त्येष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि। इयर्त्ति धूममरुषं भरिभ्रदुच्छुक्रेण शोचिषा द्यामिनक्षन् ॥२४ ॥
translation: So among mortals was immortal Agni stablished as cleansing, wise, and eager envoy. He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heaven with radiant lustre.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दृशानो रुक्मऽउर्व्या व्यद्यौद् दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः। अग्निरमृतोऽअभवद् वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौरजनयत् सुरेताः ॥२५ ॥
translation: Far hath he shone, etc. (verse 1 repeated).
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्तेऽअद्य कृणवद् भद्रशोचेऽपूपं देव घृतवन्तमग्ने। प्र तं नय प्रतरं वस्योऽअच्छाभि सुम्नं देवभक्तं यविष्ठ ॥२६ ॥
translation: Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, makes thee a cake, O Agni, mixed with butter, Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ तं भज सौश्रवसेष्वग्नऽउक्थऽउक्थऽआभज शस्यमाने। प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियोऽअग्ना भवात्युज्जातेन भिनददुज्जनित्वैः ॥२७ ॥
translation: Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every, song of praise sung forth enrich him. Dear let him be to Sûrya, dear to Agni, preëminent with son and children’s children.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामग्ने यजमानाऽअनु द्यून् विश्वा वसु दधिरे वार्याणि। त्वया सह द्रविणमिच्छमाना व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो विवव्रुः ॥२८ ॥
translation: While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing. Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्ताव्यग्निर्नराꣳ सुशेवो वैश्वानरऽऋषिभिः सोमगोपाः। अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम् ॥२९ ॥
translation: Agni, man’s gracious Friend, the Soma’s keeper, Vaisvânara, hath been lauded by the Rishis. We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत घृतैर्बोधयतातिथिम्। आस्मिन् हव्या जुहोतन ॥३० ॥
translation: Pay service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest with oil: In him present your offerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु त्वा विश्वे देवाऽअग्ने भरन्तु चित्तिभिः। स नो भव शिवस्त्वꣳ सुप्रतीको विभावसुः ॥३१ ॥
translation: May all the Gods, O Agni, bear thee upward with their earnest thoughts: Not to be looked on, rich in light, be thou propitious unto us,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेदग्ने ज्योतिष्मान् याहि शिवेभिरर्चिभिष्ट्वम्। बृहद्भिर्भानुभिर्भासन् मा हिꣳसीस्तन्वा प्रजाः ॥३२ ॥
translation: Agni, go forth resplendent, thou with thine auspicious flames of fire. Shining with mighty beams of light harm not my people with thy form.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अक्रन्ददग्नि स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद् वीरुधः समञ्जन्। सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धोऽअख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः ॥३३ ॥
translation: Agni roared out, etc. (verse 21 repeated.)
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रप्रायमग्निर्भरतस्य शृण्वे वि यत्सूर्यो न रोचते बृहद्भाः। अभि यः पूरुं पृतनासु तस्थौ दीदाय दैव्योऽअतिथिः शिवो नः ॥३४ ॥
translation: Far famed is this the Bharata’s own Agni: he shineth like the Sun with lofty splendour. He who hath vanquished Pûru in the battle, the heavenly Guest hath shone for us benignly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आपो देवीः प्रतिगृभ्णीत भस्मैतत् स्योने कृणुध्वꣳ सुरभाऽउ लोके। तस्मै नमन्तां जनयः सुपत्नीर्मातेव पुत्रं बिभृताप्स्वेनत् ॥३५ ॥
translation: Receive these ashes, ye celestial Waters, and lay them in a fair place full of fragrance. To him bow down the nobly-wedded Matrons! Bear this on waters as her son a mother. 44
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्स्वग्ने सधिष्टव सौषधीरनु रुध्यसे। गर्भे सञ्जायसे पुनः ॥३६ ॥
translation: Agni, thy home is in the floods: into the plants thou forcest way, And as their child art born anew.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गर्भोऽअस्योषधीनां गर्भो वनस्पतीनाम्। गर्भो विश्वस्य भूतस्याग्ने गर्भोऽअपामसि ॥३७ ॥
translation: Thou art the offspring of the plants, thou art the offspring of the trees: The offspring thou of all that is, thou, Agni, art the Waters’ Child,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रसद्य भस्मना योनिमपश्च पृथिवीमग्ने। सꣳसृज्य मातृभिष्ट्वं ज्योतिष्मान् पुनरासदः ॥३८ ॥
translation: With ashes having reached the womb, the waters, Agni and the earth, United with the mothers, thou blazing hast seated thee again.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनरासद्य सदनमपश्च पृथिवीमग्ने। शेषे मातुर्यथोपस्थेऽन्तरस्या शिवतमः ॥३९ ॥
translation: Seated again upon thy seat, the waters, Agni! and the earth, In her, thou, most auspicious One, liest as in a mother’s lap 40, 41 Return again, etc. Agni, return, etc. (verses 9 and 10 repeated).
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बोधा मेऽअस्य वचसो यविष्ठ मꣳहिष्ठस्य प्रभृतस्य स्वधावः। पीयति त्वोऽअनु त्वो गृणाति वन्दारुष्टे तन्वं वन्देऽअग्ने ॥४२ ॥
translation: Mark this my speech, Divine One, thou Most Youthful, offered to thee by him who gives most freely: One hates thee, and another sings thy praises. I thine adorer laud thy form, O Agni.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स बोधि सूरिर्मघवा वसुपते वसुदावन्। युयोध्यस्मद् द्वेषासि विश्वकर्मणे स्वाहा ॥४३ ॥
translation: Be thou for us a liberal Prince, Giver and Lord of precious things. Drive those who hate us far away. To the Omnific One All-hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनस्त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धतां पुनर्ब्रह्माणो वसुनीथ यज्ञैः। घृतेन त्वं तन्वं वर्धयस्व सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः ॥४४ ॥
translation: Again let the Âdityas, Rudras, Yams, and Brahmans with their rites light thee, Wealth- bringer! Increase thy body with presented butter: effectual be the Sacrificer’s wishes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातो येऽत्रस्थ पुराणा ये च नूतनाः। अदाद्यमोऽवसानं पृथिव्याऽअक्रन्निमं पितरो लोकमस्मै ॥४५ ॥
translation: Go hence, depart, creep off in all directions, both ancient visitors and recent comers: Yama hath given a place on earth to rest in. This place for him the Fathers have provided.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: संज्ञानमसि कामधरणं मयि ते कामधरणं भूयात्। अग्नेर्भस्मास्यग्नेः पुरीषमसि चित स्थ परिचितऽऊर्ध्वचितः श्रयध्वम् ॥४६ ॥
translation: Knowledge art thou: accomplishment of wishes. In me be the fulfilment of thy wishes. Thou art the ashes, thou the mould of Agni. Rankers are ye, rankers around. Rankers right upward, be ye fixed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयꣳसोऽअग्निर्यस्मिन्त्सोममिन्द्रः सुतं दधे जठरे वावशानः। सहस्रियं वाजमत्यं न सप्तिꣳ ससवान्त्सन्त्स्तूयसे जातवेदः ॥४७ ॥
translation: This is that Agni where the longing Indra took the pressed Soma deep within his body. Winner of spoils in thousands like a courser, with prayer art thou exalted, Jâtavedas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने यत्ते दिवि वर्चः पृथिव्यां यदोषधीष्वप्स्वा यजत्र। येनान्तरिक्षमुर्वाततन्थ त्वेषः स भानुरर्णवो नृचक्षाः ॥४८ ॥
translation: The splendour which is thine in heaven, O Agni, in earth, O Holy One, in plants, in waters, Wherewith thou hast o’erspread mid-air’s broad region, that light is brilliant, billowy, man-surveying.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने दिवोऽअर्णमच्छा जिगास्यच्छा देवाँ२ऽऊचिषे धिष्ण्या ये। या रोचने परस्तात् सूर्यस्य याश्चावस्तादुपतिष्ठन्तऽआपः ॥४९ ॥
translation: O Agni, to the flood of heaven thou mountest, thou tallest hither Gods, the thought- inspirers. The waters, those beyond the light of Sûrya, and those that are beneath it here, approach thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरीष्यासोऽअग्नयः प्रावणेभिः सजोषसः। जुषन्तां यज्ञमद्रुहोऽनमीवाऽइषो महीः ॥५० ॥
translation: May the Purîshya Agnis in accord with those that spring from floods, May they, benevolent, accept the sacrifice, full, wholesome draughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इडामग्ने पुरुदꣳसꣳसनिं गोः शश्वत्तमꣳ हवमानाय साध। स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाऽग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥५१ ॥
translation: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels. To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं ते योनिर्ऋत्वियो यतो जातोऽअरोचथाः। तं जानन्नग्नऽआ रोहाथा नो वर्धया रयिम् ॥५२ ॥
translation: This is thine ordered place of birth whence, sprung to life, thou shonest forth. Knowing this, Agni, mount on high and cause our riches to increase.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चिदसि तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद। परिचिदसि तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद ॥५३ ॥
translation: Ranker art thou: Angiras-like sit steady with that Deity. Ranker-round art thou: Angiras- like sit steady with that Deity.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: लोकं पृण छिद्रं पृणाथो सीद ध्रुवा त्वम्। इन्द्राग्नी त्वा बृहस्पतिरस्मिन् योनावसीषदन् ॥५४ ॥
translation: Fill up the room, supply the void, then settle steady in thy place. Indr-Âgni and Brihaspati have set thee down in this abode.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ताऽअस्य सूददोहसः सोमꣳ श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः। जन्मन् देवानां विशस्त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः ॥५५ ॥
translation: The dappled kine who stream with milk prepare his draught of Soma juice— Clans in the birthplace of the Gods, in the three luminous realms of heaven. 45
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वाऽअवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः। रथीतमꣳ रथीनां वाजाना सत्पतिं पतिम् ॥५६ ॥
translation: All sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of Strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समितꣳ संकल्पेथा संप्रियौ रोचिष्णू सुमनस्यमानौ। इषमूर्जमभि संवसानौ ॥५७ ॥
translation: Combine ye two and harmonize together, dear to each other, brilliant, friendly-minded, Abiding in one place for food and vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं वां मनासि सं व्रता समु चित्तान्याकरम्। अग्ने पुरीष्याधिपा भव त्वं न इषमूर्जं यजमानाय धेहि ॥५८ ॥
translation: Together have I brought your minds, your ordinances, and your thoughts. Be thou our Sovran Lord, Agni Purîshya; give food and vigour to the Sacrificer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं पुरीष्यो रयिमान् पुष्टिमाँ२ऽअसि। शिवाः कृत्वा दिशः सर्वाः स्वं योनिमिहासदः ॥५९ ॥
translation: Thou art Purîshya Agni, thou art wealthy, thou art prosperous. Having made all the regions blest, here seat thee in thine own abode.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भवतन्नः समनसौ सचेतसावरेपसौ। मा यज्ञꣳ हिꣳसिष्टं मा यज्ञपतिं जातवेदसौ शिवौ भवतमद्य नः ॥६० ॥
translation: Be ye one-minded unto us, both of one thought, free from deceit. Harm not the sacrifice, harm not the Patron of the sacrifice. Be gracious unto us to-day, ye knowers of all things that be.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मातेव पुत्रं पृथिवी पुरीष्यमग्नि स्वे योनावभारुखा। तां विश्वैर्देवैर्ऋतुभिः संविदानः प्रजापतिर्विश्वकर्म्मा वि मुञ्चतु ॥६१ ॥
translation: Even as a mother bears her son, Earth, Ukhâ hath borne within her womb Purîshya Agni. Maker of all, accordant with the All-Gods and Seasons, may Prajâpati release her.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असुन्वन्तमयजमानमिच्छ स्तेनस्येत्यामन्विहि तस्करस्य। अन्यमस्मदिच्छ सा तऽइत्या नमो देवि निर्ऋते तुभ्यमस्तु ॥६२ ॥
translation: Seek him who pours not, offers not oblation; follow the going of the thief and robber. This is thy way; leave us and seek some other. To thee, O Goddess Nirriti, be homage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमः सु ते निर्ऋते तिग्मतेजोऽयस्मयं विचृता बन्धमेतम्। यमेन त्वं यम्या संविदानोत्तमे नाकेऽअधि रोहयैनम् ॥६३ ॥
translation: To thee, sharp-pointed Nirriti, full homage! Loose and detach this iron bond that binds him. Unanimous with Yama and with Yamî to the sublimest vault of heaven uplift him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्यास्ते घोरऽआसञ्जुहोम्येषां बन्धानामवसर्जनाय। यां त्वा जनो भूमिरिति प्रमन्दते निर्ऋतिं त्वाहं परि वेद विश्वतः ॥६४ ॥
translation: Thou, Awful One, thou in whose mouth I offer for the unloosing of these binding fetters, Whom people hail as Earth with their glad voices, as Nirriti in every place I know thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं ते देवी निर्ऋतिराबबन्ध पाशं ग्रीवास्वविचृत्यम्। तं ते विष्याम्यायुषो न मध्यादथैतं पितुमद्धि प्रसूतः। नमो भूत्यै येदं चकार ॥६५ ॥
translation: The binding noose which Nirriti the Goddess hath fastened on thy neck that none may loose it, I loose for thee as from the midst of Âyus. Sped forward now, eat thou the food we offer: To Fortune, her who hath done this, be homage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: निवेशनः सङ्गमनो वसूनां विश्वा रूपाभिचष्टे शचीभिः। देवऽइव सविता सत्यधर्मेन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे पथीनाम् ॥६६ ॥
translation: Establisher, the gatherer of treasures, he looks with might on every form and figure. Like Savitar the God whose laws are constant, like Indra, he hath stood where meet the pathways.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वितन्वते पृथक्। धीरा देवेषु सुम्नया ॥६७ ॥
translation: Wise, through desire of bliss with Gods, the skilful bind the traces fast, and lay the yokes on either side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनुध्वं कृते योनौ वपतेह बीजम्। गिरा च श्रुष्टिः सभरा असन्नो नेदीयऽइत्सृण्यः पक्वमेयात् ॥६८ ॥
translation: Lay on the yokes and fasten well the traces; formed is the furrow sow the seed within it. Through song may we find hearing fraught with plenty: near to the ripened grain approach the sickle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुनꣳ सु फाला वि कृषन्तु भूमिꣳ शुनं कीनाशाऽअभि यन्तु वाहैः। शुनासीरा हविषा तोशमाना सुपिप्पलाऽओषधीः कर्त्तनास्मे ॥६९ ॥
translation: Happily let the shares turn up the ploughland, happily go the ploughers with the oxen! Suna and Sîra, pleased with our oblation, cause ye our plants to bear abundant fruitage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घृतेन सीता मधुना समज्यतां विश्वैर्देवैरनुमता मरुद्भिः। ऊर्जस्वती पयसा पिन्वमानास्मान्त्सीते पयसाभ्या ववृत्स्व ॥७० ॥
translation: Approved by Visvedevas and by Maruts, balmed be the furrow with sweet-flavoured fatness. Succulent, teeming with thy milky treasure, turn hitherward to us with milk, O Furrow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: लाङ्गलं पवीरवत् सुशेवꣳ सोमपित्सरु। तदुद्वपति गामविं प्रफर्व्यं च पीवरीं प्रस्थावद् रथवाहणम् ॥७१ ॥
translation: The keen-shared plough that bringeth bliss, good for the Soma-drinker’s need, Shear out for me a cow, a sheep, a rapid drawer of the car, a blooming woman, plump and strong!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कामं कामदुघे धुक्ष्व मित्राय वरुणाय च। इन्द्रायाश्विभ्यां पूष्णे प्रजाभ्यऽओषधीभ्यः ॥७२ ॥
translation: Milk out their wish, O Wishing-Cow, to Mitra and to Varuna, To Indra, to the Asvins, to Pûshan, to people and to plants.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विमुच्यध्वमघ्न्या देवयानाऽअगन्म तमसस्पारमस्य। ज्योतिरापाम ॥७३ ॥
translation: Be loosed, inviolable, Godward-farers! We have attained the limit of this darkness: we have won the light. 46
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सजूरब्दोऽअयवोभिः सजूरुषाऽअरुणीभिः। सजोषसावश्विना दꣳसोभिः सजूः सूरऽएतशेन सजूर्वैश्वानरऽइडया घृतेन स्वाहा ॥७४ ॥
translation: The year together with the darksome fortnights; Dawn with the ruddy-coloured cows about her; the Asvins with their wonderful achievements; the Sun together with his dappled Courser; Vaisvânara with Idâ and with butter. Svâhâ!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या ओषधीः पूर्वा जाता देवेभ्यस्त्रियुगं पुरा। मनै नु बभ्रूणामहꣳ शतं धामानि सप्त च ॥७५ ॥
translation: Herbs that sprang up in time of old, three ages earlier than the Gods,— Of these, whose hue is brown, will I declare the hundred powers and seven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शतं वोऽअम्ब धामानि सहस्रमुत वो रुहः। अधा शतक्रत्वो यूयमिमं मेऽअगदं कृत ॥७६ ॥
translation: Ye, Mothers, have a hundred homes, yea, and a thousand are your growths. Do ye who have a thousand powers free this my patient from disease.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओषधीः प्रतिमोदध्वं पुष्पवतीः प्रसूवरीः। अश्वाऽइव सजित्वरीर्वीरुधः पारयिष्ण्वः ॥७७ ॥
translation: Be glad and joyful in the Plants, both blossoming and bearing fruit, Plants that will lead us to success like mares who conquer in the race.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओषधीरिति मातरस्तद्वो देवीरुप ब्रुवे। सनेयमश्वं गां वासऽआत्मानं तव पूरुष ॥७८ ॥
translation: Plants, by this name I speak to you, Mothers, to you the Goddesses: Steed, cow, and garment may I win, win back thy very self, O man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वत्थे वो निषदनं पर्णे वो वसतिष्कृता। गोभाजऽइत् किलासथ यत् सनवथ पूरुषम् ॥७९ ॥
translation: The Holy Fig tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna tree: Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्रौषधीः समग्मत राजानः समिताविव। विप्रः सऽउच्यते भिषग् रक्षोहामीवचातनः ॥८० ॥
translation: He who hath store of Herbs at hand like Kings amid a crowd of men,— Physician is that sage’s name, fiend-slayer, chaser of disease.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वावती सोमावतीमूर्जयन्तीमुदोजसम्। आवित्सि सर्वाऽओषधीरस्माऽअरिष्टतातये ॥८१ ॥
translation: Herbs rich in Soma, rich in steeds, in nourishment in strengthening power, All these have I provided here, that this man may be whole again.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उच्छुष्मा ओषधीनां गावो गोष्ठादिवेरते। धनꣳ सनिष्यन्तीनामात्मानं तव पूरुष ॥८२ ॥
translation: The healing virtues of the Plants stream forth like cattle from the stall,— Plants that shall win me store of wealth, and save thy vital breath, O man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इष्कृतिर्नाम वो माताथो यूयꣳ स्थ निष्कृतीः। सीराः पतत्रिणी स्थन यदामयति निष्कृथ ॥८३ ॥
translation: Reliever is your mother’s name, and hence Restorers are ye called. Rivers are ye with wings that fly: keep far whatever brings disease.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अति विश्वाः परिष्ठा स्तेनऽइव व्रजमक्रमुः। ओषधीः प्राचुच्यवुर्यत्किं च तन्वो रपः ॥८४ ॥
translation: Over all fences have they passed, as steals a thief into the fold. The Plants have driven from the frame whatever malady was there.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिमा वाजयन्नहमोषधीर्हस्तऽआदधे। आत्मा यक्ष्मस्य नश्यति पुरा जीवगृभो यथा ॥८५ ॥
translation: When, bringing back the vanished strength, I hold these herbs within my hand, The spirit of disease departs ere he can seize upon the life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्यौषधीः प्रसर्पथाङ्गमङ्गं परुष्परुः। ततो यक्ष्मं विबाधध्वऽउग्रो मध्यमशीरिव ॥८६ ॥
translation: He through whose frame, O Plants, ye creep member by member, joint by joint, From him ye drive away disease like some strong arbiter of strife.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: साकं यक्ष्म प्रपत चाषेण किकिदीविना। साकं वातस्य ध्राज्या साकं नश्य निहाकया ॥८७ ॥
translation: Fly, Spirit of Disease, begone, with the blue jay and kingfisher. Fly, with the wind’s impetuous speed, vanish together with the storm.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्या वोऽअन्यामवत्वन्यान्यस्याऽउपावत। ताः सर्वाः संविदानाऽइदं मे प्रावता वचः ॥८८ ॥
translation: Help every one the other, lend assistance each of you to each, All of you be accordant, give furtherance to this speech of mine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याः फलिनीर्याऽअफलाऽअपुष्पा याश्च पुष्पिणीः। बृहस्पतिप्रसूतास्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वꣳहसः ॥८९ ॥
translation: Let fruitful Plants, and fruitless, those that blossom, and the blossomless, Urged onward by Brihaspati, release us from our pain and grief;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्यादथो वरुण्यादुत। अथो यमस्य पड्वीशात् सर्वस्माद् देवकिल्विषात् ॥९० ॥
translation: Release me from the curse’s plague and woe that comes from Varuna; Free me from Yama’s fetter, from sin and offence against the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवपतन्तीरवदन् दिवऽओषधयस्परि। यं जीवमश्नवामहै न स रिष्याति पूरुषः ॥९१ ॥
translation: What time, descending from the sky, the Plants flew earthward, thus they spake: No evil shall befall the man whom while he liveth we pervade.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याऽओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्बह्वीः शतविचक्षणाः। तासामसि त्वमुत्तमारं कामाय शꣳ हृदे ॥९२ ॥
translation: Of all the many Plants whose King is Soma, Plants of hundred forms, Thou art the Plant most excellent, prompt to the wish, sweet to the heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याऽओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्विष्ठिताः पृथिवीमनु। बृहस्पतिप्रसूताऽअस्यै संदत्त वीर्य्यम् ॥९३ ॥
translation: O all ye various Herbs whose King is Soma, that o’erspread the earth, Urged onward by Brihaspati, combine your virtue in this Plant. 47
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याश्चेदमुपशृण्वन्ति याश्च दूरं परागताः। सर्वाः संगत्य वीरुधोऽस्यै संदत्त वीर्य्यम् ॥९४ ॥
translation: All Plants that hear this speech, and those that have departed far away, Come all assembled and confer your healing power upon this Herb.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा वो रिषत् खनिता यस्मै चाहं खनामि वः। द्विपाच्चतुष्पादस्माकꣳ सर्वमस्त्वनातुरम् ॥९५ ॥
translation: Unharmed be he who digs you up, unharmed the man for whom I dig: And let no malady attack biped or quadruped of ours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओषधयः समवदन्त सोमेन सह राज्ञा। यस्मै कृणोति ब्राह्मणस्तꣳ राजन् पारयामसि ॥९६ ॥
translation: With Soma as their Sovran Lord the Plants hold colloquy and say: O King, we save from death the man whose cure a Brâhman undertakes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाशयित्री बलासस्यार्शसऽउपचितामसि। अथो शतस्य यक्ष्माणां पाकारोरसि नाशनी ॥९७ ॥
translation: Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant: thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां गन्धर्वाऽअखनँस्त्वामिन्द्रस्त्वां बृहस्पतिः। त्वामोषधे सोमो राजा विद्वान् यक्ष्मादमुच्यत ॥९८ ॥
translation: Banisher of catarrh art thou, of tumours and of hemorrhoids; Thou banished Pâkâru and Consumption in a hundred forms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहस्व मेऽअरातीः सहस्व पृतनायतः। सहस्व सर्वं पाप्मानꣳ सहमानास्योषधे ॥९९ ॥
translation: Thee did Gandharvas dig from earth, thee Indra and Brihaspati. King Soma, knowing thee, O Plant, from his Consumption was made free.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दीर्घायुस्तऽओषधे खनिता यस्मै च त्वा खनाम्यहम्। अथो त्वं दीर्घायुर्भूत्वा शतवल्शा विरोहतात् ॥१०० ॥
translation: Conquer mine enemies, the men who challenge me do thou subdue. Conquer thou all unhappiness: victorious art thou, O Plant.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमुत्तमास्योषधे तव वृक्षाऽउपस्तयः। उपस्तिरस्तु सोऽस्माकं योऽअस्माँ२ऽ अभिदासति ॥१०१
translation: Long-lived be he who digs thee, Plant, and he for whom I dig thee up. So mayst thou also, grown long-lived, rise upward with a hundred shoots.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा मा हिꣳसीज्जनिता यः पृथिव्या यो वा दिवꣳ सत्यधर्मा व्यानट्। यश्चापश्चन्द्राः प्रथमो जजान कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥१०२ ॥
translation: Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant; thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यावर्त्तस्व पृथिवि यज्ञेन पयसा सह। वपां तेऽअग्निरिषितोऽअरोहत् ॥१०३ ॥
translation: May he not harm me who is earth’s begetter, nor he whose laws are faithful, sky’s pervades; Nor he who first begot the lucid waters. To Ka the God let us present oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने यत्ते शुक्रं यच्चन्द्रं यत्पूतं यच्च यज्ञियम्। तद्देवेभ्यो भरामसि ॥१०४ ॥
translation: Turn thyself hitherward, O Earth, to us with sacrifice and milk. Thy covering skin Agni, urged forth, hath mounted.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषमूर्जमहमितऽआदमृतस्य योनिं महिषस्य धाराम्। आ मा गोषु विशत्वा तनुषु जहामि सेदिमनिराममीवाम् ॥१०५ ॥
translation: All, Agni, that in thee is bright, pure, cleansed, and meet for sacrifice, That do we bring unto the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्तेऽअर्चयो विभावसो। बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्यं दधासि दाशुषे कवे ॥१०६ ॥
translation: I from this place have fed on strength and vigour, the womb of holy Law, stream of the mighty. In cows let it possess me and in bodies. I quit decline and lack of food, and sickness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चाऽअनूनवर्चाऽउदियर्षि भानुना। पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसीऽउभे ॥१०७ ॥
translation: Agni, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः। त्वेऽइषः संदधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः ॥१०८ ॥
translation: With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इरज्यन्नग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायोऽअमर्त्य। स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि सानसिं क्रतुम् ॥१०९ ॥
translation: O Jâtavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs. In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इष्कर्त्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तꣳ राधसो महः। रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिꣳ रयिम् ॥११० ॥
translation: Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God. Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निꣳ सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः। श्रुत्कर्णꣳ सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा ॥१११ ॥
translation: To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control, Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आप्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम्। भवा वाजस्य सङ्गथे ॥११२ ॥
translation: The men have set before them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy. Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men’s generations magnify with praise- songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं ते पयासि समु यन्तु वाजाः सं वृष्ण्यान्यभिमातिषाहः। आप्यायमानोऽअमृताय सोम दिवि श्रवास्युत्तमानि धिष्व ॥११३ ॥
translation: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee. Be in the gathering-place of strength. 48
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आप्यायस्व मदिन्तम सोम विश्वेभिरꣳशुभिः। भवा नः सप्रथस्तमः सखा वृधे ॥११४ ॥
translation: In thee be juicy nutriments united, and power and mighty foe-subduing vigour. Waxing to immortality, O Soma, win highest glory for thyself in heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत् परमाच्चित् सधस्थात्। अग्ने त्वाङ्कामया गिरा ॥११५ ॥
translation: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy filaments, and be A friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्यं ताऽअङ्गिरस्तम विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक्। अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥११६ ॥
translation: May Vatsa draw thy mind away, even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निः प्रियेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य। सम्राडेको विराजति ॥११७ ॥
translation: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes Apart have turned to gain their wish.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मयि गृह्णाम्यग्रे अग्निꣳ रायस्पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्याय। मामु देवताः सचन्ताम् ॥१ ॥
translation: I TAKE within me Agni first, for increase of my wealth, good offspring, manly strength: So may the Deities wait on me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपां पृष्ठमसि योनिरग्नेः समुद्रमभितः पिन्वमानम्। वर्धमानो महाँ२ऽआ च पुष्करे दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथस्व ॥२ ॥
translation: Thou art the waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread forth in amplitude with heaven’s own measure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेनऽआवः। स बुध्न्याऽ उपमाऽ अस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च वि वः ॥३ ॥
translation: Eastward at first was Brahma generated. Vena o’erspread the bright Ones from the summit, Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of existent and of non-existent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्त्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेकऽ आसीत्। स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥४ ॥
translation: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created being. He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. Worship we Ka the God with our oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द पृथिवीमनु द्यामिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः। समानं योनिमनु संचरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः ॥५ ॥
translation: The Drop leaped onward through the earth and heaven, along this place and that which was before it. I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop still moving to the common dwelling.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु सर्पेभ्यो ये के च पृथिवीमनु। येऽ अन्तरिक्षे ये दिवि तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो नमः ॥६ ॥
translation: Homage be paid to Serpents unto all of them that are on earth, To those that dwell in air, to those that dwell in sky be homage paid.
