translation: Most bounteous, most auspicious, be auspicious, well inclined to us. On some remotest tree lay down thy weapon. and clad in robe of skin approach, bearing thy bow come hitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विकिरिद्र विलोहित नमस्तेऽअस्तु भगवः। यास्ते सहस्रꣳ हेतयोऽन्यमस्मन्नि वपन्तु ताः ॥५२ ॥
translation: O Wound averter, purple-hued, to thee be homage, holy Lord! May all those thousand darts of thine strike dead another one than us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहस्राणि सहस्रशो बाह्वोस्तव हेतयः। तासामीशानो भगवः पराचीना मुखा कृधि ॥५३ ॥
translation: Thousands of thousands are the shafts, the missiles ready in thy hands: Thou holy Lord, who hast the power, turn thou their points away from us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असंख्याता सहस्राणि ये रुद्राऽअधि भूम्याम्। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥५४ ॥
translation: Innumerable thousands are the Rudras on the face of earth: Of all these Rudras we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मिन् महत्यर्णवेऽन्तरिक्षे भवाऽअधि। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥५५ ॥
translation: Bhavas there are above us in this mighty billowy sea of air, Of all of these do we unbend, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नीलग्रीवाः शितिकण्ठा दिवꣳरुद्राऽउपश्रिताः। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥५६ ॥
translation: Rudras are dwelling in the sky, whose necks are blue, whose throats are white: Of these do we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away from us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नीलग्रीवाः शितिकण्ठाः शर्वाऽअधः क्षमाचराः। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥५७ ॥
translation: Sarvas haunt realms beneath the earth—their necks are blue, their throats are white: Of these, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये वृक्षेषु शष्पिञ्जरा नीलग्रीवा विलोहिताः। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥५८ ॥
translation: These, green like young grass, in the trees, with azure necks and purple hue, Of those, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये भूतानामधिपतयो विशिखासः कपर्दिनः। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥५९ ॥
translation: Those, ministering spirits’ lords, with no hair-tufts, with braided locks, Of these, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये पथां पथिरक्षयऽऐलबृदाऽआयुर्युधः। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥६० ॥
translation: Those, the protectors of the paths, bringers of food, who fight for life. Of these, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये तीर्थानि प्रचरन्ति सृकाहस्ता निषङ्गिणः। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥६१ ॥
translation: Those who with arrows in their hand, and armed with words, frequent the fords, Of these, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येऽन्नेषु विविध्यन्ति पात्रेषु पिबतो जनान्। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥६२ ॥
translation: Those who, inhabiting the food, vex men while drinking from their cups, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यऽएतावन्तश्च भूयासश्च दिशो रुद्रा वितस्थिरे। तेषा सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ॥६३ ॥
translation: Rudras so many and still more, lodged in the quarters of the sky, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये दिवि येषां वर्षमिषवः। तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर्दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर्दशोदीचीर्दशोर्ध्वाः। तेभ्यो नमोऽअस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः ॥६४ ॥
translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is sky, whose arrows floods of rain. To them ten eastward, southward ten, ten to the south, ten to the north, ten to the region uppermost! To them be homage! May they spare and guard us. Within their jaws we lay the man who hates us and whom we abhor. 65
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो येऽन्तरिक्षे येषां वातऽइषवः। तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर्दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर्दशोदीचीर्दशोर्ध्वाः। तेभ्यो नमोऽअस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः ॥६५ ॥
translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is air, whose arrows is the rain. To them, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये पृथिव्यां येषामन्नमिषवः। तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर्दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर्दशोदीचीर्दशोर्ध्वाः। तेभ्यो नमोऽअस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः ॥६६ ॥
translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is earth, whose arrows is men’s food. To them be homage, etc. 66
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्मन्नूर्जं पर्वते शिश्रियाणामद्भ्यऽओषधीभ्यो वनस्पतिभ्योऽअधि सम्भृतं पयः। तां नऽइषमूर्जं धत्त मरुतः सꣳरराणाऽअश्मꣳस्ते क्षुन् मयि तऽऊर्ग्यं द्विष्मस्तं ते शुगृच्छतु ॥१ ॥
translation: THE food and strength contained in stone and mountain, drink gathered from the plants and trees and waters, That food and strength, Maruts! free-givers, grant us. In the stone is thy hunger. In me is thy food. Let thy pain reach the man we hate.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा मेऽअग्नऽइष्टका धेनवः सन्त्वेका च दश च दश च शतं च शतं च सहस्रं च सहस्रं चायुतं चायुतं च नियुतं च नियुतं च प्रयुतं चार्बुदं च न्यर्बुदं च समुद्रश्च मध्यं चान्तश्च परार्द्धश्चैता मेऽअग्नऽइष्टका धेनवः सन्त्वमुत्रामुष्मिँल्लोके ॥२ ॥
translation: O Agni, may these bricks be mine own milch kine: one, and ten, and ten tens, a hundred, and ten hundreds, a thousand, and ten thousand a myriad, and a hundred thousand, and a million, and a hundred millions, and an ocean middle and end, and a hundred thousand millions, and a billion. May these bricks be mine own milch-kine in yonder world and in this world.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतव स्थऽऋतावृधऽऋतुष्ठा स्थऽऋतावृधः। घृतश्च्युतो मधुश्च्युतो विराजो नाम कामदुघाऽअक्षीयमाणाः ॥३ ॥
translation: Ye are the Seasons, strengthening Law, fixed in due season, strengthening Law, Called Splendid, dropping butter down and honey, yielders of every wish, imperishable.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रस्य त्वावकयाग्ने परिव्ययामसि। पावकोऽअस्मभ्यꣳ शिवो भव ॥४ ॥
translation: With the lake’s mantling need we robe thee, Agni: to us he purifying and auspicious.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिमस्य त्वा जरायुणाग्ने परिव्ययामसि। पावकोऽअस्मभ्यꣳ शिवो भव ॥५ ॥
translation: With cold’s investing garb we gird thee, Agni: to us be purifying and auspicious.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप ज्मन्नुप वेतसेऽवतर नदीष्वा। अग्ने पित्तमपामसि मण्डूकि ताभिरागहि सेमं नो यज्ञं पावकवर्णꣳ शिवं कृधि ॥६ ॥
translation: Descend upon the earth, the reed, the rivers: thou art the gall, O Agni, of the waters. With them come hither, female Frog, and render this sacrifice of ours bright-hued, successful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपामिदं न्ययनꣳ समुद्रस्य निवेशनम्। अन्याँस्तेऽअस्मत्तपन्तु हेतयः पावकोऽअस्मभ्यꣳ शिवो भव ॥७ ॥
translation: This is the place where waters meet; here is the gathering of the flood. Let thy shaft burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया। आ देवान् वक्षि यक्षि च ॥८ ॥
translation: O Agni, purifier, God, with splendour and thy pleasant tongue Bring hither, and adore, the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पावक दीदिवोऽग्ने देवाँ२ऽइहा वह। उप यज्ञꣳ हविश्च नः ॥९ ॥
translation: So, Agni, purifying, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावकया यश्चितयन्त्या कृपा क्षामन् रुरुचऽउषसो न भानुना। तूर्वन् न यामन्नेतशस्य नू रणऽआ यो घृणे न ततृषाणोऽअजरः ॥१० ॥
translation: He who with purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon the earth as with the light of Dawn; Who speeding on, as in the fleet steed’s race, in fight, cometh untouched by age, as one athirst in heat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमस्ते हरसे शोचिषे नमस्तेऽअस्त्वर्चिषे। अन्याँस्ते अस्मत्तपन्तु हेतयः पावकोऽअस्मभ्यꣳ शिवो भव ॥११ ॥
translation: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow! Obeisance to thy fiery flame! Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नृषदे वेडप्सुषदे वेड् बर्हिषदे वेड् वनसदे वेट् स्वर्विदे वेट् ॥१२ ॥
translation: To him who dwells in man, Hail! To him who dwells in waters, Hail! To him who dwells in sacred grass, Hail! To him who dwells in the wood, Hail! To him who finds the light, Hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये देवा देवानां यज्ञिया यज्ञियाना संवत्सरीणमुप भागमासते। अहुतादो हविषो यज्ञेऽअस्मिन्त्स्वयं पिबन्तु मधुनो घृतस्य ॥१३ ॥
translation: Worshipful Gods of Gods who merit worship, those who sit down beside their yearly portion, Let them who eat not sacrificial presents drink in this rite of honey and of butter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये देवा देवेष्वधि देवत्वमायन् ये ब्रह्मणः पुरऽएतारोऽअस्य। येभ्यो नऽऋते पवते धाम किञ्चन न ते दिवो न पृथिव्याऽअधि स्नुषु ॥१४ ॥
translation: Those Gods who have attained to Godhead over Gods, they who have led the way in this our holy work, Without whose aid no body whatsoever moves, not on heaven’s heights are they, nor on the face of earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राणदाऽअपानदा व्यानदा वर्चोदा वरिवोदाः। अन्याँस्तेऽअस्मत्तपन्तु हेतयः पावकोऽअस्मभ्यꣳ शिवो भव ॥१५ ॥
translation: Giver of breath, of out-breath, breath diffusive, giver of lustre, giving room and freedom, Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यासद्विश्वं न्यत्रिणम्। अग्निर्नो वनते रयिम् ॥१६ ॥
translation: May Agni with his sharpened blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend. May Agni win us wealth by war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यऽइमा विश्वा भुवनानि जुह्वदृषिर्होता न्यसीदत् पिता नः। सऽआशिषा द्रविणमिच्छमानः प्रथमच्छदवराँ२ऽआविवेश ॥१७ ॥
translation: He who sate down as Hotar priest, the Rishi, our Father offering, up all things existent He, seeking with his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal. 67
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: किस्विदासीदधिष्ठानमारम्भणं कतमत् स्वित् कथासीत्। यतो भूमिं जनयन् विश्वकर्मा वि द्यामौर्णोन्महिना विश्वचक्षाः ॥१८ ॥
translation: What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that upheld him? What the manner, Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed the heavens?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वतश्चक्षुरुत विश्वतोमुखो विश्वतोबाहुरुत विश्वतस्पात्। सं बाहुभ्यां धमति सं पतत्रैर्द्यावाभूमी जनयन् देवऽएकः ॥१९ ॥
translation: He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on all sides, arms and feet on all sides, He the sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them with his arms as wings together.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: किस्विद्वनं कऽउ स वृक्षऽआस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः। मनीषिणो मनसा पृच्छतेदु तद्यदध्यतिष्ठद् भुवनानि धारयन् ॥२० ॥
translation: What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven? Ye thoughtful men, inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या ते धामानि परमाणि याऽवमा या मध्यमा विश्वकर्मन्नुतेमा। शिक्षा सखिभ्यो हविषि स्वधावः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वं वृधानः ॥२१ ॥
translation: Thine highest, lowest sacrificial natures, and these thy midmost here, O Visvakarman, Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessèd, and come thy- self, exalted, to our worship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वकर्मन् हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व पृथिवीमुत द्याम्। मुह्यन्त्वन्येऽअभितः सपत्नाऽइहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु ॥२२ ॥
translation: Bring those, thyself exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman, Earth and Heaven to worship. Let enemies around us live in folly: here let us have a rich and liberal patron. 23, 24. = VIII. 45, 46.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चक्षुषः पिता मनसा हि धीरो घृतमेनेऽअजनन्नम्नमाने। यदेदन्ताऽअददृहन्त पूर्वऽआदिद् द्यावापृथिवीऽअप्रथेताम् ॥२५ ॥
translation: The Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness. Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far extended.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वकर्म्मा विमनाऽआद्विहाया धाता विधाता परमोत सन्दृक्। तेषामिष्टानि समिषा मदन्ति यत्रा सप्तऽऋषीन् परऽएकमाहुः ॥२६ ॥
translation: Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence. Their offerings joy in rich juice where they value One, only One beyond the Seven Rishis.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो नः पिता जनिता यो विधाता धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा। यो देवानां नामधाऽएकऽएव तꣳ सम्प्रश्नं भुवना यन्त्यन्या ॥२७ ॥
translation: Father who made us, he who, as Disposer, knoweth all races and all things existing, Even he alone, the Deities’ name-giver,—him other beings seek for information.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तऽआयजन्त द्रविणꣳ समस्माऽऋषयः पूर्वे जरितारो न भूना। असूर्त्ते सूर्त्ते रजसि निषत्ते ये भूतानि समकृण्वन्निमानि ॥२८ ॥
translation: To him in sacrifice they offered treasures,—Rishis of old, in numerous troops, as singers, Who, in the distant, near, and lower region, made ready all these things that have existence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परो दिवा परऽएना पृथिव्या परो देवेभिरसुरैर्यदस्ति। कꣳस्विद् गर्भं प्रथमं दध्रऽआपो यत्र देवाः समपश्यन्त पूर्वे ॥२९ ॥
translation: That which is earlier than this earth and heaven, before the Asuras and Gods had being, What was the germ primeval which the waters received where the first Gods beheld each other?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिद् गर्भं प्रथमं दध्रऽआपो यत्र देवाः समगच्छन्त विश्वे। अजस्य नाभावध्येकमर्पितं यस्मिन् विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुः ॥३० ॥
translation: The waters, they received that germ primeval wherein the Gods were gathered all together. It rested set upon the Unborn’s navel, that One wherein abide all things existing.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न तं विदाथ यऽइमा जजानान्यद्युष्माकमन्तरं बभूव। नीहारेण प्रावृता जल्प्या चासुतृपऽउक्थशासश्चरन्ति ॥३१ ॥
translation: Ye will not find him who produced these creatures: another thing hath risen up among you. Enwrapt in misty cloud, with lips that stammer, hymn-chanters wander and are discontented.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वकर्मा ह्यजनिष्ट देवऽआदिद् गन्धर्वोऽअभवद् द्वितीयः। तृतीयः पिता जनितौषधीनामपां गर्भं व्यदधात् पुरुत्रा ॥३२ ॥
translation: First was the God engendered, Visvakarman: then the Gandharva sprang to life as second. Third in succession was the plants’ begetter: he laid the waters’ germ in many places.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम्। संक्रन्दनोऽनिमिषऽएकवीरः शतꣳ सेनाऽअजयत् साकमिन्द्रः ॥३३ ॥
translation: Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people, With eyes that close not, bellowing, Sole Hero, Indra subdued at once a hundred armies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: संक्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना। तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा ॥३४ ॥
translation: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, Victor, bold, hard to overthrow, Rouser of battle, Indra the Strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye warriors, now, now vanquish in the combat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सऽइषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी सꣳस्रष्टा स युधऽइन्द्रो गणेन। सꣳसृष्टजित् सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्युग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता ॥३५ ॥
translation: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band brings hosts together, Foe-conquering, strong of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्राँ२ऽ अपबाधमानः। प्रभञ्जन्त्सेनाः प्रमृणो युधा जयन्नस्माकमेद्ध्यविता रथानाम् ॥३६ ॥
translation: Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen. Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies. 68
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बलविज्ञायः स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान् वाजी सहमानऽउग्रः। अभिवीरोऽअभिसत्वा सहोजा जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमातिष्ठ गोवित् ॥३७ ॥
translation: Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all- subduing, The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kine-winner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोत्रभिदं गोविदं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा। इमꣳ सजाताऽअनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्रꣳ सखायोऽअनु सꣳरभध्वम् ॥३८ ॥
translation: Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it, Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदयो वीरः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः। दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाडयुध्योऽअस्माकꣳ सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु ॥३९ ॥
translation: Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra, the pitiless Hero, wild with anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless,—may he protect our armies in our battles.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रऽआसां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुरऽएतु सोमः। देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्रम् ॥४० ॥
translation: Indra guide these: Brihaspati precede them, the guerdon, and the sacrifice, and Soma; And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञऽआदित्यानां मरुता शर्द्धऽउग्रम्। महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात् ॥४१ ॥
translation: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna, and Maruts, and Âdityas. Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, high-minded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुधान्युत्सत्वनां मामकानां मनासि। उद् वृत्रहन् वाजिनां वाजिनान्युद्रथानां जयतां यन्तु घोषाः ॥४२ ॥
translation: Bristle thou up, O Bounteous Lord, our weapons: excite the spirits of my warring heroes. Urge on the strong steeds’ might, O Vritra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं याऽइषवस्ता जयन्तु। अस्माकं वीराऽउत्तरे भवन्त्वस्माँ२ऽउ देवाऽअवता हवेषु ॥४३ ॥
translation: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be the arrows of our army. May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods protect us in the shout of onset.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमीषां चित्तं प्रतिलोभयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि। अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैरन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्ताम् ॥४४ ॥
translation: Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies and depart, O Apvâ. Attack them, set their hearts on fire and burn them: so let our foes abide in utter darkness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवसृष्टा परा पत शरव्ये ब्रह्मसꣳशिते। गच्छामित्रान् प्र पद्यस्व मामीषां कञ्चनोच्छिषः ॥४५ ॥
translation: Loosed from the bowstring fly awry, O Arrow, sharpened by our prayer. Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one of them escape.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेता जयता नरऽइन्द्रो वः शर्म यच्छतु। उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवोऽनाधृष्या यथासथ ॥४६ ॥
translation: Advance, O heroes, win the day. May Indra be your sure defence. Exceeding mighty be your arms, that none may wound or injure you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असौ या सेना मरुतः परेषामभ्यैति नऽओजसा स्पर्द्धमाना। तां गूहत तमसापव्रतेन यथामीऽअन्योऽअन्यन्न जानन् ॥४७ ॥
translation: That army of our enemies, O Maruts, that comes against us with its might, contending, Meet ye and wrap it in unwelcome darkness so that not one of them may know another.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्र बाणाः सम्पतन्ति कुमारा विशिखाऽइव। तन्नऽइन्द्रो बृहस्पतिरदितिः शर्म यच्छतु विश्वाहा शर्म यच्छतु ॥४८ ॥
translation: There where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn, May Indra, may Brihaspati, may Aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मर्माणि ते वर्मणा छादयामि सोमस्त्वा राजामृतेनानु वस्ताम्। उरोर्वरीयो वरुणस्ते कृणोतु जयन्तं त्वानु देवा मदन्तु ॥४९ ॥
translation: Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee. Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy triumph may the Gods be joyful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदेनमुत्तरां नयाग्ने घृतेनाहुत। रायस्पोषेण सꣳसृज प्रजया च बहुं कृधि ॥५० ॥
translation: Worshipped with butter, Agni, lead this man to high preeminence. Vouchsafe him growth of riches and multiply him with progeny.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रेमं प्रतरां नय सजातानामसद्वशी। समेनं वर्चसा सृज देवानां भागदाऽअसत् ॥५१ ॥
translation: Indra, lead him to eminence: controller of his foes be he. Vouchsafe him lustre: let him give their sacred portions to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य कुर्मो गृहे हविस्तमग्ने वर्द्धया त्वम्। तस्मै देवाऽअधिब्रुवन्नयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥५२ ॥
translation: The man within whose house we pay oblation, Indra, prosper him. May the Gods bless and comfort him, they and this Brahmanaspati.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु त्वा विश्वे देवाऽअग्ने भरन्तु चित्तिभिः। स नो भव शिवस्त्वꣳ सुप्रतीको विभावसुः ॥५३ ॥
translation: May the All-Gods, O Agni, bear and lift thee upward with their thoughts. Fair to be looked on, rich in light, he thou propitious unto us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पञ्च दिशो दैवीर्यज्ञमवन्तु देवीरपामतिं दुर्मतिं बाधमानाः। रायस्पोषे यज्ञपतिमाभजन्ती रायस्पोषेऽअधि यज्ञोऽअस्थात् ॥५४ ॥
translation: May the Five Regions guard, divine, our worship, Goddesses chasing lack of thought and hatred, Giving the Sacrificer growth of riches. Let sacrifice be based on growth of riches.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिद्धेऽअग्नावधि मामहानऽउक्थपत्रऽईड्यो गृभीतः। तप्तं घर्म्मं परिगृह्यायजन्तोर्जा यद्यज्ञमयजन्त देवाः ॥५५ ॥
translation: Inspirited above enkindled Agni, adorable, winged with hymns, was it accepted, When the Gods offered sacrifice with viands, circling the heated caldron, paving worship. 69
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दैव्याय धर्त्रे जोष्ट्रे देवश्रीः श्रीमनाः शतपयाः। परिगृह्य देवा यज्ञमायन् देवा देवेभ्योऽअध्वर्यन्तोऽअस्थुः ॥५६ ॥
translation: Lord of a hundred draughts. benign, God-serving—to him divine, establisher, protector, The Gods approached the sacrifice, encircling. Gods for the Gods stood fain for sacred service.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वीतꣳ हविः शमितꣳ शमिता यजध्यै तुरीयो यज्ञो यत्र हव्यमेति। ततो वाकाऽआशिषो नो जुषन्ताम् ॥५७ ॥
translation: When the fourth sacrifice reaches the oblation, accepted offering which hath been made ready, fit for the Inmolator’s sacrificing, Thence bless us prayers and holy recitations!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सूर्यरश्मिर्हरिकेशः पुरस्तात् सविता ज्योतिरुदयाँ२ऽअजस्रम्। तस्य पूषा प्रसवे याति विद्वान्त्सम्पश्यन् विश्वा भुवनानि गोपाः ॥५८ ॥
translation: Savitar, golden-hued, hath lifted eastward, bright with the sunbeams, his eternal lustre, He at whose furtherance wise Pûshan marches surveying all existence like a herdsman.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विमानऽएष दिवो मध्यऽआस्तऽआपप्रिवान् रोदसीऽअन्तरिक्षम्। स विश्वाचीरभिचष्टे घृताचीरन्तरा पूर्वमपरं च केतुम् ॥५९ ॥
translation: He sits, the measurer, in the midst of heaven, filling the two world-halves and air’s mid- region. He looks upon the rich far-spreading pastures between the eastern and the western limit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्षा समुद्रोऽअरुणः सुपर्णः पूर्वस्य योनिं पितुराविवेश। मध्ये दिवो निहितः पृश्निरश्मा वि चक्रमे रजसस्पात्यन्तौ ॥६० ॥
translation: Steer, Sea, Red Bird with strong wings, he hath entered the dwelling-place of the Primeval Father. A gay-hued Stone set in the midst of heaven, he hath gone forth and guards the air’s two limits.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वाऽअवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः। रथीतमꣳ रथीनां वाजाना सत्पतिं पतिम् ॥६१ ॥
translation: All sacred songs have glorified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the Very Lord of strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवहूर्यज्ञऽआ च वक्षत् सुम्नहूर्यज्ञऽआ च वक्षत्। यक्षदग्निर्देवो देवाँ२ऽआ च वक्षत् ॥६२ ॥
translation: May God-invoking sacrifice bring the Gods hitherward to us. May bless-invoking sacrifice bring the Gods hitherward to us. May Agni, God, make offering and hither bring the Gods to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजस्य मा प्रसवऽउद्ग्राभेणोदग्रभीत्। अधा सपत्नानिन्द्रो मे निग्राभेणाधराँ२ऽअकः ॥६३ ॥
translation: May the abundant growth of wealth with elevation lift me up, And with his subjugating power may Indra keep my foemen down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्ग्राभं च निग्राभं च ब्रह्म देवाऽअवीवृधन्। अधा सपत्नानिन्द्राग्नी मे विषूचीनान् व्यस्यताम् ॥६४ ॥
translation: Upraising and depression and devotion may the Gods increase. May Indra, too, and Agni drive my foes away to every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्रमध्वमग्निना नाकमुख्यꣳ हस्तेषु बिभ्रतः। दिवस्पृष्ठ स्वर्गत्वा मिश्रा देवेभिराध्वम् ॥६५ ॥
translation: Go ye by Agni to the sky bearing the Ukhya in your hands. Reaching the heights of sky and heaven stay intermingled with the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं प्रेहि विद्वानग्नेरग्ने पुरोऽअग्निर्भवेह। विश्वाऽआशा दीद्यानो वि भाह्यूर्जं नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ॥६६ ॥
translation: Agni, go forward to the eastern region, well-skilled, be here the fire in front of Agni. Illuming all the quarters, shine with splendour: supply with food our quadrupeds and bipeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पृथिव्याऽअहमुदन्तरिक्षमारुहमन्तरिक्षाद् दिवमारुहम्। दिवो नाकस्य पृष्ठात् स्वर्ज्योतिरगामहम् ॥६७ ॥
translation: From earth to air’s mid-region have I mounted, and from mid-air ascended up to heaven. From the high pitch of heaven’s cope I came into the world of light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वर्यन्तो नापेक्षन्तऽआ द्या रोहन्ति रोदसी। यज्ञं ये विश्वतोधारꣳ सुविद्वासो वितेनिरे ॥६८ ॥
translation: Mounting the sky they look not round: they rise to heaven through both the worlds— Sages who span the sacrifice that pours its stream on every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने प्रेहि प्रथमो देवयतां चक्षुर्देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम्। इयक्षमाणा भृगुभिः सजोषाः स्वर्य्यन्तु यजमानाः स्वस्ति ॥६९ ॥
translation: Foremost of those who seek the Gods come forward, thou who art eye of Gods and men, O Agni. Accordant with the Bhrigus, fain to worship, to heaven in safety go the Sacrificers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे धापयेते शिशुमेकꣳ समीची। द्यावाक्षामा रुक्मोऽअन्तर्विभाति देवाऽअग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाः ॥७० ॥
translation: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, etc., as in XII. 2.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने सहस्राक्ष शतमूर्द्धञ्छतं ते प्राणाः सहस्रं व्यानाः। त्वꣳ साहस्रस्य रायऽईशिषे तस्मै ते विधेम वाजाय स्वाहा ॥७१ ॥
translation: O Agni, thousand-eyed and hundred-headed, thy breaths are hundred, thy through-breaths a thousand. Thou art the Lord of thousandfold possessions. To thee; for strength, may we present oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुपर्णोऽसि गरुत्मान् पृष्ठे पृथिव्याः सीद। भासान्तरिक्षमापृण ज्योतिषा दिवमुत्तभान तेजसा दिशऽउद्दृꣳह ॥७२ ॥
translation: Thou art the Bird of goodly wing: be seated on the ridge of earth. Fill air’s mid-region with thy glow, supporting with thy light the sky, confirm the quarters with thy sheen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आजुह्वानः सुप्रतीकः पुरस्तादग्ने स्वं योनिमासीद साधुया। अस्मिन्त्सधस्थेऽअध्युत्तरस्मिन् विश्वे देवा यजमानश्च सीदत ॥७३ ॥
translation: Receiving offerings, fair of aspect, eastward be duly seated in thy place, O Agni. In this the more exalted habitation be seated All-Gods and the Sacrificer. 70
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता सवितुर्वरेण्यस्य चित्रामाहं वृणे सुमतिं विश्वजन्याम्। यामस्य कण्वो अदुहत् प्रपीना सहस्रधारां पयसा महीं गाम् ॥७४ ॥
translation: That wondrous all-mankind-embracing favour of Savitar, choice-worthy, I solicit, Even his which Kanva wont to milk, the mighty, the teeming Cow who yields a thousand milk- streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विधेम ते परमे जन्मन्नग्ने विधेम स्तोमैरवरे सधस्थे। यस्माद् योनेरुदारिथा यजे तं प्र त्वे हवीषि जुहुरे समिद्धे ॥७५ ॥
translation: May we adore thee in thy loftiest birth place, Agni! with praise-songs in thy lower station. The place whence those hast issued forth I worship. In thee, well kindled, have they paid oblations
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेद्धोऽअग्ने दीदिहि पुरो नोऽजस्रया सूर्म्या यविष्ठ। त्वा शश्वन्तऽउपयन्ति वाजाः ॥७६ ॥
translation: Shine thou before us, Agni, well enkindled, with flame, most youthful God, that never fadeth. Unceasing unto thee come sacred viands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने तमद्याश्वन्न स्तोमैः क्रतुन्न भद्रꣳ हृदिस्पृशम्। ऋध्यामा तऽओहैः ॥७७ ॥
translation: Agni, this day with lands, etc., as in XV. 44.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चित्तिं जुहोमि मनसा घृतेन यथा देवाऽइहागमन् वीतिहोत्राऽऋतावृधः। पत्ये विश्वस्य भूमनो जुहोमि विश्वकर्मणे विश्वाहादाभ्यꣳ हविः ॥७८ ॥
translation: I dedicate the thought with mind and butter so that the Gods may come who love oblation, strengthing Law, To Visvakarman, Lord of all the earth, I offer up day after day the inviolable sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सप्त तेऽअग्ने समिधः सप्त जिह्वाः सप्तऽऋषयः सप्त धाम प्रियाणि। सप्त होत्राः सप्तधा त्वा यजन्ति सप्त योनीरापृणस्व घृतेन स्वाहा ॥७९ ॥
translation: Seven fuel logs hast thou, seven tongues, O Agni, seven Rishis hast thou, seven belovèd mansions. Seven-priests in sevenfold manner pay thee worship. Fill full—All-hail to thee!— seven wombs with butter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुक्रज्योतिश्च चित्रज्योतिश्च सत्यज्योतिश्च ज्योतिष्माँश्च। शुक्रश्चऽऋतपाश्चात्यꣳहाः ॥८० ॥
translation: Purely-Bright, Wonderfully-Bright, Really-Bright, All-Luminous, Bright, Law’s- Protector, Safe-from-Ill;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईदृङ् चान्यादृङ् च सदृङ् च प्रतिसदृङ् च। मितश्च सम्मितश्च सभराः ॥८१ ॥
translation: Such, Other-Looking, Equal, Similar, Measured, Commensurate, Jointly-Bearing-up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतश्च सत्यश्च ध्रुवश्च धरुणश्च। धर्त्ता च विधर्त्ता च विधारयः ॥८२ ॥
translation: Right, Real, Firm, Strong-to-Support, Bearer, Disposer, Manager.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतजिच्च सत्यजिच्च सेनजिच्च सुषेणश्च। अन्तिमित्रश्च दूरेऽअमित्रश्च गणः ॥८३ ॥
translation: Winner-of-Right, Winner-of-Truth, Host-Conquering, Lord-of-Goodly-Host, Whose- Friends-are-Near-at-Hand, Whose-Banded-Enemies-are-Far-Away:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईदृक्षासऽएतादृक्षासऽऊ षु णः सदृक्षासः प्रतिसदृक्षासऽएतन। मितासश्च सम्मितासो नोऽअद्य सभरसो मरुतो यज्ञेऽअस्मिन् ॥८४ ॥
translation: To day in this our sacrifice be present, Such, Looking-Thus, Same, Similar-in-appearance, Measured, Commensurate, Joint-Bearers, Maruts!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वतवाँश्च प्रघासी च सान्तपनश्च गृहमेधी च। क्रीडी च शाकी चोज्जेषी ॥८५ ॥
translation: Self-Powerful, Voracious-One, Kin-to-the-Sun, The House-holder, Play-Lover, Mighty, Conqueror. Fierce, Terrible, The Resonant, The Roaring. Victorious, Assailant, and Dispeller, All-Hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं दैवीर्विशो मरुतोऽनुवर्त्मानोऽभवन् यथेन्द्रं दैवीर्विशो मरुतोऽनुवर्त्मानोऽभवन्। एवमिमं यजमानं दैवीश्च विशो मानुषीश्चानुवर्त्मानो भवन्तु ॥८६ ॥
translation: The Maruts, clans divine, became the followers of Indra; as The Maruts, clans divine, became the followers of Indra, so May clans divine and human he the Sacrificer’s followers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमꣳ स्तनमूर्जस्वन्तं धयापां प्रपीनमग्ने सरिरस्य मध्ये। उत्सं जुषस्व मधुमन्तमर्वन्त्समुद्रियꣳ सदनमाविशस्व ॥८७ ॥
translation: Drink in the middle of the flood, O Agni, this breast stored full of sap, teeming with water. Welcome this fountain redolent of sweetness. O Courser, enter those thy watery dwelling.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घृतं मिमिक्षे घृतमस्य योनिर्घृते श्रितो घृतम्वस्य धाम। अनुष्वधमावह मादयस्व स्वाहाकृतं वृषभ वक्षि हव्यम् ॥८८ ॥
translation: Oil hath been mixed: oil is his habitation. In oil he rests: oil is his proper province. Come as thy wont is. O thou Steer, rejoice thee. Bear off the oblation duly consecrated.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रादूर्मिर्मधुमाँ२ऽउदारदुपाशुना सममृतत्वमानट्। घृतस्य नाम गुह्यं यदस्ति जिह्वा देवानाममृतस्य नाभिः ॥८९ ॥
translation: Forth from the ocean sprang the wave of sweetness: together with the stalk it turned to Amrit, That which is holy oil’s mysterious title: but the Gods’ tongue is truly Amities centre.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं नाम प्रं ब्रवामा घृतस्यास्मिन् यज्ञे धारयामा नमोभिः। उप ब्रह्मा शृणवच्छस्यमानं चतुःशृङ्गोऽवमीद् गौरऽएतत् ॥९० ॥
translation: Let us Declare aloud the name of Ghrita, and at this sacrifice held it up with homage. So let the Brahman hear the praise we utter. This hath the four-horned Buffalo emitted.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चत्वारि शृङ्गा त्रयोऽअस्य पादा द्वे शीर्षे सप्त हस्तासोऽअस्य। त्रिधा बद्धो वृषभो रोरवीति महो देवो मर्त्याँ २ऽआविवेश ॥९१ ॥
translation: Four are his horns, three are the feet that bear him: his heads are two, his hands are seven in number. Bound with a triple bond the Bull roars loudly: the mighty God hath entered into mortals.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिधा हितं पणिभिर्गुह्यमानं गवि देवासो घृतमन्वविन्दन्। इन्द्रऽएकꣳ सूर्यऽएकञ्जजान वेनादेकꣳस्वधया निष्टतक्षुः ॥९२ ॥
translation: That oil in triple shape the Gods discovered laid down with- in the Cow, concealed by Panis. Indra produced one shape, Sûrya another: by their own power they formed the third from Vena. 71
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एताऽअर्षन्ति हृद्यात् समुद्राच्छतव्रजा रिपुणा नावचक्षे। घृतस्य धाराऽअभि चाकशीमि हिरण्ययो वेतसो मध्यऽआसाम् ॥९३ ॥
translation: From inmost reservoir in countless channels flow down these rivers which the foe beholds not. I look upon the streams of oil descending, and lo! the Golden Reed is there among them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सम्यक् स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेनाऽअन्तर्हृदा मनसा पूयमानाः। एतेऽअर्षन्त्यूर्मयो घृतस्य मृगाऽइव क्षिपणोरीषमाणाः ॥९४ ॥
translation: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. The streams of holy oil pour swiftly downward like the wild beasts that fly before the bowman.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सिन्धोरिव प्राध्वने शूघनासो वातप्रमियः पतयन्ति यह्वाः। घृतस्य धाराऽअरुषो न वाजी काष्ठा भिन्दन्नूर्मिभिः पिन्वमानः ॥९५ ॥
translation: As rushing down the rapids of a river, flow swifter than the wind the vigorous currents, The streams of oil in swelling fluctuation like a red courser bursting through the fences.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभिप्रवन्त समनेव योषाः कल्याण्यः स्मयमानासोऽअग्निम्। घृतस्य धाराः समिधो नसन्त ता जुषाणो हर्यति जातवेदाः ॥९६ ॥
translation: Like women at a gathering fair to look on and gently smiling, they incline to Agni. The streams of holy oil attain the fuel, and Jâtavedas joyfully receives them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कन्याऽइव वहतुमेतवा उऽअञ्ज्यञ्जानाऽअभि चाकशीमि। यत्र सोमः सूयते यत्र यज्ञो घृतस्य धाराऽअभि तत्पवन्ते ॥९७ ॥
translation: As maidens deck themselves with gay adornment to join the bridal feast, I now behold them. Where Soma flows and sacrifice is ready, thither the streams of holy oil are running.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्षत सुष्टुतिं गव्यमाजिमस्मासु भद्रा द्रविणानि धत्त। इमं यज्ञं नयत देवता नो घृतस्य धारा मधुमत्पवन्ते ॥९८ ॥
translation: Send to our eulogy a herd of cattle: bestow upon us excellent possessions. Bear to the Gods the sacrifice we offers the streams of oil flow pure and full of sweetness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धामन्ते विश्वं भुवनमधि श्रितमन्तः समुद्रे हृद्यन्तरायुषि। अपामनीके समिथे यऽआभृतस्तमश्याम मधुमन्तं तऽऊर्मिम् ॥९९ ॥
translation: The universe depends upon thy power and might within the sea, within the heart, within all life. May we attain that sweetly-flavoured wave of thine, brought, at this gathering, o’er the surface of the floods. 72
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजश्च मे प्रसवश्च मे प्रयतिश्च मे प्रसितिश्च मे धीतिश्च मे क्रतुश्च मे स्वरश्च मे श्लोकश्च मे श्रवश्च मे श्रुतिश्च मे ज्योतिश्च मे स्वश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१ ॥
translation: MAY my strength and my gain, and my inclination and my influence, and my thought and my mental power, and my praise and my fame, and my renown and my light, and my heaven prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राणश्च मेऽपानश्च मे व्यानश्च मेऽसुश्च मे चित्तं च मऽआधीतं च मे वाक् च मे मनश्च मे चक्षुश्च मे श्रोत्रं च मे दक्षश्च मे बलं च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२ ॥
translation: May my breathing and my out-breathing, and my through-breathing and my vital spirit, and my thought and my reflection, and my voice and my mind, and my eye and my ear, and my ability and my strength prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओजश्च मे सहश्च मऽआत्मा च मे तनूश्च मे शर्म च मे वर्म च मेऽङ्गानि च मेऽस्थीनि च मे परूषि च मे शरीराणि च मऽआयुश्च मे जरा च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥३ ॥
translation: May my energy and my force, and my self and my body, and my shelter and my shield, and my limbs and my bones, and my joints and my members, and my life and my old age prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ज्यैष्ठ्यं च मऽआधिपत्यं च मे मन्युश्च मे भामश्च मेऽमश्च मेऽम्भश्च मे जेमा च मे महिमा च मे वरिमा च मे प्रथिमा च मे वर्षिमा च मे द्राघिमा च मे वृद्धं च मे वृद्धिश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥४ ॥
translation: May my preëminence and my overlordship, and my wrath and my angry passion, and my violence and my impetuosity, and my victorious power and my greatness, and my breadth and my width, and my height and my length, and my increase and my improvement prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सत्यं च मे श्रद्धा च मे जगच्च मे धनं च मे विश्वं च मे महश्च मे क्रीडा च मे मोदश्च मे जातं च मे जनिष्यमाणं च मे सूक्तं च मे सुकृतं च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥५ ॥
translation: May my truth and my faith, and my cattle and my wealth, and my goods and my pleasure, and my play and my enjoyment, and my children and my future children, and my hymn and my pious act prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतं च मेऽमृतं च मेऽयक्ष्मं च मेऽनामयच्च मे जीवातुश्च मे दीर्घायुत्वं च मेऽनमित्रं च मेऽभयं च मे सुखं च मे शयनं च मे सूषाश्च मे सुदिनं च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥६ ॥
translation: May my religious rite and my immortality, and my freedom from consumption and my freedom from disease, and my life and my longevity, and my freedom from enemies and my freedom from danger, and my happiness and my lying down, and my fair dawn and my fair day prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यन्ता च मे धर्त्ता च मे क्षेमश्च मे धृतिश्च मे विश्वं च मे महश्च मे संविच्च मे ज्ञात्रं च मे सूश्च मे प्रसूश्च मे सीरं च मे लयश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥७ ॥
translation: May my controller and my supporter, and my security and my firmness, and my goods and my pleasure, and my knowledge and my understanding, and my begetting and my propagation, and my plough and my harrow prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शं च मे मयश्च मे प्रियं च मेऽनुकामश्च मे कामश्च मे सौमनसश्च मे भगश्च मे द्रविणं च मे भद्रं च मे श्रेयश्च मे वसीयश्च मे यशश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥८ ॥
translation: May my welfare and my comfort, and what I hold dear and what I desire, and my love and my gratification, and my enjoyment and my substance, and my happiness and my felicity, and my higher bliss and my fame prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्क् च मे सूनृता च मे पयश्च मे रसश्च मे घृतं च मे मधु च मे सग्धिश्च मे सपीतिश्च मे कृषिश्च मे वृष्टिश्च मे जैत्रं च मऽऔद्भिद्यं च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥९ ॥
translation: May my vigour and my pleasantness, and my milk and my sap, and my butter and my honey, and my meal in company and my drinking in company, and my ploughing and my husbandry, and my superiority and my preëminence prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रयिश्च मे रायश्च मे पुष्टं च मे पुष्टिश्च मे विभु च मे प्रभु च मे पूर्णं च मे पूर्णतरं च मे कुयवं च मेऽक्षितं च मेऽन्नं च मेऽक्षुच्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१० ॥
translation: May my wealth and my property, and my prosperity and my growth, and my pervading power and my lordship, and my abundance and my greater abundance, and my bad harvest and my unwasted crop, and my food and my satiety prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वित्तं च मे वेद्यं च मे भूतं च मे भविष्यच्च मे सुगं च मे सुपथ्यं च मऽऋद्धं च मऽऋद्धिश्च म क्लृप्तं च मे क्लृप्तिश्च मे मतिश्च मे सुमतिश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥११ ॥
translation: May my gain and my future gain, and what I have and what I shall have, and my good road and my good path, and my success and my succeeding, and my achievement and my contrivance, and my thought and my good counsel prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: व्रीहयश्च मे यवाश्च मे माषाश्च मे तिलाश्च मे मुद्गाश्च मे खल्वाश्च मे प्रियङ्गवश्च मेऽणवश्च मे श्यामाकाश्च मे नीवाराश्च मे गोधूमाश्च मे मसूराश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१२ ॥
translation: May my rice-plants and my barley, and my beans and my sesamum, and my kidney-beans and my vetches, and my millet and my Panicum Milliaceum, and my Panicum Frumentaceum and my wild rice, and my wheat and my lentils prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्मा च मे मृत्तिका च मे गिरयश्च मे पर्वताश्च मे सिकताश्च मे वनस्पतयश्च मे हिरण्यं च मेऽयश्च मे श्यामं च मे लोहं च मे सीसं च मे त्रपु च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१३ ॥
translation: May my stone and my clay, and my hills and my mountains, and my pebbles and my trees, and my gold and my bronze, and my copper and my iron, and my lead and my tin prosper by sacrifice. 73
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निश्च मऽआपश्च मे वीरुधश्च मऽओषधयश्च मे कृष्टपच्याश्च मेऽकृष्टपच्याश्च मे ग्राम्याश्च मे पशवऽआरण्याश्च मे वित्तञ्च मे वित्तिश्च मे भूतञ्च मे भूतिश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१४ ॥
translation: May my fire and my water, and my creepers and my plants, and lily plants with culture- ripened fruit and my plants with fruit ripened without culture, and my domestic animals and my wild animals, and my substance and my future substance, and my belongings and my power be produced by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसु चे मे वसतिश्च मे कर्म च मे शक्तिश्च मेऽर्थश्च मऽएमश्च मऽइत्या च मे गतिश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१५ ॥
translation: May my treasure and my dwelling, and my religious service and my ability to perform it, and my object and my course, and my way and my going prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे सोमश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे सविता च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे सरस्वती च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे पूषा च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे बृहस्पतिश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१६ ॥
translation: May my Agni and my Indra, and my Soma and my Indra, and my Savitar and my Indra, and my Sarasvatî and my Indra, and my Pûshan and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे वरुणश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे धाता च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे त्वष्टा च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे मरुतश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे विश्वे च मे देवाऽइन्द्रश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१७ ॥
translation: May my Mitra and my Indra, and my Varuna and my Indra, and my Dhâtar and my Indra, and my Maruts and my Indra, and my All-Gods and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पृथिवी च मऽइन्द्रश्च मेऽन्तरिक्षं च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे द्यौश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे समाश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे नक्षत्राणि च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे दिशश्च मऽइन्द्रश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥१८ ॥
translation: May my earth and my Indra, and my Air and my Indra, and my Sky and my Indra, and my Half-months and my Indra, and my Lunar Mansions and my Indra, and my Sky-regions and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अꣳशुश्च मे रश्मिश्च मेऽदाभ्यश्च मेऽधिपतिश्च मऽउपाशुश्च मेऽन्तर्यामश्च मऽऐन्द्रवायवश्च मे मैत्रावरुणश्च मऽआश्विनश्च मे प्रतिप्रस्थानश्च मे शुक्रश्च मे मन्थी च मे यज्ञेन कल्पताम् ॥१९ ॥
translation: May my Amsu and my Rasmi, and my Adhipati and my Upâmsu, and my Antaryâma and my Aindra-Vâyava, and my Maitrâ-Varuna, and my Âsvina and my Pratiprasthâna, and my Sukra and my Manthin proper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आग्रयणश्च मे वैश्वदेवश्च मे ध्रुवश्च मे वैश्वानरश्च मऽऐन्द्राग्नश्च मे महावैश्वदेवश्च मे मरुत्वतीयाश्च मे निष्केवल्यश्च मे सावित्रश्च मे सारस्वतश्च मे पात्नीवतश्च मे हारियोजनश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२० ॥
translation: May my Âgrayana and my Vaisvadeva, and my Dhruvâ and my Vaisvânara, and my Aindrâgna and my Mahâvaisvadeva, and my Marutvatîya and my Nishkevalya, and my Sâvitra and my Sârasvata, and my Pâtnîvata and my Hâriyojana prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्रुचश्च मे चमसाश्च मे वायव्यानि च मे द्रोणकलशश्च मे ग्रावाणश्च मेऽधिषवणे च मे पूतभृच्च मऽआधवनीयश्च मे वेदिश्च मे बर्हिश्च मेऽवभृथश्च मे स्वगाकारश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२१ ॥
translation: May my ladles and my cups, and my Vâyu, vessels and my Soma reservoirs, and my pressing-stones and my two press-boards, and my Pûtabhrit and my Âdhavanîya, and my altar and altar-grass, and my Avabhritha and my cries of Good-speed prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निश्च मे घर्मश्च मेऽर्कश्च मे सूर्यश्च मे प्राणश्च मेऽश्वमेधश्च मे पृथिवी च मेऽदितिश्च मे दितिश्च मे द्यौश्च मेऽङ्गुलयः शक्वरयो दिशश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२२ ॥
translation: May my Agni and my charms, and my Arka and my Sûrya, and my Prâna and my Asvamedha, and my Prithivî and my Aditi, and my Diti and my Sky, and my fingers, powers, and sky-regions prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: व्रतं च मऽऋतवश्च मे तपश्च मे संवत्सरश्च मेऽहोरात्रेऽऊर्वष्ठीवे बृहद्रथन्तरे च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२३ ॥
translation: May my vow and my seasons, and my austere devotion, and my day and night, thighs and knees, and two Great Rathantaras prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एका च मे तिस्रश्च मे तिस्रश्च मे पञ्च च मे पञ्च च मे सप्त च मे सप्त च मे नव च मे नव च मऽएकादश च मऽएकादश च मे त्रयोदश च मे त्रयोदश च मे पञ्चदश च मे पञ्चदश च मे सप्तदश च मे सप्तदश च मे नवदश च मे नवदश च मऽएकविꣳशतिश्च मऽएकविꣳशतिश्च मे त्रयोविꣳशतिश्च मे त्रयोविꣳशतिश्च मे पञ्चविꣳशतिश्च मे पञ्चविꣳशतिश्च मे सप्तविꣳशतिश्च मे सप्तविꣳशतिश्च मे नवविꣳशतिश्च मे नवविꣳशतिश्च मऽएकत्रिꣳशच्च मऽएकत्रिꣳशच्च मे त्रयस्त्रिꣳशच्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२४ ॥
translation: May me One and my Three, and my Three and my Five, and my Five and my Seven (and similarly up to thirty-three) prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चतस्रश्च मेऽष्टौ च मेऽष्टौ च मे द्वादश च मे द्वादश च मे षोडश च मे षोडश च मे विꣳशतिश्च मे विꣳशतिश्च मे चतुर्विꣳशतिश्च मे चतुर्विꣳशतिश्च मेऽष्टाविꣳशतिश्च मेऽष्टाविꣳशतिश्च मे द्वात्रिꣳशच्च मे द्वात्रिꣳशच्च मे षट्त्रिꣳशच्च मे षट्त्रिꣳशच्च मे चत्वारिꣳशच्च मे चत्वारिꣳशच्च मे चतुश्चत्वारिꣳशच्च मे चतुश्चत्वारिꣳशच्च मेऽष्टाचत्वारिꣳशच्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२५ ॥
translation: May my Four and my Eight and my Twelve (and similarly up to forty-eight) prosper by sacrifice
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्र्यविश्च मे त्र्यवी च मे दित्यवाट् च मे दित्यौही च मे पञ्चाविश्च मे पञ्चावी च मे त्रिवत्सश्च मे त्रिवत्सा च मे तुर्यवाट् च मे तुर्यौही च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२६ ॥
translation: May my eighteen-months steer and my eighteen-months heifer, and my two-year bull and cow (and similarly up to four-year) prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पष्ठवाट् च मे पष्ठौही च मऽउक्षा च मे वशा च मऽऋषभश्च मे वेहच्च मेऽनड्वाँश्च मे धेनुश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम् ॥२७ ॥
translation: May my six-year bull and my six-year cow, and my bull and my barren cow, and my young bull and my calf-slipping cow, and my ox and my milch-cow prosper by sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजाय स्वाहा प्रसवाय स्वाहापिजाय स्वाहा क्रतवे स्वाहा वसवे स्वाहाहर्पतये स्वाहाह्ने मुग्धाय स्वाहा मुग्धाय वैनꣳशिनाय स्वाहा विनꣳशिनऽआन्त्यायनाय स्वाहान्त्याय भौवनाय स्वाहा भुवनस्य पतये स्वाहाधिपतये स्वाहा प्रजापतये स्वाहा। इयं ते राण्मित्राय यन्तासि यमनऽऊर्जे त्वा वृष्ट्यै त्वा प्रजानां त्वाधिपत्याय ॥२८ ॥
translation: To strength, Hail! To Gain, Hail! To After-born, Hail! To Power, Hail! To Vasu, Hail! To the Lord of Days, Hail! To the Failing Day, Hail! To the Failing Sprung from the Transitory, Hail! To the Transitory sprung from the Final, Hail! To the Final Mundane, Hail! To the Lord of the World, Hail! To the Sovran Lord, Hail! To Prajâpati, Hail! This is thy kingdom. Thou art a guiding controller for the friend. Thee for vigour, thee for rain, thee for the sovran lordship of creatures.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयुर्यज्ञेन कल्पतां प्राणो यज्ञेन कल्पतां चक्षुर्यज्ञेन कल्पता श्रोत्रं यज्ञेन कल्पतां वाग्यज्ञेन कल्पतां मनो यज्ञेन कल्पतामात्मा यज्ञेन कल्पतां ब्रह्मा यज्ञेन कल्पतां ज्योतिर्यज्ञेन कल्पता स्वर्यज्ञेन कल्पतां पृष्ठं यज्ञेन कल्पतां यज्ञो यज्ञेन कल्पताम्। स्तोमश्च यजुश्चऽऋक् च साम च बृहच्च रथन्तरञ्च। स्वर्देवाऽअगन्मामृताऽअभूम प्रजापतेः प्रजाऽअभूम वेट् स्वाहा ॥२९ ॥
translation: May life succeed through sacrifice. May life-breath thrive by sacrifice. May the eye thrive by sacrifice. May the ear thrive by sacrifice. May the voice thrive by sacrifice. May the mind thrive by sacrifice. May the self thrive by sacrifice. May Brahma thrive by sacrifice. May 74 light succeed by sacrifice. May heaven succeed by sacrifice. May the hymn thrive by sacrifice. May sacrifice thrive by sacrifice; And laud and sacrificial text, and verse of praise and Sâma chant, The Brihat and Rathantara. Gods, we have gone to light. We have become the children of Prajâpati. We have become immortal.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजस्य नु प्रसवे मातरं महीमदितिं नाम वचसा करामहे। यस्यामिदं विश्वं भुवनमाविवेश तस्यां नो देवः सविता धर्म साविषत् ॥३० ॥
translation: In gain of wealth we celebrate, etc: = IX. 5.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वेऽअद्य मरुतो विश्वऽऊती विश्वे भवन्त्वग्नयः समिद्धाः। विश्वे नो देवाऽअवसागमन्तु विश्वमस्तु द्रविणं वाजोऽअस्मे ॥३१ ॥
translation: This day come all the Maruts, all to aid us! Let all the fires be thoroughly enkindled. May the All-Gods come hither with protection. May we possess all property and riches.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजो नः सप्त प्रदिशश्चतस्रो वा परावतः। वाजो नो विश्वैर्देवैर्धनसाताविहावतु ॥३२ ॥
translation: May our strength fill the regions seven, fill the four distant places full. Here may our riches guard us with the All-Gods in the gain of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजो नोऽअद्य प्र सुवाति दानं वाजो देवाँ२ऽऋतुभिः कल्पयाति। वाजो हि मा सर्ववीरं जजान विश्वाऽआशा वाजपतिर्जयेयम् ॥३३ ॥
translation: May strength to-day procure for us donations strength range the Gods together with the Seasons. Yea, strength hath made me rich in store of heroes. As lord of strength may I gain all the regions.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नो वाजो देवान् हविषा वर्द्धयाति। वाजो हि मा सर्ववीरं चकार सर्वाऽआशा वाजपतिर्भवेयम् ॥३४ ॥
translation: Strength be before us, in the midst among us. May strength exalt the Gods with our oblation. Yea, strength hath made me rich in store of heroes. As lord of strength may I gain all the regions.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं मा सृजामि पयसा पृथिव्याः सं मा सृजाम्यद्भिरोषधीमिः। सोऽहं वाजꣳ सनेयमग्ने ॥३५ ॥
translation: With milk of Prithivî do I unite me, unite myself with waters and with plants. As such may I gain strength, O Agni.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पयः पृथिव्यां पयऽओषधीषु पयो दिव्यन्तरिक्षे पयो धाः। पयस्वतीः प्रदिशः सन्तु मह्यम् ॥३६ ॥
translation: Store milk in earth and milk in plants, milk in the sky and milk in air. Teeming with milk for me he all the regions. 37 Thee by the radiant Savitar’s impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, Controlled by Vâk Sarasvatî’s Controller, with Agni’s sole dominion I besprinkle. 38 Maintainer of Law, true by nature, Agni is the Gandharva. The plants are his Apsarases, namely Delights. May he protect this our Priesthood and Nobility. To him All-hail! Ave! To those All-hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सꣳहितो विश्वसामा सूर्यो गन्धर्वस्तस्य मरीचयोऽप्सरसऽआयुवो नाम। स नऽइदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा ॥३९ ॥
translation: The Conjoined, Visvasâman, Sûrya is the Gandharva. His motes are his Apsarases, Swift- moving. May he protect, etc., as in 38.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुषुम्णः सूर्यरश्मिश्चन्द्रमा गन्धर्वस्तस्य नक्षत्राण्यप्सरसो भेकुरयो नाम। स नऽइदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा ॥४० ॥
translation: The Highly-Blessed, the Moon whose rays are like the Sun’s, is the Gandharva. The Asterisms are his Apsarases, Luminous. May he protect, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषिरो विश्वव्यचा वातो गन्धर्वस्तस्यापोऽअप्सरसऽऊर्जो नाम। स नऽइदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा ॥४१ ॥
translation: The Quick, All-reaching, Wind is the Gandharva. The Waters are his Apsarases, named Energies. May he protect, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भुज्युः सुपर्णो यज्ञो गन्धर्वस्तस्य दक्षिणाऽअप्सरस स्तावा नाम। स नऽइदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा ॥४२ ॥
translation: The Protecting, Strong-winged, Sacrifice is the Gandharva. Guerdons are his Apsarases, called Praisers. May he protect, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रजापतिर्विश्वकर्मा मनो गन्धर्वस्तस्यऽऋक्सामान्यप्सरसऽएष्टयो नाम। स नऽइदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा ॥४३ ॥
translation: The Lord of Creatures, Omnific, Mind is the Gandharva. Richas and Sâmans are his Apsarases, called Wishings. May he protect, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो भुवनस्य पते प्रजापते यस्य तऽउपरि गृहा यस्य वेह। अस्मै ब्रह्मणेऽस्मै क्षत्राय महि शर्म यच्छ स्वाहा ॥४४ ॥
translation: Lord of the World, Prajâpati, whose are the homes above and here, Give great protection unto these, the Priesthood and Nobility.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रोऽसि नभस्वानार्द्रदानुः शम्भूर्मयोभूरभि मा वाहि स्वाहा मारुतोऽसि मरुतां गणः शम्भूर्मयोभूरभि मा वाहि स्वाहाऽवस्यूरसि दुवस्वाञ्छम्भूर्मयोभूरभि मा वाहि स्वाहा ॥४५ ॥
translation: Thou art the vapoury sea that giveth moisture. Blow on me, thou, healthful and blessing- laden. Thou art the Maruts’ own, the band of Maruts. Blow on me, etc. Seeker of aid art thou, receiving worship. Blow on me, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यास्ते अग्ने सूर्ये रुचो दिवमातन्वन्ति रश्मिभिः। ताभिर्नोऽअद्य सर्वाभी रुचे जनाय नस्कृधि ॥४६ ॥
translation: Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun, etc., as in XIII. 22.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या वो देवाः सूर्ये रुचो गोष्वश्वेषु या रुचः। इन्द्राग्नी ताभिः सर्वाभी रुचं नो धत्त बृहस्पते ॥४७ ॥
translation: Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, etc., as in XIII. 23.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रुचं नो धेहि ब्राह्मणेषु रुचꣳ राजसु नस्कृधि। रुचं विश्येषु शूद्रेषु मयि धेहि रुचा रुचम् ॥४८ ॥
translation: Give lustre to our holy priests, set lustre in our ruling chiefs Lustre to Vaisyas, Sûdras: give, through lustre; lustre unto me. 75
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस्तदा शास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः। अहेडमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशꣳस मा नऽआयुः प्रमोषीः ॥४९ ॥
translation: I ask this of thee with my prayer, adoring: thy worshipper asks this with his oblations. Varuna, stay thou here and be not angry: steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वर्ण घर्मः स्वाहा स्वर्णार्कः स्वाहा स्वर्ण शुक्रः स्वाहा स्वर्ण ज्योतिः स्वाहा स्वर्ण सूर्यः स्वाहा ॥५० ॥
translation: Heaven-like is Warmth, Hail! Heaven-like is Arka, Hail! Heaven-like is the Bright One, Hail! Heaven-like is Light, Hail! Heaven-like is Sûrya, Hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं युनज्मि शवसा घृतेन दिव्यꣳ सुपर्णं वयसा बृहन्तम्। तेन वयं गमेम ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपꣳ स्वो रुहाणाऽअधि नाकमुत्तमम् ॥५१ ॥
translation: I yoke with power and flowing butter Agni, divine, strong- pinioned, great with vital vigour. Through him may we approach the Bright One’s station, ascending to the loftiest sky, to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमौ ते पक्षावजरौ पतत्त्रिणौ याभ्या रक्षास्यपहस्यग्ने। ताभ्यां पतेम सुकृतामु लोकं यत्रऽऋषयो जग्मुः प्रथमजाः पुराणाः ॥५२ ॥
translation: With these thy two ne’er-wasting feathered pinions wherewith thou drivest fiends away, O Agni, Let us fly to the regions of the pious whither have gone the first-born ancient Rishis.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुर्दक्षः श्येनऽऋतावा हिरण्यपक्षः शकुनो भुरण्युः। महान्त्सधस्थे ध्रुवऽआ निषत्तो नमस्तेऽअस्तु मा मा हिꣳसीः ॥५३ ॥
translation: The Drop, the powerful, the falcon, righteous, impetuous bird borne on his golden pinions, Great, stedfast, settled in the habitation—to thee be reverence! Forbear to harm thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवो मूर्द्धासि पृथिव्या नाभिरूर्गपामोषधीनाम्। विश्वायुः शर्म सप्रथा नमस्पथे ॥५४ ॥
translation: Centre of earth, heaven’s head art thou, essence of waters and of plants. Eternal, far spread refuge. Homage to the Path!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वस्य मूर्द्धन्नधि तिष्ठसि श्रितः समुद्रे ते हृदयमप्स्वायुरपो दत्तोदधिं भिन्त। दिवस्पर्जन्यादन्तरिक्षात् पृथिव्यास्ततो नो वृष्ट्याव ॥५५ ॥
translation: Attached thou standest at the head of all the world. Thy heart is in the sea, thy life is in the floods. Give water: cleave the reservoir. Help us with rain sent from the sky, Parjanya, firmament, or earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इष्टो यज्ञो भृगुभिराशीर्दा वसुभिः। तस्य न इष्टस्य प्रीतस्य द्रविणेहागमेः ॥५६ ॥
translation: By Bhrigus and by Vasus hath prayer-granting sacrifice been paid. Come, Wealth, into the house of him our dear, our well-beloved one.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इष्टोऽअग्निराहुतः पिपर्त्तु नऽइष्टꣳ हविः। स्वगेदं देवेभ्यो नमः ॥५७ ॥
translation: May Agni, served with sacrifice and gifts, protect our offered food: This homage be Good-speed to Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदाकूतात् समसुस्रोद्धृदो वा मनसो वा सम्भृतं चक्षुषो वा। तदनु प्रेत सुकृतामु लोकं यत्रऽऋषयो जग्मुः प्रथमजाः पुराणाः ॥५८ ॥
translation: That which hath flowed from purpose or from judgment, or gathered from the wind or from the vision, Follow ye to the region of the pious whither have gone the first-born ancient Rishis.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतꣳ सधस्थ परि ते ददामि यमावहाच्छेवधिं जातवेदाः। अन्वागन्ता यज्ञपतिर्वोऽअत्र तꣳ स्म जानीत परमे व्योमन् ॥५९ ॥
translation: To thee I trust this man. Celestial Dwelling! treasure which Jâtavedas shall bring hither. After you will the Sacrificer follow. Here recognize him in the highest heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतं जानाथ परमे व्योमन् देवाः सधस्था विद रूपमस्य। यदागच्छात् पथिभिर्देवयानैरिष्टापूर्त्ते कृणवाथाविरस्मै ॥६० ॥
translation: Acknowledge him, ye Gods, in highest heaven. Ye who are present, know the shape he weareth. When he approacheth by the God-ward pathways, reveal to him the meed of pious actions.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्बुध्यस्वाग्ने प्रति जागृहि त्वमिष्टापूर्ते सꣳसृजेथामयं च। अस्मिन्त्सधस्थेऽअध्युत्तरस्मिन् विश्वे देवा यजमानश्च सीदत ॥६१ ॥
translation: Wake up, O Agni, etc., as in XV. 54.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येन वहसि सहस्रं येनाग्ने सर्ववेदसम्। तेनेमं यज्ञं नो नय स्वर्देवेषु गन्तवे ॥६२ ॥
translation: Convey our sacrifice to heaven, etc., as in XV. 55,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रस्तरेण परिधिना स्रुचा वेद्या च बर्हिषा। ऋचेमं यज्ञं नो नय स्वर्देवेषु गन्तवे ॥६३ ॥
translation: With Darbha-bunch, with fencing-wood, with spoon, with altar, holy grass, With laud, lead this our sacrifice to go to heaven among the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्दत्तं यत्परादानं यत्पूर्त्तं याश्च दक्षिणाः। तदग्निर्वैश्वकर्मणः स्वर्देवेषु नो दधत् ॥६४ ॥
translation: Our gifts, our charitable grants, our pious works, our fees to priests, May the Omnific’s Agni set all this among the Gods in heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्र धाराऽअनपेता मधोर्घृतस्य च याः। तदग्निर्वैश्वकर्मणः स्वर्देवेषु नो दधत् ॥६५ ॥
translation: There where all never-failing streams of honey and of butter flow, May Agni, Visvakarman’s own, place us in heaven among the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निरस्मि जन्मना जातवेदा घृतं मे चक्षुरमृतं मऽआसन्। अर्कस्त्रिधातू रजसो विमानोऽजस्रो घर्मो हविरस्मि नाम ॥६६ ॥
translation: Agni am who know by birth all creatures. Mine eye is butter, in my mouth is nectar. I am the triple light, the region’s meter: exhaustless heat am I, named burnt oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋचो नामास्मि यजूषि नामास्मि सामानि नामास्मि। येऽअग्नयः पाञ्चजन्याऽअस्यां पृथिव्यामधि। तेषामसि त्वमुत्तमः प्र नो जीवातवे सुव ॥६७ ॥
translation: Praise-verses, sacrificial texts, and chanted hymns am I in name. Thou art the best of all the Fires among the fivefold race of man That burn upon this earth of ours. Speed thou us on to lengthened life. 76
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वार्त्रहत्याय शवसे पृतनाषाह्याय च। इन्द्र त्वावर्तयामसि ॥६८ ॥
translation: O Indra, for the strength that slays Vritra and conquers in the fight We torn thee hitherward to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहदानुम्पुरुहूत क्षियन्तमहस्तमिन्द्र सम्पिणक् कुणारुम्। अभि वृत्रं वर्द्धमानं पियारुमपादमिन्द्र तवसा जघन्थ ॥६९ ॥
translation: Thou, Indra, much-invoked, didst crush to pieces, Kunâru, handless fiend who dwelt with Dânus. Thou with might, Indra, smotest dead the scorner, the footless Vritra as he waxed in vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि नऽइन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः। योऽअस्माँ२ऽअभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः ॥७० ॥
translation: O Indra, beat our foes away, etc. as in VIII. 44.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावतऽआ जगन्था परस्याः। सृकꣳ सꣳशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून् ताढि वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥७१ ॥
translation: Like some dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foes and scatter those who hate us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वैश्वानरो नऽऊतयऽआ प्र यातु परावतः। अग्निर्नः सुष्टुतीरुप ॥७२ ॥
translation: To aid us let Vaisvânara come from the distance far away: Come Agni, to our eulogies!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पृष्टो दिवि पृष्टोऽअग्निः पृथिव्यां पृष्टो विश्वाऽओषधीराविवेश। वैश्वानरः सहसा पृष्टोऽअग्निः स नो दिवा स रिषस्पातु नक्तम् ॥७३ ॥
translation: Sought in the sky, sought on the earth, sought after, all plants that grow on ground hath Agni entered. May Agni, may Vaisvânara with vigour, sought for, by day and night from harm preserve us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्याम तं काममग्ने तवोतीऽअश्याम रयिꣳ रयिवः सुवीरम्। अश्याम वाजमभि वाजयन्तोऽश्याम द्युम्नमजराजरं ते ॥७४ ॥
translation: Help its that we may gain this wish, O Agni, gain riches, Wealthy One! with store of heroes. Desiring strength from thee may we be strengthened, and win, Eternal! thine eternal glory.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं तेऽअद्य ररिमा हि काममुत्तानहस्ता नमसोपसद्य। यजिष्ठेन मनसा यक्षि देवानस्रेधता मन्मना विप्रोऽअग्ने ॥७५ ॥
translation: Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing. Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit as Priest with no unfriendly thought. O Agni.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धामच्छदग्निरिन्द्रो ब्रह्मा देवो बृहस्पतिः। सचेतसो विश्वे देवा यज्ञं प्रावन्तु नः शुभे ॥७६ ॥
translation: Home-hider Agni, Indra, and Brahma, and bright Brihaspati— May the All Gods, one- minded, guard our sacrifice in happy place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँ पाहि शृणुधी गिरः। रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना ॥७७ ॥
translation: Guard thou the Sacrificer’s men, O Youthfullest, etc., as in XIII. 52. 77
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वाद्वीं त्वा स्वादुना तीव्रां तीव्रेणामृताममृतेन। मधुमतीं मधुमता सृजामि सꣳसोमेन। सोमोऽस्यश्विभ्यां पच्यस्व सरस्वत्यै पच्यस्वेन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे पच्यस्व ॥१ ॥
translation: SWEET with the sweet, I sprinkle thee with Soma, strong with the strong, the nectar with the nectar, The honey-sweet with what is sweet as honey. Soma art thou. Get dressed for the Asvins. Get dressed for Sarasvatî. Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतꣳ सोमो यऽउत्तमꣳ हविः। दधन्वान् यो नर्योऽअप्स्वन्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः ॥२ ॥
translation: Hence pour ye forth the flowing juice, Soma, best Sacrificial food. He who, man’s friend, hath run within the waters hath with the pressing-stones poured out the Soma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायोः पूतः पवित्रेण प्रत्यङ् सोमोऽअतिद्रुतः। इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा। वायोः पूतः पवित्रेण प्राङ् सोमोऽअतिद्रुतः। इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ॥३ ॥
translation: Purified by Vâyu’s strainer, Soma that has passed away forward is Indra’s proper friend. Purified by Vâyu’s strainer, Soma that has passed away backward is Indra’s proper friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनाति ते परिस्रुतꣳ सोमꣳ सूर्यस्य दुहिता। वारेण शश्वता तना ॥४ ॥
translation: By means of this eternal sieve may Sûrya’s Daughter purify The Soma that flows forth from thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पवते तेजऽइन्द्रियꣳ सुरया सोमः सुतऽआसुतो मदाय। शुक्रेण देव देवताः पिपृग्धि रसेनान्नं यजमानाय धेहि ॥५ ॥
translation: Soma with Wine, pressed; filtered for the banquet, cleanses priest, noble, brilliancy and vigour. God, with the Bright give Deities enjoyment: give food with flavour to the Sacrificer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद्यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय। इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नमऽ उक्तिं यजन्ति। उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यश्विभ्यां त्वा सरस्वत्यै त्वेन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्णऽएष ते योनिस्तेजसे त्वा वीर्याय त्वा बलाय त्वा ॥६ ॥
translation: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley, etc., as in X. 32. Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee for the Asvin Pair. Thee for Sarasvatî. Thee for Indra the Good Deliverer. This is thy home. For splendour thee. Thee for mans’ vigour. Thee for strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाना हि वां देवहितꣳ सदस्कृतं मा सꣳसृक्षाथां परमे व्योमन्। सुरा त्वमसि शुष्मिणी सोमऽएष मा मा हिꣳसीः स्वां योनिमाविशन्ती ॥७ ॥
translation: For each of you is made a God-appointed place: so grant to me a portion in the highest sphere. Surâ the strong art thou. This here is Soma. Entering thine own place do me no mischief.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपयामगृहीतोऽस्याश्विनं तेजः सारस्वतं वीर्यमैन्द्रं बलम्। एष ते योनिर्मोदाय त्वानन्दाय त्वा महसे त्वा ॥८ ॥
translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Splendour of Asvins, Sarasvatî’s manly vigour, might of Indra. This is thy home. I take thee for enjoyment. I take thee for delight, take thee for greatness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धेहि वीर्यमसि वीर्यं मयि धेहि बलमसि बलं मयि धेह्योजोऽस्योजो मयि धेहि मन्युरसि मन्युं मयि धेहि सहोऽसि सहो मयि धेहि ॥९ ॥
translation: Thou art lustre: give me lustre, Thou art manly vigour: give me manly vigour. Thou art strength: give me strength. Thou art energy: give me energy. Thou art passion: Give me passion. Thou art conquering might: give me conquering might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या व्याघ्रं विषूचिकोभौ वृकं च रक्षति। श्येनं पतत्रिणꣳ सिꣳहꣳ सेमं पात्वꣳहसः ॥१० ॥
translation: My she, Vishûchikâ, who guards these two, the tiger and the wolf, The lion and the wingèd hawk, may she guard this man from distress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदापिपेष मातरं पुत्रः प्रमुदितो धयन्। एतत्तदग्नेऽअनृणो भवाम्यहतौ पितरौ मया। सम्पृच स्थ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्त विपृच स्थ वि मा पाप्मना पृङ्क्त ॥११ ॥
translation: When, a delighted boy, I bruised my mother as I sucked her breast, Free from my debt, O Agni, I become thereby. My parents are by me unharmed. United are ye all: with bliss unite me. Parted are ye, keep me apart from evil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवा यज्ञमतन्वत भेषजं भिषजाश्विना। वाचा सरस्वती भिषगिन्द्रायेन्द्रियाणि दधतः ॥१२ ॥
translation: The Asvins, the Physicians, Gods, stretched out the healing sacrifice, Sarasvatî with speech was a Physician, all with heroic powers investing Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दीक्षायै रूपꣳ शष्पाणि प्रायणीयस्य तोक्मानि। क्रयस्य रूपꣳ सोमस्य लाजाः सोमाशवो मधु ॥१३ ॥
translation: Symbols of Dîkshâ are grass buds, of Prâyanîya sprouts of corn, Of Soma-purchasing fried grains are symbols, Soma-shoots and meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आतिथ्यरूपं मासरं महावीरस्य नग्नहुः। रूपमुपसदामेतत्तिस्रो रात्रीः सुरासुता ॥१४ ॥
translation: Âtithya’s sign is Mâsara, the Gharma’s symbol Nagnahu. Three nights with Surâ poured, this is the symbol of the Upasads.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमस्य रूपं क्रीतस्य परिस्रुत्परिषिच्यते। अश्विभ्यां दुग्धं भेषजमिन्द्रायैन्द्रꣳ सरस्वत्या ॥१५ ॥
translation: Emblem of purchased Soma is Parisrut, foaming drink effused: Indra’s balm milked for Indra by the Asvins and Sarasvatî.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आसन्दी रूपꣳ राजासन्द्यै वेद्यै कुम्भी सुराधानी। अन्तरऽउत्तरवेद्या रूपं कारोतरो भिषक् ॥१६ ॥
translation: The Sacrificer’s seat is the throne’s symbol, the jar containing Surâ of the Altar. The mid- space is the northern Altar’s symbol: the cloth for filtering is the physician.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेद्या वेदिः समाप्यते बर्हिषा बर्हिरिन्द्रियम्। यूपेन यूपऽआप्यते प्रणीतोऽअग्निरग्निना ॥१७ ॥
translation: Altar by Altar is produced, power, holy grass by holy grass. The stake is by the stake obtained, by Agni Agni carried forth. 78
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हविर्धानं यदश्विनाग्नीध्रं यत्सरस्वती। इन्द्रायैन्द्रꣳसदस्कृतं पत्नीशालं गार्हपत्यः ॥१८ ॥
translation: The Asvins are the Soma store, Sarasvatî the sacred hearth. For Indra formed is Indra s seat, the Matrons’ Hall, the house-lord’s fire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रैषेभिः प्रैषानाप्नोत्याप्रीभिराप्रीर्यज्ञस्य। प्रयाजेभिरनुयाजान् वषट्कारेभिराहुतीः ॥१९ ॥
translation: Orders he gains by orders, by Âprîs Âprîs of sacrifice, Post-offerings by fore-offerings, and by calls of Vashat Âhutis.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पशुभिः पशूनाप्नोति पुरोडाशैर्हवीष्या। छन्दोभिः सामिधेनीर्याज्याभिर्वषट्कारान् ॥२० ॥
translation: By victims he gains victims, by ground rice-cakes sacrificial food, By metres kindling- verses, and Vashat-calls by Inviting prayers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धानाः करम्भः सक्तवः परीवापः पयो दधि। सोमस्य रूपꣳ हविषऽआमिक्षा वजिनं मधु ॥२१ ॥
translation: Grain roasted, gruel, barley-meal, grains of rice roasted, milk and curd Are types of Soma: mingled milk, sweet whey, of sacrificial food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धानाना रूपं कुवलं परीवापस्य गोधूमाः। सक्तूना रूपं बदरमुपवाकाः करम्भस्य ॥२२ ॥
translation: Type of parched corn is jujube-fruit; wheat of the roasted grains of rice; Jujube the type of barley-meal, and Indra-grains of gruel-groats.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पयसो रूपं यद्यवा दध्नो रूपं कर्कन्धूनि। सोमस्य रूपं वाजिनꣳ सौम्यस्य रूपमामिक्षा ॥२३ ॥
translation: Symbol of milk are barley-grains, symbol of curd are jujube-fruits. Whey is the type of Soma, and milk-mixture type of Soma’s pap.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ श्रावयेति स्तोत्रियाः प्रत्याश्रावोऽअनुरूपः। यजेति धाय्यारूपं प्रगाथा येयजामहाः ॥२४ ॥
translation: The Strophe is the cry, Bid hear? the answer is the antistrophe. Sacrifice! is the Dhâyyâ’s form, Pragâthas’ the Yajâmahas. 25 By verse-halves comes the Ukthas’ type, Nivids by Padas he obtains. The type of Sastras is obtained by Pranavas, Soma by milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विभ्यां प्रातः सवनमिन्द्रेणैन्द्रं माध्यन्दिनम्। वैश्वदेवꣳ सरस्वत्या तृतीयमाप्तꣳ सवनम् ॥२६ ॥
translation: Gained by the Asvins is the morn’s libation, Indra’s libation of mid-day by Indra. Sarasvatî obtains the third outpouring, the offering sacred to the Visve Devas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायव्यैर्वायव्यान्याप्नोति सतेन द्रोणकलशम्। कुम्भीभ्यामम्भृणौ सुते स्थालीभि स्थालीराप्नोति ॥२७ ॥
translation: By Vâyu cups he gains the cups of Vâyu, and by the basket gains the vat for Soma. By the two jars he gains two cleansing-vessels, and by the cooking-pot the pot for cooking.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यजुर्भिराप्यन्ते ग्रहा ग्रहै स्तोमाश्च विष्टुतीः। छन्दोभिरुक्थाशस्त्राणि साम्नावभृथऽआप्यते ॥२८ ॥
translation: By sacrificial texts are gained the Grahas, and by the Grahas lauds and laud-arrangements. By metres are obtained Ukthas and praise-songs, and by the Sâma-chant the Avabhritha.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इडाभिर्भक्षानाप्नोति सूक्तवाकेनाशिषः। शम्युना पत्नीसंयाजान्त्समिष्टयजुषा सꣳस्थाम् ॥२९ ॥
translation: Draughts he obtains by pouring out libations, and wishes by the utterance of praises, By Samyu he obtains Patnîsamyâjas, and Consummation by Samishtayajus.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: व्रतेन दीक्षामाप्नोति दीक्षयाप्नोति दक्षिणाम्। दक्षिणा श्रद्धामाप्नोति श्रद्धया सत्यमाप्यते ॥३० ॥
translation: He gains by vow of fasting Consecration, by Consecration gains the priestly guerdon. He gains by priestly guerdon faith: by faith comes knowledge of the truth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतावद् रूपं यज्ञस्य यद्देवैर्ब्रह्मणा कृतम्। तदेतत्सर्वमाप्नोति यज्ञे सौत्रामणी सुते ॥३१ ॥
translation: So far the type of sacrifice was formed by Brahma, and the Gods. All this he gains, when juice is shed, in the Santrâmanî sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुरावन्तं बर्हिषदꣳ सुवीरं यज्ञꣳ हिन्वन्ति महिषा नमोभिः। दधानाः सोमं दिवि देवतासु मदेमेन्द्रं यजमानाः स्वर्काः ॥३२ ॥
translation: The rite with sacred grass, wine, store of heroes, the mighty ones speed on with adorations. May we, sweet-singing sacrificers, setting Soma mid Gods in heaven, give joy to Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते रसः सम्भृतऽओषधीषु सोमस्य शुष्मः सुरया सुतस्य। तेन जिन्व यजमानं मदेन सरस्वतीमश्विनाविन्द्रमग्निम् ॥३३ ॥
translation: All essence of thine own in plants collected, all strength of Soma when poured out with Surâ— Therewith impel with joy the sacrifice, Sarasvatî, the Asvins, Indra, Agni.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमश्विना नमुचेरासुरादधि सरस्वत्यसुनोदिन्द्रियाय। इमं तꣳ शुक्रं मधुमन्तमिन्दुꣳ सोमꣳ राजानमिह भक्षयामि ॥३४ ॥
translation: That which Sarasvatî poured out for Indra, by Asvins brought from Namuchi the demon, This flowing drop, brilliant and full of sweetness, I drink and feed on here, the King, the Soma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदत्र रिप्तꣳ रसिनः सुतस्य यदिन्द्रोऽअपिबच्छचीभिः। अहं तदस्य मनसा शिवेन सोमꣳ राजानमिह भक्षयामि ॥३५ ॥
translation: Whatever portion of the savoury fluid is clinging here, what Indra drank with powers, That drop thereof with pure and holy spirit I drink and feed upon, the King, the Soma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पितृभ्यः स्वधायिभ्यः स्वधा नमः पितामहेभ्यः स्वधायिभ्यः स्वधा नमः प्रपितामहेभ्यः स्वधायिभ्यः स्वधा नमः। अक्षन् पितरोऽमीमदन्त पितरोऽतीतृपन्त पितरः पितरः शुन्धध्वम् ॥३६ ॥
translation: To Fathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Great-grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! The Fathers have eaten. The Fathers have rejoiced. The Fathers have been satisfied, Fathers, be ye purified. 79
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनन्तु मा पितरः सोम्यासः पुनन्तु मा पितामहाः पुनन्तु प्रपितामहाः। पवित्रेण शतायुषा। पुनन्तु मा पितामहाः पुनन्तु प्रपितामहाः। पवित्रेण शतायुषा विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नवै ॥३७ ॥
translation: Cleanse me the Fathers who enjoy Soma! Grandfathers make me clean! May Great- grandfathers cleanse me with a sieve that brings a century. May my Grandfathers cleanse me, may my Great-grand-fathers make me clean. With sieve that brings a century may I obtain full length of life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्नऽआयूषि पवसऽआ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः। आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् ॥३८ ॥
translation: Agni, thou poorest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength. Drive thou misfortune far away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनन्तु मा देवजनाः पुनन्तु मनसा धियः। पुनन्तु विश्वा भूतानि जातवेदः पुनीहि मा ॥३९ ॥
translation: Cleanse me the companies of Gods! May thoughts with spirit make me clean. Cleanse me all things that be! Do thou, O Jâtavedas, make me clean.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवित्रेण पुनीहि मा शुक्रेण देव दीद्यत्। अग्ने क्रत्वा क्रतूँ२ऽरनु ॥४० ॥
translation: Purify me, O Agni, God, refulgent with thy pure bright sieve, With powers according to thine own.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिष्यग्ने विततमन्तरा। ब्रह्म तेन पुनातु मा ॥४१ ॥
translation: O Agni, may the cleansing sieve, diffused through all thy fiery glow, Holy devotion, make me clean.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानः सोऽअद्य नः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः। यः पोता स पुनातु मा ॥४२ ॥
translation: May Pavamâna with his sieve, Guest of all tribes, cleanse us to-day, He who is Cleanser make us clean.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च। मां पुनीहि विश्वतः ॥४३ ॥
translation: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power, Purify me on every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वैश्वदेवी पुनती देव्यागाद् यस्यामिमा बह्व्यस्तन्वो वीतपृष्ठाः। तया मदन्तः सधमादेषु वय स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥४४ ॥
translation: Dear to all Gods hath come the cleansing Goddess, she who contains these many smooth- backed figures. Through her may we in sacrificial banquets taking our pleasure be the lords of riches.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये समानाः समनसः पितरो यमराज्ये। तेषां लोकः स्वधा नमो यज्ञो देवेषु कल्पताम् ॥४५ ॥
translation: The Fathers who in Yama’s realm are equal and unanimous— Their world is Svadhâ, reverence. To Gods let sacrifice be paid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये समानाः समनसो जीवा जीवेषु मामकाः। तेषा श्रीर्मयि कल्पतामस्मिँल्लोके शतꣳ समाः ॥४६ ॥
translation: Equals, unanimous, my folk yet living among those who live— On me be set their glory through a hundred years in this our world.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्वे सृतीऽअशृणवं पितॄणामहं देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम्। ताभ्यामिदं विश्वमेजत्समेति यदन्तरा पितरं मातरं च ॥४७ ॥
translation: I have heard mention of two several pathways, way of the Fathers, way of Gods and mortals. On these two roads each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदꣳ हविः प्रजननं मेऽअस्तु दशवीरꣳ सर्वगण स्वस्तये। आत्मसनि प्रजासनि पशुसनि लोकसन्यभयसनि। अग्निः प्रजां बहुलां मे करोत्वन्नं पयो रेतोऽअस्मासु धत्त ॥४८ ॥
translation: May this my sacrifice bring store of children, with ten brave sons, full-companied, for welfare— Life-winning, winning offspring, winning cattle, winning this world of ours and peace and safety. May Agni make nay progeny abundant. Do ye confer food, milk, and wanly vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदीरतामवरऽउत्परासऽउन्मध्यमाः पितरः सोम्यासः। असुं यऽईयुरवृकाऽऋतज्ञास्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु ॥४९ ॥
translation: May they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma. May Fathers who have gained the world of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अङ्गिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वाऽअथर्वाणो भृगवः सोम्यासः। तेषां वयꣳ सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ॥५० ॥
translation: Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrigus, who deserve the Soma. May these the holy look on us with favour: may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये नः पूर्वे पितरः सोम्यासोऽनूहिरे सोमपीथं वसिष्ठाः। तेभिर्यमः सꣳरराणो हवीष्युशन्नुशद्भिः प्रतिकाममत्तु ॥५१ ॥
translation: Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet— With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳसोम प्र चिकितो मनीषा त्वꣳ रजिष्ठमनु नेषि पन्थाम्। तव प्रणीती पितरो नऽइन्दो देवेषु रत्नमभजन्त धीराः ॥५२ ॥
translation: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom: along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our prudent Fathers by thy wisdom, Soma, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वया हि नः पितरः सोम पूर्वे कर्माणि चक्रुः पवमान धीराः। वन्वन्नवातः परिधीँ१ऽरपोर्णु वीरेभिरश्वैर्मघवा भवा नः ॥५३ ॥
