translation: For our sage Fathers, Soma Pavamâna, of old performed by thee their sacred duties. Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ सोम पितृभिः संविदानोऽनु द्यावापृथिवीऽआ ततन्थ। तस्मै तऽइन्दो हविषा विधेम वय स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥५४ ॥
translation: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven. So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches. 80
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बर्हिषदः पितरऽऊत्यर्वागिमा वो हव्या चकृमा जुषध्वम्। तऽआगतावसा शन्तमेनाथा नः शंयोररपो दधात ॥५५ ॥
translation: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come help us: these offerings we have made for you; accept them. So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आहं पितॄन्त्सुविदत्राँ२ऽअवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं च विष्णोः। बर्हिषदो ये स्वधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्तऽइहागमिष्ठाः ॥५६ ॥
translation: I have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, have gained a son and progeny from Vishnu. They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation, seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपहूताः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येषु निधिषु प्रियेषु। तऽआगमन्तु तऽइह श्रुवन्त्वधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान् ॥५७ ॥
translation: May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यन्तु नः पितरः सोम्यासोऽग्निष्वात्ताः पथिभिर्देवयानैः। अस्मिन् यज्ञे स्वधया मदन्तोऽधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान् ॥५८ ॥
translation: May they our Fathers whom the flames have tasted, worthy of Soma, come on God-ward pathways. Enjoying at this sacrifice their portion, may they be gracious unto us and bless us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निष्वात्ताः पितरऽएह गच्छत सदःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः। अत्ता हवीषि प्रयतानि बर्हिष्यथा रयिꣳ सर्ववीरं दधातन ॥५९ ॥
translation: Fathers whom Agni’s flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place. Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येऽअग्निष्वात्ता येऽअनग्निष्वात्ता मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयन्ते। तेभ्यः स्वराडसुनीतिमेतां यथावशं तन्वं कल्पयाति ॥६० ॥
translation: For those who, burnt with fire or not cremated, joy in their portion in the midst of heaven, May the Self-Ruler form the world of spirits and this their body as his pleasure wills it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निष्वात्तानृतुमतो हवामहे नाराशꣳसे सोमपीथं यऽआशुः। ते नो विप्रासः सुहवा भवन्तु वय स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥६१ ॥
translation: We call the Agnishvâttas, true to seasons, those who drank Soma in the Nârâsamsa. Prompt to give ear to us be they, the sages, and then let us be lords of wealth and treasure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येमं यज्ञमभिगृणीत विश्वे। मा हिꣳसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन्नो यद्वऽआगः पुरुषता कराम ॥६२ ॥
translation: Bowing the bended knee and seated southward, accept ye, all, this sacrifice with favour. Injure us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आसीनासोऽअरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय। पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः प्रयच्छत तऽइहोर्जं दधात ॥६३ ॥
translation: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings give riches to the man who brings oblation. Grant to his sons a portion of your treasure, and, present, give us energy, ye Fathers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमग्ने कव्यवाहन त्वं चिन्मन्यसे रयिम्। तन्नो गीर्भिः श्रवाय्यं देवत्रा पनया युजम् ॥६४ ॥
translation: O Agni Kavyavâhana, cause us to praise before the Gods, As our associate meet for lauds, wealth which e’en thou reputest wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योऽअग्निः कव्यवाहनः पितॄन् यक्षदृतावृधः। प्रेदु हव्यानि वोचति देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्य आ ॥६५ ॥
translation: May Agni, Kavya-bearer, who hath worshipped Fathers true to Law. Announce to Gods and Fathers these our sacrificial offerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्नऽईडितः कव्यवाहनावाड्ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वी। प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया तेऽअक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवीषि ॥६६ ॥
translation: Thou. Agni Kavya-bearer, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant, And gayest to the Fathers who did eat them with Svadhâ. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये चेह पितरो ये च नेह याँश्च विद्म याँ२ऽउ च न प्रविद्म। त्वं वेत्थ यति ते जातवेदः स्वधाभिर्यज्ञꣳ सुकृतं जुषस्व ॥६७ ॥
translation: Thou, Jâtavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent, Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not. Accept the sacrifice arranged with portions.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं पितृभ्यो नमोऽअस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वोसो यऽउपरास ईयुः। ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषत्ता ये वा नूनꣳ सुवृजनासु विक्षु ॥६८ ॥
translation: Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed, Those who have rested in the earthly region and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा यथा नः पितरः परासः प्रत्नासोऽअग्नऽऋतमाशुषाणाः। शुचीदयन् दीधितिमुक्थशासः क्षामा भिन्दन्तोऽअरुणीरप व्रन् ॥६९ ॥
translation: As in the days of old our ancient Fathers speeding the work of holy worship, Agni! Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises, they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उशन्तस्त्वा नि धीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि। उशन्नुशतऽआ वह पितॄन् हविषेऽअत्तवे ॥७० ॥
translation: Right gladly do we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow. Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to eat the food of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिरऽइन्द्रोदवर्त्तयः। विश्वा यदजयः स्पृधः ॥७१ ॥
translation: Indra, with waters’ foam didst thou wrench off the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमो राजामृतꣳ सुतऽऋजीषेणाजहान्त्मृत्युम्। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानꣳ शुक्रमन्धसऽइन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु ॥७२ ॥
translation: King Soma, pressed, the Drink of Life, left Death behind with Soma-dregs. By Law came truth and Indra-power, the pure bright drinking-off of juice. The power of Indra was this sweet immortal milk. 81
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अद्भ्यः क्षीरं व्यपिबत् क्रुङ्ङाङ्गिरसो धिया। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानꣳशुक्रमन्धसऽइन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु ॥७३ ॥
translation: The Snipe of Angiras by thought from out the waters drank up milk. By Law came truth, etc., as in 72.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोममद्भ्यो व्यपिबच्छन्दसा हꣳसः शुचिषत्। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानꣳ शुक्रमन्धसऽइन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु ॥७४ ॥
translation: The Hamsa throned in light drank up by metre Soma from the floods. By Law, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्नात् परिस्रुतो रसं ब्रह्मणा व्यपिबत् क्षत्रं पयः सोमं प्रजापतिः। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानंꣳ शुक्रमन्धसऽइन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु ॥७५ ॥
translation: Prajâpati by Brahma drank the essence from the foaming food, the princely power, milk, Soma juice. By Law, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रेतो मूत्रं विजहाति योनिं प्रविशदिन्द्रियम्। गर्भो जरायुणावृतऽउल्बं जहाति जन्मना। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानꣳ शुक्रमन्धसऽइन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु ॥७६ ॥
translation: The generative part enters the yoni: it leaves aside the retas and the mûtra. The caul- invested embryo leaves by its birth the covering folds. By Law, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा रूपे व्याकरोत् सत्यानृते प्रजापतिः। अश्रद्धामनृतेऽदधाच्छ्रद्धा सत्ये प्रजापतिः। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानꣳ शुक्रमन्धसऽइन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु ॥७७ ॥
translation: Viewing both forms Prajâpati gave truth and falsehood different shapes. Prajâpati assigned the lack of faith to falsehood, faith to truth. By Law, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेदेन रूपे व्यपिबत् सुतासुतौ प्रजापतिः। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानꣳ शुक्रमन्धसऽइन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु ॥७८ ॥
translation: By holy lore Prajâpati drank up both forms, pressed and unpressed. By Law, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा परिस्रुतो रसꣳ शुक्रेण शुक्रं व्यपिबत् पयः सोमं प्रजापतिः। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानꣳ शुक्रमन्धसऽइन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु ॥७९ ॥
translation: Seeing the farming liquor’s sap, Prajâpati with the bright drank nut the bright the milk, the Soma juice. By Law, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सीसेन तन्त्रं मनसा मनीषिणऽऊर्णासूत्रेण कवयो वयन्ति। अश्विना यज्ञꣳ सविता सरस्वतीन्द्रस्य रूपं वरुणो भिषज्यन् ॥८० ॥
translation: Wise, with mind, lead, and thread of wool the sages twine an amulet. Sarasvatî, Savitar, Varuna, the Asvins span sacrifice and healed his form for Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदस्य रूपममृतꣳ शचीभिस्तिस्रो दधुर्देवताः सꣳरराणाः। लोमानि शष्पैर्बहुधा न तोक्मभिस्त्वगस्य मासमभवन्न लाजाः ॥८१ ॥
translation: This his immortal shape with mighty powers three Deities bestowing gifts compounded. His hair they made with sprouts of grass and barley, and roasted grain with skin and flesh supplied him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदश्विना भिषजा रुद्रवर्तनी सरस्वती वयति पेशोऽअन्तरम्। अस्थि मज्जानं मासरैः कारोतरेण दधतो गवां त्वचि ॥८२ ॥
translation: His inner shape Sarasvatî arranges and, borne on bright paths, the Physician Asvins: With Mâsaras and sieve his bone and marrow, as on the Oxen’s hide they lay the liquor.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सरस्वती मनसा पेशलं वसु नासत्याभ्यां वयति दर्शतं वपुः। रसं परिस्रुता न रोहितं नग्नहुर्धीरस्तसरं न वेम ॥८३ ॥
translation: By thought Sarasvatî with both Nâsatyas forms lovely treasure and a beauteous body. Like shuttle through the loom the steady ferment mixes the red juice with the foaming spirit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पयसा शुक्रममृतं जनित्रꣳ सुरया मूत्राज्जनयन्त रेतः। अपामतिं दुर्मतिं बाधमानाऽऊवध्यं वातꣳ सब्वं तदारात् ॥८४ ॥
translation: By milk they generated bright immortal, productive seed, by Surâ seed from urine, Chasing afar folly and ill intention, crude food and wind and meat that loads the stomach.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रः सुत्रामा हृदयेन सत्यं पुरोडशेन सविता जजान। यकृत् क्लोमानं वरुणो भिषज्यन् मतस्ने वायव्यैर्न मिनाति पित्तम् ॥८५ ॥
translation: Heart with his heart Indra Good Guardian gendered: with rice-cake Savitar gave truth its being. Varuna, doctoring the lungs and liver, forms, as with Vâyu cups, the gall and kidneys.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आन्त्राणि स्थालीर्मधु पिन्वमाना गुदाः पात्राणि सुदुघा न धेनुः। श्येनस्य पत्रं न प्लीहा शचीभिरासन्दी नाभिरुदरं न माता ॥८६ ॥
translation: Cooking-pots pouring honey were the entrails: like a well-milking cow the pans were bowels. A hawk’s wing was the spleen: through mighty powers the stool as mother was navel and belly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुम्भो वनिष्ठुर्जनिता शचीभिर्यस्मिन्नग्रे योन्यां गर्भोऽअन्तः। प्लाशिर्व्यक्तः शतधारऽउत्सो दुहे न कुम्भी स्वधां पितृभ्यः ॥८७ ॥
translation: The pitcher was the father of the rectum by powers, the womb which first contained the infant. Plain was the hundred-streaming fount as penis: the jar poured forth libations to the Father.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मुखꣳ सदस्य शिरऽइत् सतेन जिह्वा पवित्रमश्विनासन्त्सरस्वती। चप्यं न पायुर्भिषगस्य वालो वस्तिर्न शेपो हरसा तरस्वी ॥८८ ॥
translation: His face the basket, thence his head; the strainer his tongue, his mouth Sarasvatî and Asvins. The Chapya was his rump, his leech the filter, the bladder was his penis keen with ardour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विभ्यां चक्षुरमृतं ग्रहाभ्यां छागेन तेजो हविषा शृतेन। पक्ष्माणि गोधूमैः कुवलैरुतानि पेशो न शुक्रमसितं वसाते ॥८९ ॥
translation: Asvins with both cups made his eye immortal, the goat and cooked oblation gave it keenness. With wheat eyelashes and with jujube eyebrows they clothe as ‘twere a black and brilliant figure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अविर्न मेषो नसि वीर्याय प्राणस्य पन्थाऽअमृतो ग्रहाभ्याम्। सरस्वत्युपवाकैर्व्यानं नस्यानि बर्हिर्बदरैर्जजान ॥९० ॥
translation: The sheep, the ram to give his nostril vigour. the immortal path of breath by both libations. By Indra-grains and sacrificial jujubes Sarasvatî produced through-breath and nose hairs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य रूपमृषभो बलाय कर्णाभ्या श्रोत्रममृतं ग्रहाभ्याम्। यवा न बर्हिर्भ्रुवि केसराणि कर्कन्धु जज्ञे मधु सारघं मुखात् ॥९१ ॥
translation: The hull for strength made Indra’s form: the immortal bearing for both his ears by two libations. Barley and sacred grass composed his eyebrows: from his mouth came the jujube and sweet honey. 82
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आत्मन्नुपस्थे न वृकस्य लोम मुखे श्मश्रूणि न व्याघ्रलोम। केशा न शीर्षन् यशसे श्रियै शिखा सिꣳहस्य लोम त्विषिरिन्द्रियाणि ॥९२ ॥
translation: Hair of the wolf was on his waist and body: the beard upon his face was hair of tigers. Lions hair were his locks, for fame and beauty, worn on his head, his crest and sheen and vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अङ्गान्यात्मन् भिषजा तदश्विनात्मानमङ्गैः समधात् सरस्वती। इन्द्रस्य रूपꣳ शतमानमायुश्चन्द्रेण ज्योतिरमृतं दधानाः ॥९३ ॥
translation: The Asvins, Leeches, joined his limbs and body, Sarasvatî put limbs and frame together, Giving the form and vital power of Indra, hundredfold, deathless and delightful lustre.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सरस्वती योन्यां गर्भमन्तरश्विभ्यां पत्नी सुकृतं बिभर्ति। अपा रसेन वरुणो न साम्नेन्द्र श्रियै जनयन्नप्सु राजा ॥९४ ॥
translation: Sarasvatî, as Consort of the Asvins, bears in her womb the nobly fashioned Infant. King Varuna with waters’ wealthy essence begetting Indra in the floods for glory.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तेजः पशूना हविरिन्द्रियावत् परिस्रुता पयसा सारघं मधु। अश्विभ्यां दुग्धं भिषजा सरस्वत्या सुतासुताभ्याममृतः सोमऽइन्दुः ॥९५ ॥
translation: Splendour of victims, powerful oblation, honey and meath with milk and foaming liquor, Healing Sarasvatî effused, and Asvins; from pressed and unpressed Soma, deathless Indu. 83
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्षत्रस्य योनिरसि क्षत्रस्य नाभिरसि। मा त्वा हिꣳसीन्मा मा हिꣳसीः ॥१ ॥
translation: BIRTH PLACE of princely power art thou: centre art thou of princely power. Harm not thyself: do me no harm.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: निषसाद धृतव्रतो वरुणः पस्त्यास्वा। साम्राज्याय सुक्रतुः। मृत्योः पाहि विद्योत् पाहि ॥२ ॥
translation: Varuna, Law’s maintainer, hath sat down, etc., as in X. 27. Save me from death. Save me from lightning.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। अश्विनोर्भैषज्येन तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसायाभि षिञ्चामि सरस्वत्यै भैषज्येन वीर्यायान्नाद्यायाभि षिञ्चामीन्द्रस्येन्द्रियेण बलाय श्रियै यशसेऽभि षिञ्चामि ॥३ ॥
translation: Thee, by the radiant Savitar’s impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, With leech-craft of the Asvins, I besprinkle for splendour, for the lustre of a Brâhman; With leech-craft of Sarasvatî, besprinkle for manly vigour and for food to feed thee; Besprinkle thee, by special power of Indra, for strength of body and for fame and glory.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कोऽसि कतमोऽसि कस्मै त्वा काय त्वा। सुश्लोक सुमङ्गल सत्यराजन् ॥४ ॥
translation: Thou art Ka. Noblest Ka art thou. Thee for the state and rank of Ka. Sumangala! Susloka! Satyarâjan!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिरो मे श्रीर्यशो मुखं त्विषिः केशाश्च श्मश्रूणि। राजा मे प्राणोऽअमृतꣳ सम्राट् चक्षुर्विराट् श्रोत्रम् ॥५ ॥
translation: My head be grace, my mouth be fame, my hair and beard be brilliant sheen! My breath be King and deathlessness, mine eye Sole Lord, mine ear the Prince!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जिह्वा मे भद्रं वाङ् महो मनो मन्युः स्वराड् भामः। मोदाः प्रमोदा अङ्गुलीरङ्गानि मित्रं मे सहः ॥६ ॥
translation: My tongue be bliss, my voice be might, my mind be wrath, my rage self-lord! Joys be my fingers, and delight my members, conquering strength my friend!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बाहू मे बलमिन्द्रियꣳ हस्तौ मे कर्म वीर्यम्। आत्मा क्षत्रमुरो मम ॥७ ॥
translation: Let my two arms be Indra’s power, my hands be deed of manly might, my soul and breast be princely rule! neck
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पृष्ठीर्मे राष्ट्रमुदरमꣳसौ ग्रीवाश्च श्रोणी। ऊरूऽअरत्नी जानुनी विशो मेऽङ्गानि सर्वतः ॥८ ॥
translation: My ribs be royal government, my belly, shoulders, neck, and hips, Thighs, elbows, knees, the people, yea, my members universally!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाभिर्मे चित्तं विज्ञानं पायुर्मेऽपचितिर्भसत्। आनन्दनन्दावाण्डौ मे भगः सौभाग्यं पसः। जङ्घाभ्यां पद्भ्यां धर्मोऽस्मि विशि राजा प्रतिष्ठितः ॥९ ॥
translation: My navel intellect, etc., etc. ... ... ... ... Duty am I in legs and feet, established King among the folk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति क्षत्रे प्रति तिष्ठामि राष्ट्रे प्रत्यश्वेषु प्रति तिष्ठामि गोषु। प्रत्यङ्गेषु प्रति तिष्ठाम्यात्मन् प्रति प्राणेषु प्रति तिष्ठामि पुष्टे प्रति द्यावापृथिव्योः प्रति तिष्ठामि यज्ञे ॥१० ॥
translation: I take my stand on princely power and Kingship, on cows am I dependent, and on horses. on vital breath On members I depend, and on the body, dependent and on welfare, on heaven and earth and sacrifice dependent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रया देवा एकादश त्रयस्त्रिꣳशाः सुराधसः। बृहस्पतिपुरोहिता देवस्य सवितुः सवे। देवा देवैरवन्तु मा ॥११ ॥
translation: May Deities, eleven threes, the three and thirty bounteous Ones Whose House-Priest is Brihaspati, by impulse of bright Savitar, the Gods protect me with the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रथमा द्वितीयैर्द्वितीयास्तृतीयैस्तृतीयाः सत्येन सत्यं यज्ञेन यज्ञो यजुर्भिर्यजूषि सामभिः सामान्यृग्भिर्ऋचः। पुरोऽनुवाक्याभिः पुरोऽनुवाक्या याज्याभिर्याज्या वषट्कारैर्वषट्काराऽ आहुतिभिराहुतयो मे कामान्त्समर्धयन्तु भूः स्वाहा ॥१२ ॥
translation: May the first Gods with the second, the second with the third, the third with Truth, Truth with Sacrifice, Sacrifice with sacrificial texts, sacrificial texts with Sâmans, Sâmans with praise-verses, praise-verses with fore and after-sentences. fore-sentences with inviting-texts, inviting-texts with Vashat-calls, Vashat calls with oblations, and oblations, fulfil my desires, Earth! All-hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: लोमानि प्रयतिर्मम त्वङ् मऽआनतिरागतिः। मासं मऽउपनतिर्वस्वस्थि मज्जा मऽआनतिः ॥१३ ॥
translation: My hair is effort and attempt, my skin is reverence and approach. My flesh is inclination, wealth my bone, my marrow reverence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्देवा देवहेडनं देवासश्चकृमा वयम्। अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसो विश्वान्मुञ्चत्वꣳहसः ॥१४ ॥
translation: Gods, Deities, whatever fault of ours have stirred the wrath of Gods, May Agni set me free from that iniquity and all distress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदि दिवा यदि नक्तमेनासि चकृमा वयम्। वायुर्मा तस्मादेनसो विश्वान्मुञ्चत्वꣳहसः ॥१५ ॥
translation: If in the day-time or at night we have committed acts of sin, May Vâyu set me free from that iniquity and all distress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदि जाग्रद् यदि स्वप्नऽएनासि चकृमा वयम्। सूर्यो मा तस्मादेनसो विश्वान्मुञ्चत्वꣳहसः ॥१६ ॥
translation: If when awake or in our sleep we have committed acts of sin, May Sûrya set me free from that iniquity and all distress. 84
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद् ग्रामे यदरण्ये यत्सभायां यदिन्द्रिये। यच्छूद्रे यदर्ये यदेनश्चकृमा वयं यदेकस्याधि धर्मणि तस्यावयजनमसि ॥१७ ॥
translation: Each fault in village or in wild, company or corporeal sense, Each sinful act that we have done to Sûdra or Arya, or to either’s disadvantage, e’en of that sin thou art the expiation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदापोऽअघ्न्या इति वरुणेति शपामहे ततो वरुण नो मुञ्च। अवभृथ निचुम्पुण निचेरुरसि निचुम्पुणः। अव देवैर्देवकृतमेनोऽयक्ष्यव मर्त्यैर्मर्त्यकृतं पुरुराव्णो देव रिषस्पाहि ॥१८ ॥
translation: Waters, Inviolable ones, etc. Said to be repeated from VI. 22. O ever-moving Cleansing Bath, etc. Repeated from III. 48.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रे ते हृदयमप्स्वन्तः सं त्वा विशन्त्वोषधीरुतापः। सुमित्रिया नऽआपऽओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः ॥१९ ॥
translation: Thy heart is in the flood, etc. Repeated from VIII. 25. To us let Waters, etc. Repeated from VI. 22.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्रुपदादिव मुमुचानः स्विन्नः स्नातो मलादिव। पूतं पवित्रेणेवाज्यमापः शुन्धन्तु मैनसः ॥२० ॥
translation: As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath purged, let water clean me from my sin.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्वयं तमसस्परि स्वः पश्यन्त उत्तरम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम् ॥२१ ॥
translation: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपोऽअद्यान्वचारिषꣳ रसेन समसृक्ष्महि। पयस्वाग्नऽआगमं तं मा सꣳसृज वर्चसा प्रजया च धनेन च ॥२२ ॥
translation: The waters I this day have sought, and to their essence have we come. Agni, come hither rich in milk, splendour and brilliancy bestow on me, and progeny and wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एधोऽस्येधिषीमहि समिदसि तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धेहि। समाववर्ति पृथिवी समुषाः समु सूर्यः। समु विश्वमिदं जगत्। वैश्वानरज्योतिर्भूयासं विभून् कामान् व्यश्नवै भूः स्वाहा ॥२३ ॥
translation: A brand art thou: fain would we thrive. Fuel art thou and splendour: give me splendour. Earth comes again, the Dawn, the Sun. This Universe all comes again. May I possess Vaisvânara’s light, may I attain my vast desires. Earth! All-hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यादधामि समिधमग्ने व्रतपते त्वयि। व्रतं च श्रद्धां चोपैमीन्धे त्वा दीक्षितोऽअहम् ॥२४ ॥
translation: O Agni, Master of the Vow, on thee I lay the kindling- stick. To the fast-vow and faith I come. I, consecrated, kindle thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्र ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च सम्यञ्चौ चरतः सह। तं लोकं पुण्यं प्रज्ञेषं यत्र देवाः सहाग्निना ॥२५ ॥
translation: Fain would I know that holy world where Deities with Agni dwell, Where priestly rank and princely power together in accordance move.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्रेन्द्रश्च वायुश्च सम्यञ्चौ चरतः सह। तं लोकं पुण्यं प्रज्ञेषं यत्र सेदिर्न विद्यते ॥२६ ॥
translation: Fain would I know that holy world where want and languor are unknown, Where in complete accordance move Indra and Vâyu side by side
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अꣳशुना ते अꣳशुः पृच्यतां परुषा परुः। गन्धस्ते सोममवतु मदाय रसोऽअच्युतः ॥२७ ॥
translation: Let thy shoot be united with his tendril, joint combine with joint. Imperishable sap for joy, thine odour be the Soma’s guard!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सिञ्चन्ति परि षिञ्चन्त्युत्सिञ्चन्ति पुनन्ति च। सुरायै बभ्र्वै मदे किन्त्वो वदति किन्त्वः ॥२८ ॥
translation: They pour it out, they sprinkle it, they scatter it, they make it pure. In the brown Surâ’s ecstasy he says What art thou? What art thou?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम्। इन्द्र प्रातर्जुषस्व नः ॥२९ ॥
translation: Indra, at morn accept our cake accompanied with grain and groats, with wheaten bread and hymns of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम्। येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि ॥३० ॥
translation: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts? that slayeth Vritra best, Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the radiant light that never dies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध्वर्योऽअद्रिभिः सुतꣳ सोमं पवित्रऽआ नय। पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥३१ ॥
translation: Adhvaryu, on the straining cloth pour thou the Soma pressed with stones: Purify it for Indra’s drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो भूतानामधिपतिर्यस्मिँल्लोकाऽअधि श्रिताः। यऽईशे महतो महाँस्तेन गृह्णामि त्वामहं मयि गृह्णामि त्वामहम् ॥३२ ॥
translation: The Sovran Lord of living things, he upon whom the worlds depend, Mighty, the mighty’s King—by him I take thee, take thee on myself.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपयामगृहीतोस्यश्विभ्यां त्वा सरस्वत्यै त्वेन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्णऽएष ते योनिरश्विभ्यां त्वा सरस्वत्यै त्वेन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्णे ॥३३ ॥
translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राणपा मेऽअपानपाश्चक्षुष्पाः श्रोत्रपाश्च मे। वाचो मे विश्वभेषजो मनसोऽसि विलायकः ॥३४ ॥
translation: Guard of my breath and outward breath, the guardian of mine eye and ear, All-healer of my voice, thou. art the mollifier of my mind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विनकृतस्य ते सरस्वतिकृतस्येन्द्रेण सुत्राम्णा कृतस्य। उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि ॥३५ ॥
translation: Invited I feed upon thee invited, Whom Asvins, whom Sarasvatî, whom Indra, Good Protector, made.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिद्धऽइन्द्रऽउषसामनीके पुरोरुचा पूर्वकृद्वावृधानः। त्रिभिर्देवैस्त्रिꣳशता वज्रबाहुर्जघान वृत्रं वि दुरो ववार ॥३६ ॥
translation: Kindred in forefront of the Mornings, Indra with forward light, long-active, waxing mighty, With three-and thirty Gods, the Thunder-wielder, smote. Vritra dead and threw the portals open. 85
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नराशꣳसः प्रति शूरो मिमानस्तनूनपात् प्रति यज्ञस्य धाम। गोभिर्वपावान् मधुना समञ्जन् हिरण्यैश्चन्द्री यजति प्रचेताः ॥३७ ॥
translation: Son of Himself, the Praise of Men, the hero, measuring out the sacrificial stations, Rich in bulls’ fat, anointing with sweet butter, wise, bright with gauds of gold, he sacrificeth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईडितो देवैर्हरिवाँ२ऽअभिष्टिराजुह्वानो हविषा शर्द्धमानः। पुरन्दरो गोत्रभिद्वज्रबाहुरायातु यज्ञमुप नो जुषाणः ॥३८ ॥
translation: Lauded by Gods, Lord of Bay Steeds, the Helper, showing his greatness. worshipped with oblations. Fort-render, Cowpen-cleaver, Thunder-wielder, may he approach our sacrifice rejoicing
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जुषाणो बर्हिर्हरिवान्नऽइन्द्रः प्राचीनꣳ सीदत् प्रदिशा पृथिव्याः। उरुप्रथाः प्रथमानꣳ स्योनमादित्यैरक्तं वसुभिः सजोषाः ॥३९ ॥
translation: May Indra, Lord of Bays, sit by direction eastward on earth, accepting our oblation, And sacred grass, fair, far-spread, widely-stretching, anointed by Âdityas and by Vasus.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं दुरः कवष्यो धावमाना वृषाणं यन्तु जनयः सुपत्नीः। द्वारो देवीरभितो विश्रयन्ता सुवीरा वीरं प्रथमाना महोभिः ॥४० ॥
translation: To the strong Indra go the sounding Portals, dames with a goodly husband, swiftly moving! Well-manned, divine, wide be the Doors thrown open, expanding in their greatness fir the Hero!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उषासानक्ता बृहती बृहन्तं पयस्वती सुदुघे शूरमिन्द्रम्। तन्तुं ततं पेशसा संवयन्ती देवानां देवं यजतः सुरुक्मे ॥४१ ॥
translation: Dawn and Night, lofty, sapful, richly-yielding, fair-showing, as they weave with varied colour The long-extended thread in concert, worship the God of Gods, the lofty Hero Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दैव्या मिमाना मनुषः पुरुत्रा होताराविन्द्रं प्रथमा सुवाचा। मूर्द्धन् यज्ञस्य मधुना दधाना प्राचीनं ज्योतिर्हविषा वृधातः ॥४२ ॥
translation: The two first pleasant-voiced celestial Hotars, arranging rites for man in sundry places, At head of sacrifice stablishing Indra, increase the eastern light with sweet oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिस्रो देवीर्हविषा वर्द्धमानाऽइन्द्रं जुषाणा जनयो न पत्नीः। अच्छिन्नं तन्तुं पयसा सरस्वतीडा देवी भारती विश्वतूर्त्तिः ॥४३ ॥
translation: Thriving by sacrifice may the three Bright Ones, taking delight like wedded dames in Indra, Sarasvatî, Idâ, Bhâratî all-surpassing, with milk preserve our sacred thread unbroken.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वष्टा दधच्छुष्ममिन्द्राय वृष्णेऽपाकोऽचिष्टुर्यशसे पुरूणि। वृषा यजन्वृषणं भूरिरेता मूर्द्धन् यज्ञस्य समनक्तु देवान् ॥४४ ॥
translation: May Tvashtar coming frail afar, the active, give strength and plenty to strong glorious Indra, And strong, prolific, worshipping, the Mighty at sacrifice’s head give the Gods honour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वनस्पतिरवसृष्टो न पाशैस्त्मन्या समञ्जञ्छमिता न देवः। इन्द्रस्य हव्यैर्जठरं पृणानः स्वदाति यज्ञं मधुना घृतेन ॥४५ ॥
translation: Let the divine Stake, like an Immolator, bind, as one ordered, to himself the victim, And, filling Indra’s belly with ablations, season the sacrifice with sweets and butter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तोकानामिन्दुं प्रति शूरऽइन्द्रो वृषायमाणो वृषभस्तुराषाट्। घृतप्रुषा मनसा मोदमानाः स्वाहा देवाऽअमृता मादयन्ताम् ॥४६ ॥
translation: Indra the Bull, swift conqueror, wildly rushing bull-like to meet the Indu of the droppings— Delighting in a mind that scatters fatness, let the immortal Gods rejoice in Svâhâ.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयात्विन्द्रोऽवसऽउप नऽइह स्तुतः सधमादस्तु शूरः। वावृधानस्तविषीर्यस्य पूर्वीर्द्यौर्न क्षत्रमभिभूति पुष्यात् ॥४७ ॥
translation: May Indra come to us for our protection, here, lauded Hero, be our feast-companion. May he whose powers are many, waxen mighty, cherish, like Dyaus, the sovran sway of princes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नऽइन्द्रो दूरादा नऽआसादभिष्टिकृदवसे यासदुग्रः। ओजिष्ठेभिर्नृपतिर्वज्रबाहुः सङ्गे समत्सु तुर्वणिः पृतन्यून् ॥४८ ॥
translation: From near or far away may mighty Indra, giver of succour, come for our protection, Lord of men, armed with thunder, with the Strongest, slaying his foes in conflict, in the battles.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नऽइन्द्रो हरिभिर्यात्वच्छार्वाचीनोऽवसे राधसे च। तिष्ठाति वज्री मघवा विरप्शीमं यज्ञमनु नो वाजसातौ ॥४९ ॥
translation: May Indra come to us with Tawny Coursers, inclined to us, to favour and enrich us. May Maghavan, loud-voiced and wielding thunder, stand by us at this sacrifice, in combat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रातारमिन्द्रमवितारमिन्द्रꣳ हवेहवे सुहवꣳ शूरमिन्द्रम्। ह्वयामि शक्रं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रꣳ स्वस्ति नो मघवा धात्विन्द्रः ॥५० ॥
translation: Indra the Rescuer, Indra the Helper, Hero who listens at each invocation, Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra, Bounteous Lord, prosper and bless us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ२ऽअवोभिः सुमृडीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः। बाधतां द्वेषोऽअभयं कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥५१ ॥
translation: May helpful Indra as our Good Protector, Lord of all treasures, favour us with succour, Baffle our foes and give us rest and safety, and may we be the lords of hero vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्य वयꣳ सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम। स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ२ऽइन्द्रोऽअस्मेऽआराच्चिद् द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु ॥५२ ॥
translation: May we enjoy the grace of him the Holy, yea, may we dwell in his auspicious favour. May helpful Indra as our Good Preserver drive from us even from afar, our foemen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः। मा त्वा के चिन्नि यमन् विं न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताँ२ऽइहि ॥५३ ॥
translation: Come hither, Indra, with Bay Steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock plumes, Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o’er them as o’er desert lands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवेदिन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुं वसिष्ठासोऽअभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः। स नः स्तुतो वीरवद्धातु गोमद् यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥५४ ॥
translation: Verily the Vasishthas hymn with praises Indra the mighty One whose arm wields thunder. Praised, may he guard our wealth in men and cattle. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिद्धोऽअग्निरश्विना तप्तो घर्मो विराट् सुतः। दुहे धेनुः सरस्वती सोमꣳ शुक्रमिहेन्द्रियम् ॥५५ ॥
translation: Fire hath been kindled, Asvins Twain! the Gharma warmed, the Radiant pressed, Here the Milch-Cow Sarasvatî hath poured bright Soma, Indra’s own. 86
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तनूपा भिषजा सुतेऽश्विनोभा सरस्वती। मध्वा रजासीन्द्रियमिन्द्राय पथिभिर्वहान् ॥५६ ॥
translation: When Soma flows Sarasvatî and both the Asvins, Leeches and Body-guards, bear to Indra strength by passage through the realms of air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रायेन्दुꣳ सरस्वती नराशꣳसेन नग्नहुम्। अधातामश्विना मधु भेषजं भिषजा सुते ॥५७ ॥
translation: When Soma flowed the Asvins Twain, the Leeches, brought sweet medicine, With Men’s Desire Sarasvatî for Indra, Soma, Nagnahu.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आजुह्वाना सरस्वतीन्द्रायेन्द्रियाणि वीर्यम्। इडाभिरश्विनाविषꣳ समूर्जꣳ सꣳ रयिं दधुः ॥५८ ॥
translation: Worshipped, Sarasvatî bestowed on Indra, senses, manly power. The Asvins, through oblations paid, combined food, energy, and wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना नमुचेः सुतꣳ सोमꣳ शुक्रं परिस्रुता। सरस्वती तमाभरद् बर्हिषेन्द्राय पातवे ॥५९ ॥
translation: The Asvins brought from Namuchi pressed Soma bright with foaming juice. Sarasvatî with sacred grass brought that to Indra for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कवष्यो न व्यचस्वतीरश्विभ्यां न दुरो दिशः। इन्द्रो न रोदसीऽउभे दुहे कामान्त्सरस्वती ॥६० ॥
translation: Sarasvatî and Indra with the Asvins Twain milked out desires From heaven and earth, the regions, the resounding and expansive doors.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उषासानक्तमश्विना दिवेन्द्रꣳ सायमिन्द्रियैः। संजानाने सुपेशसा समञ्जाते सरस्वत्या ॥६१ ॥
translation: Ye Asvins, Dawn and Night, by day and in the evening, fair of hue, Accordant, with Sarasvatî, deck Indra with surpassing powers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पातं नोऽअश्विना दिवा पाहि नक्तꣳ सरस्वति। दैव्या होतारा भिषजा पातमिन्द्रꣳ सचा सुते ॥६२ ॥
translation: Guard us, O Asvins, through the day, guards us by night, Sarasvatî. Celestial Hotars, Leeches! both guard Indra when the juice is pressed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिस्रस्त्रेधा सरस्वत्यश्विना भारतीडा। तीव्रं परिस्रुता सोममिन्द्राय सुषुवुर्मदम् ॥६३ ॥
translation: The Asvins, and the Three, apart, Sarasvatî, Idâ, Bhâratî, As drink to gladden Indra, poured strong Soma with the foaming juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना भेषजं मधु भेषजं नः सरस्वती। इन्द्रे त्वष्टा यशः श्रियꣳ रूपꣳरूपमधुः सुते ॥६४ ॥
translation: The Asvins, our Sarasvatî, and Tvashtar, when the juice was shed, Gave Indra balm, yea, mead as balm, glory and fame and many a shape.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतुथेन्द्रो वनस्पतिः शशमानः परिस्रुता। कीलालमश्विम्यां मधु दुहे धेनुः सरस्वती ॥६५ ॥
translation: Praising with foaming liquor at due times, Indra, Vanaspatî, Sarasvatî as cow gave forth sweet beverage with the Asvins Twain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोभिर्न सोममश्विना मासरेण परिस्रुता। समधातꣳ सरस्वत्या स्वाहेन्द्रे सुतं मधु ॥६६ ॥
translation: Asvins, to Indra ye with cows, with Mâsara and foaming drink Gave, with Sarasvatî—All hail!—the pressed-out Soma juice and mead.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना हविरिन्द्रियं नमुचेर्धिया सरस्वती। आ शुक्रमासुराद्वसु मघमिन्द्राय जभ्रिरे ॥६७ ॥
translation: The Asvins and Sarasvatî by wit from fiendish Namuchi Brought unto Indra sacred food, strength, brilliant treasure, ample wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमश्विना सरस्वती हविषेन्द्रमवर्द्धयन्। स बिभेद बलं मघं नमुचावासुरे सचा ॥६८ ॥
translation: That Indra, strong through sacrifice by Asvins and Sarasvatî, Cleft Vala through to win him wealth, with Namuchi of Asura birth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं पशवः सचाश्विनोभा सरस्वती। दधाना अभ्यनूषत हविषा यज्ञऽइन्द्रियैः ॥६९ ॥
translation: Supporting him in sacrifice with sacred food and mighty powers, Sarasvatî, both Asvins and the cattle hymned that Indra’s praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यऽइन्द्रऽइन्द्रियं दधुः सविता वरुणो भगः। स सुत्रामा हविष्पतिर्यजमानाय सश्चत ॥७० ॥
translation: Indra whom Bhaga, Savitar, and Varuna supplied with power, Lord of the sacrifice, may he, Good Guardian, love the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सविता वरुणो दधद् यजमानाय दाशुषे। आदत्त नमुचेर्वसु सुत्रामा बलमिन्द्रियम् ॥७१ ॥
translation: Savitar, Varuna bestow gifts on the liberal offerer, Strength, power and treasure which the Good Protector took from Namuchi!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वरुणः क्षत्रमिन्द्रियं भगेन सविता श्रियम्। सुत्रामा यशसा बलं दधाना यज्ञमाशत ॥७२ ॥
translation: Varuna giving sway and power, Savitar grace with happiness, The Good Protector giving strength with fame, obtained the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना गोभिरिन्द्रियमश्वेभिर्वीर्यं बलम्। हविषेन्द्रꣳ सरस्वती यजमानमवर्द्धयन् ॥७३ ॥
translation: With cows the Asvins, mighty power, with horses manly vigour, strength, With sacred food Sarasvatî, made Indra, Sacrificer, strong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता नासत्या सुपेशसा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी नरा। सरस्वती हविष्मतीन्द्र कर्मसु नोऽवत ॥७४ ॥
translation: May those Nâsatyas, fair of form, the Men who ride on paths of gold, Oblation-rich Sarasvatî, thou, Indra! help us in our rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता भिषजा सुकर्मणा सा सुदुघा सरस्वती। स वृत्रहा शतक्रतुरिन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियम् ॥७५ ॥
translation: Those Leeches righteous in their deeds, She, rich in milk, Sarasvatî, That Vritra-Mayer hundred-powered, invested Indra with his might. 87
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवꣳ सुराममश्विना नमुचावासुरे सचा। विपिपानाः सरस्वतीन्द्रं कर्मस्वावत ॥७६ ॥
translation: Ye Asvins and Sarasvatî, joint drinkers of the Sara draught, In Namuchi of Asura birth, give aid to Indra in his deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुत्रमिव पितरावश्विनोभेन्द्रावथुः काव्यैर्दꣳसनाभिः। यत्सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक् ॥७७ ॥
translation: As parents aid a son, etc., as in X. 34.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मिन्नश्वासऽऋषभासऽउक्षणो वशा मेषाऽअवसृष्टासऽआहुताः। कीलालपे सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे हृदा मतिं जनय चारुमग्नये ॥७८ ॥
translation: He in whom horses, bulls, oxen, and barren cows, and rams, when duly set apart, are offered up, To Agni, Soma-sprinkled, drinker of sweet juice, Disposer, with thy heart bring forth a pleasant hymn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहाव्यग्ने हविरास्ये ते स्रुचीव घृतं चम्वीव सोमः। वाजसनिꣳ रयिमस्मे सुवीरं प्रशस्तं धेहि यशसं बृहन्तम् ॥७९ ॥
translation: Within thy mouth is poured the offering, Agni, as Soma into cup, oil into ladle. Vouchsafe us wealth, strength-winning, blest with heroes, wealth lofty, praised by men, and full of splendour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना तेजसा चक्षुः प्राणेन सरस्वती वीर्यम्। वाचेन्द्रो बलेनेन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियम् ॥८० ॥
translation: The Asvins gave, with lustre, sight, Sarasvatî manly strength with breath. Indra with voice and might gave Indra vigorous power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोमदू षु णासत्याश्वावद्यातमश्विना। वर्त्ती रुद्रा नृपाय्यम् ॥८१ ॥
translation: With kine, Nâsatyas! and with steeds, come, Asvins, Rudras! to the house, the sure protector of its men;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न यत्परो नान्तरऽआदधर्षद् वृषण्वसू। दुःशꣳसो मर्त्यो रिपुः ॥८२ ॥
translation: Such, wealthy Gods! as none afar or standing near to us may harm, yea, no malicious mortal foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता नऽआ वोढमश्विना रयिं पिशङ्गसन्दृशम्। धिष्ण्या वरिवोविदम् ॥८३ ॥
translation: Do ye, O longed-for Asvins, lead us on to wealth of varied form, wealth that shall bring us room and rest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती। यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ॥८४ ॥
translation: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may pure Sarasvatî desire with eager love our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चोदयित्री सूनृतानां चेतन्ती सुमतीनाम्। यज्ञं दधे सरस्वती ॥८५ ॥
translation: She who awakens sounds of joy, inspires our hymns, Sarasvatî, she hath allowed our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महोऽअर्णः सरस्वती प्र चेतयति केतुना। धियो विश्वा वि राजति ॥८६ ॥
translation: Sarasvatî, the mighty flood, she with her light illuminates, she brightens every pious thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रायाहि चित्रभानो सुताऽइमे त्वायवः। अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः ॥८७ ॥
translation: O Indra, marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, thus by fine fingers purified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रायाहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः। उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः ॥८८ ॥
translation: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers of the libation-pouring priest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रायाहि तूतुजानऽउप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः। सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः ॥८९ ॥
translation: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayer: in our libations take delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना पिबतां मधु सरस्वत्या सजोषसा। इन्द्रः सुत्रामा वृत्रहा जुषन्ता सोम्यं मधु ॥९० ॥
translation: Accordant with Sarasvatî let the two Asvins drink the meath, May Indra, Vritra-slayer, Good Guardian, accept the Soma meath. 88
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृडय। त्वामवस्युरा चके ॥१ ॥
translation: VARUNA, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this day. Longing for help I yearn for thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस्तदाशास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः। अहेडमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशꣳस मा नऽआयुः प्र मोषीः ॥२ ॥
translation: I ask this of thee with my prayer, etc., as in XVIII. 49.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं नोऽअग्ने वरुणस्य विद्वान् देवस्य हेडोऽअव यासिसीष्ठाः। यजिष्ठो वह्नितमः शोशुचानो विश्वा द्वेषासि प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत्॥३ ॥
translation: Do thou who knowest Varuna, O Agni, put far away from us the God’s displeasure. Best Sacrificer, brightest One, refulgent, remove thou far from us all those who hate us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्वं नोऽअग्नेऽवमो भवोती नेदिष्ठोऽअस्याऽउषसो व्युष्टौ। अव यक्ष्व नो वरुणꣳ रराणो वीहि मृडीकꣳ सुहवो नऽएधि ॥४ ॥
translation: Be thou the nearest unto us, O Agni, our closest Friend while now this Morn is breaking. Reconcile Varuna to us, be bounteous: show thy compassion and be swift to hear us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महीमू षु मातरꣳ सुव्रतानामृतस्य पत्नीमवसे हुवेम। तुविक्षत्रामजरन्तीमुरूची सुशर्माणमदितिꣳ सुप्रणीतिम् ॥५ ॥
translation: We call to succour us the mighty Mother of those whose sway is just, the Queen of Order, Strong-ruler, far-expanding, ne’er decaying, Aditi gracious guide and good protectress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसꣳ सुशर्माणमदितिꣳ सुप्रणीतिम्। दैवीं नावꣳ स्वरित्रामनागसमस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥६ ॥
translation: Sinless may we ascend, for weal, this vessel rowed with good oars, divine, that never leaketh, Earth our strong guard, incomparable Heaven. Aditi gracious guide and good protectress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुनावमा रुहेयमस्रवन्तीमनागसम्। शतारित्रा स्वस्तये ॥७ ॥
translation: May I ascend the goodly ship, free from defect, that leaketh not, Moved by a hundred oars, for weal.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम्। मध्वा रजासि सुक्रतू ॥८ ॥
translation: O Mitra-Varuna, gracious Pair, with fatness dew our pasturage, With mead the regions of the air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र बाहवा सिसृतं जीवसे नऽआ नो गव्यूतिमुक्षतं घृतेन। आ मा जने श्रवयतं युवाना श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमा ॥९ ॥
translation: Stretch forth your arms and let our lives be lengthened: with fatness dew the pastures of our cattle. Ye Youthful, make us famed among the people: hear, Mitra-Varuna, these mine invocations.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शन्नो भवन्तु वाजिनो हवेषु देवताता मितद्रवः स्वर्काः। जम्भयन्तोऽहिं वृकꣳ रक्षासि सनेम्यस्मद्युयवन्नमीवाः ॥१० ॥
translation: Bless us the Coursers when we call, etc., as in IX. 16.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजेवाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो धनेषु विप्राऽअमृताऽऋतज्ञाः। अस्य मध्वः पिबत मादयध्वं तृप्ता यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः ॥११ ॥
translation: Deep-skilled in Law, etc., as in IX. 18.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिद्धोऽअग्निः समिधा सुसमिद्धो वरेण्यः। गायत्री छन्दऽइन्द्रियं त्र्यविर्गौर्वयो दधुः ॥१२ ॥
translation: Kindled is Agni with the brand, yea, kindled well, the excellent. The metre Gâyatrî, the steer of eighteen months, give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तनूनपाच्छुचिव्रतस्तनूपाश्च सरस्वती। उष्णिहा छन्दऽइन्द्रियं दित्यवाड् गौर्वयो दधुः ॥१३ ॥
translation: Tanûnapât whose acts are pure, our bodies’ guard Sarasvatî, Ushnihâ metre and the steer of two years’ age give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इडाभिरग्निरीड्यः सोमो देवोऽअमर्त्यः। अनुष्टुप् छन्दऽइन्द्रियं पञ्चाविगौर्वयो दधुः ॥१४ ॥
translation: Agni with offerings, meet for praise, and Soma the immortal God, Anushtup metre and the steer of thirty months give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुबर्हिरग्निः पूषण्वान्त्स्तीर्णबर्हिरमर्त्यः। बृहती छन्दऽइन्द्रियं त्रिवत्सो गौर्वयो दधुः ॥१५ ॥
translation: Agni with goodly grass spread out, deathless with Pûshan at his side, Brihatî metre and a steer of three years’ age give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दुरो देवीर्दिशो महीर्ब्रह्मा देवो बृहस्पतिः। पङ्क्तिश्छन्दऽइहेन्द्रियं तुर्य्यवाड् गौर्वयो दधुः ॥१६ ॥
translation: The Doors divine, the mighty Regions, Brahma, God Brihaspati, The metre Pankti, here a bull in his fourth year, give power and life
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उषे यह्वी सुपेशसा विश्वे देवाऽअमर्त्याः। त्रिष्टुप् छन्दऽइहेन्द्रियं पष्ठवाड् गौर्वयो दधुः ॥१७ ॥
translation: The two young Darns of lovely form, the deathless Universal Gods, The Trishtup metre, here, a bull in his sixth year, give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दैव्या होतारा भिषजेन्द्रेण सयुजा युजा। जगती छन्दऽइन्द्रियमनड्वान् गौर्वयो दधुः ॥१८ ॥
translation: The two celestial Hotars, both Physicians, Indra’s close-knit friends, The metre Jagatî, an ox who draws the wain, give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिस्रऽइडा सरस्वती भारती मरुतो विशः। विराट्छन्दऽइहेन्द्रियं धेनुर्गौर्न वयो दधुः ॥१९ ॥
translation: The Three, Ida, Sarasvatî, and Bhâratî, the Marut folk, Virâj the metre, here, a cow in milk, a bull, give power and life! 89
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वष्टा तुरीपोऽअद्भुतऽइन्द्राग्नी पुष्टिवर्धना। द्विपदा छन्दऽइन्द्रियमुक्षा गौर्न वयो दधुः ॥२० ॥
translation: Tvashtar the wondrous, full of seed, Indrâgnî furtherers of weal, Dvipadâ metre, and a cow and vigorous bull give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शमिता नो वनस्पतिः सविता प्रसुवन् भगम्। ककुप् छन्दऽइहेन्द्रियं वशा वेहद्वयो दधुः ॥२१ ॥
translation: Our slaughterer, Vanaspatî, Savitar who promoteth wealth, The metre Kakup, here, a cow who casts her calf, give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वाहा यज्ञं वरुणः। सुक्षत्रो भेषजं करत्। अतिच्छन्दाऽइन्द्रियं बृहदृषभो गौर्वयो दधुः ॥२२ ॥
translation: With Svâhâ mighty Varuna give healing power to Sacrifice! The Atichhandas, Brihat, and a steer and bull give power and life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसन्तेनऽऋतुना देवा वसवस्त्रिवृता स्तुताः। रथन्तरेण तेजसा हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥२३ ॥
translation: With the Spring Season may the Gods the Vasus praised with triple hymn And with Rathantara, give life to Indra, splendour, sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ग्रीष्मेणऽऋतुना देवा रुद्राः पञ्चदशे स्तुताः। बृहता यशसा बलꣳहविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥२४ ॥
translation: With Summer may the Rudras, Gods, praised in the Pañchadasa hymn With Brihat, give to Indra strength; with fame, and sacrifice and life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वर्षाभिर्ऋतुनादित्या स्तोमे सप्तदशे स्तुताः। वैरूपेण विशौजसा हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥२५ ॥
translation: May the Âdityas with the Rains, lauded in Saptadasa hymn And with Vairûpa, with folk, strength, give Indra sacrifice and life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शारदेनऽऋतुना देवाऽएकविꣳशऽऋभव स्तुताः। वैराजेन श्रिया श्रियꣳ हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥२६ ॥
translation: With Autumn may the Ribhus, Gods, praised in the Ekavimsa hymn And with Virâja, give with grace to Indra grace, life, sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हेमन्तेनऽऋतुना देवास्त्रिणवे मरुत स्तुताः। बलेन शक्वरीः सहो हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥२७ ॥
translation: With Winter may the Maruts, Gods, praised in the laud of thrice nine parts, The Sakvarîs, with strength give might to Indra, sacrifice and life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शैशिरेणऽऋतुना देवास्त्रयस्त्रिꣳशेऽमृता स्तुताः। सत्येन रेवतीः क्षत्रꣳ हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥२८ ॥
translation: With Dew-time may the deathless Gods praised in the Thirty-three-part laud, The Revatîs, with truth give sway to Indra, sacrifice and life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षत्समिधाऽग्निमिडस्पदेऽश्विनेन्द्रꣳ सरस्वतीमजो धूम्रो न गोधूमैः कुवलैर्भेषजं मधु शष्पैर्न तेजऽइन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥२९ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar sacrifice with fuel to Agni in the place of libation, to the Asvins, Indra, Sarasvatî. A grey-coloured he-goat with wheat, jujube-fruit and sprouts of rice becomes a sweet salutary remedy, splendour, might, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy sweet butter with foaming liquor. Hotar, present offerings of butter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षत्तनूनपात्सरस्वतीमविर्मेषो न भेषजं पथा मधुमता भरन्नश्विनेन्द्राय वीर्यं बदरैरुपवाकाभिर्भेषजं तोक्मभिः पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३० ॥
translation: Let the Hotar, Tanûnapât, worship Sarasvatî. A sheep, a ram, a salutary remedy on the honey-sweet path, bearing to the Asvins and Indra heroic strength, with jujube-fruit, Indra- grains, sprouts of rice, becomes a salutary remedy, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc., as in verse 29.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षन्नराशꣳसं न नग्नहुं पतिꣳ सुरया भेषजं मेषः सरस्वती भिषग्रथो न चन्द्र्यश्विनोर्वपा इन्द्रस्य वीर्यं बदरैरुपवाकाभिर्भेषजं तोक्मभिः पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३१ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship Narâsamsa and the Lord Nagnahu. A ram with Surâ a salutary remedy, Sarasvatî the Physician, the golden car of the Asvins, the victim’s omentum, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, and rice-sprouts, become a salutary remedy, the manly strength of Indra, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षदिडेडितऽआ जुह्वानः सरस्वतीमिन्द्रं बलेन वर्धयन्नृषभेण गवेन्द्रियमश्विनेन्द्राय भेषजं यवैः कर्कन्धुभिर्मधु लाजैर्न मासरं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३२ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar, magnified with oblations, offering sacrifice, worship Sarasvatî and Indra, increasing them with strength, with a bull and a cow. Strength and medicine to the Asvins and Indra are meath with jujube-fruit, Mâsara with parched grain, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षद् बर्हिरूर्णम्रदा भिषङ् नासत्या भिषजाश्विनाश्वा शिशुमती भिषग्धेनुः सरस्वती भिषग्दुहऽइन्द्राय भेषजं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३३ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship the wool-soft Altar-grass, the Physicians Nâsatyas, the Physicians Asvins. A mare with a foal, a milch-cow is a physician. Sarasvatî the Physician yields medicine to Indra, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षद् दुरो दिशः कवष्यो न व्यचस्वतीरश्विभ्यां न दुरो दिशऽइन्द्रो न रोदसी दुघे दुहे धेनुः सरस्वत्यश्विनेन्द्राय भेषजꣳ शुक्रं न ज्योतिरिन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३४ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship the Doors, the Regions, the resounding, expansive Doors, the Regions, with the Asvins. Indra milks the two milky worlds. The Mulch-cow Sarasvatî yields medicine for the Asvins and Indra, pure light and strength. Milk, Soma. Let them, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षत्सुपेशसोषे नक्तं दिवाश्विना समञ्जाते सरस्वत्या त्विषिमिन्द्रे न भेषजꣳ श्येनो न रजसा हृदा श्रिया न मासरं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३५ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship the two fair-formed Dawns. At night and by day the Asvins with Sarasvatî compose impetuous power, like healing balm, in Indra, like a falcon, Mâsara with light, thought, and grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc. 90
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षद् दैव्या होतारा भिषजाश्विनेन्द्रं न जागृवि दिवा नक्तं न भेषजैः शूषꣳ सरस्वती भिषक्सीसेन दुहऽइन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३६ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship the two divine Hotars, the Physician Asvins, and Indra. Watchfully by day and night Sarasvatî as Physician, with balms, with lead, yields strength and power. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षत्तिस्रो देवीर्न भेषजं त्रयस्त्रिधातवोऽपसो रूपमिन्द्रे हिरण्ययमश्विनेडा न भारती वाचा सरस्वती महऽइन्द्राय दुहऽइन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३७ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship the three Goddesses. The three active ones, with three sacrificial elements, lay balm and golden hue on Indra. The Asvins, Idâ, Bhâratî—Sarasvatî with Speech yields might and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षत्सुरेतसमृषभं नर्यापसं त्वष्टारमिन्द्रमश्विना भिषजं न सरस्वतीमोजो न जूतिरिन्द्रियं वृको न रभसो भिषग्यशः सुरया भेषजꣳ श्रिया न मासरं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३८ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship Tvashtar full of good seed, the Bull active for men, Indra, the Asvins, Sarasvatî the Physician. Vigour, speed, power, a fierce wolf as physician, fame with Surâ is a medicine, Mâsara with grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षद् वनस्पतिꣳ शमितारꣳ शतक्रतुं भीमं न मन्युꣳ राजानं व्याघ्रं नमसाश्विना भामꣳ सरस्वती भिषगिन्द्राय दुहऽइन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥३९ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî the Immolator, the Lord of Hundred Powers, and awful Passion, the King, the Tiger, and the Asvins, with reverence. Sarasvatî the Physician yields wrath and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षदग्नि स्वाहाज्यस्य स्तोकाना स्वाहा मेदसां पृथक्स्वाहा छागमश्विभ्या स्वाहा मेषꣳ सरस्वत्यै स्वाहऽऋषभमिन्द्राय सिꣳहाय सहसऽइन्द्रियꣳ स्वाहाग्निं न भेषजꣳ स्वाहा सोममिन्द्रियꣳ स्वाहेन्द्रꣳ सुत्रामाणꣳ सवितारं वरुणं भिषजां पतिꣳ स्वाहा वनस्पतिं प्रियं पाथो न भेषजꣳ स्वाहा देवाऽआज्यपा जुषाणोऽअग्निर्भेषजं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज ॥४० ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship Agni. Of the drops of clarified butter, Svâhâ! Of the fat, omentum, etc., severally, Svâhâ! Svâhâ! the goat for the Asvins. Svâhâ! the ram for Sarasvatî. Svâhâ! the bull for Indra. To the Lion, to his might, power. Svâhâ! Agni the salutary remedy. Svâhâ! Soma, the power. Svâhâ! Indra the Good Deliverer. Savitar, Varuna Lord of Physicians. Svâhâ! Vanaspatî, beloved, food and medicine. Svâhâ! Gods who drink clarified butter. Agni accepting the medicine. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षदश्विनौ छागस्य वपाया मेदसो जुषेता हविर्होतर्यज। होता यक्षत्सरस्वतीं मेषस्य वपाया मेदसो जुषता हविर्होतर्यज। होता यक्षदिन्द्रमृषभस्य वपाया मेदसो जुषता हविर्होतर्यज ॥४१ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins with the omentum of a he-goat. Let them enjoy the fat. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Sarasvatî with the omentum of a ram. Let her enjoy the fat. Hotar offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Indra with the omentum of a bull. Let him, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षदश्विनौ सरस्वतीमिन्द्रꣳ सुत्रामाणमिमे सोमाः सुरामाणश्छागैर्न मेषैर्ऋषभैः सुताः शष्पैर्न तोक्मभिर्लाजैर्महस्वन्तो मदा मासरेण परिष्कृताः शुक्राः पयस्वन्तोऽमृताः प्रस्थिता वो मधुश्चुतस्तानश्विना सरस्वतीन्द्रः सुत्रामा वृत्रहा जुषन्ता सोम्यं मधु पिबन्तु मदन्तु व्यन्तु होतर्यज ॥४२ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins, Sarasvatî, Indra the Good Deliverer. These your Somas, pressed, rejoicing with goats, rams, bulls, giving pleasure with rice-shoots, young blades of corn, parched grain, joy-givers adorned with Mâsara, bright, milky, immortal, presented, dropping honey. these let the Asvins, Sarasvatî, Indra the Good Deliverer, Vritra-slayer, accept. Let them drink, rejoice in, enjoy the Soma meath. Hotar, sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षदश्विनौ छागस्य हविषऽआत्तामद्य मध्यतो मेदऽउद्भृतं पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभो घस्तां नूनं घासेऽअज्राणां यवसप्रथमाना सुमत्क्षराणा शतरुद्रियाणामग्निष्वात्तानां पीवोपवसनानां पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः शितामतऽउत्सादतोऽङ्गादङ्गादवत्तानां करतऽएवाश्विना जुषेता हविर्होतर्यज ॥४३ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins. Let them eat of the he-goat, the sacrifice. Let them to- day eat the fat, taken from the middle, before those who hate us, before human handling. Yea, let them eat amid the fodder of fields fresh with moisture, with their expanse of barley, limbs of those tasted by Agni, belonging to the Hundred Rudras, portions covered with fat, from the sides, from the thighs, from the fore-feet from the chine. From every member of the divided victims these two make their repast. Thus let the Asvins accept. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षत्सरस्वतीं मेषस्य हविषऽआवयदद्य मध्यतो मेदः उद्भृतं पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभो घसन्नूनं घासेऽअज्राणां यवसप्रथमाना सुमत्क्षराणा शतरुद्रियाणामग्निष्वात्तानां पीवोपवसनानां पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः शितामतऽउत्सादतोऽङ्गादङ्गादवत्तानां करदेवꣳ सरस्वती जुषता हविर्होतर्यज ॥४४ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship Sarasvatî. Let her approach the ram, the sacrifice. To-day let her eat, etc., the rest of verse 43 repeated mutatis mutandis.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षदिन्द्रमृषभस्य हविषऽआवयदद्य मध्यतो मेदऽउद्भृतं पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभो घसन्नूनं घासेऽअज्राणां यवसप्रथमाना सुमत्क्षराणा शतरुद्रियाणामग्निष्वात्तानां पीवोपवसनानां पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः शितामतऽउत्सादतोऽङ्गादङ्गादवत्तानां करदेवमिन्द्रो जुषता हविर्होतर्यज ॥४५ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship Indra, etc., as in 44 mutatis mutandis.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षद् वनस्पतिमभि हि पिष्टतमया रभिष्ठया रशनयाधित। यत्राश्विनोश्छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि यत्र सरस्वत्या मेषस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि यत्रेन्द्रस्यऽऋषभस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि यत्राग्नेः प्रिया धामानि यत्र सोमस्य प्रिया धामानि यत्रेन्द्रस्य सुत्राम्णः प्रिया धामानि यत्र सवितुः प्रिया धामानि यत्र वरुणस्य प्रिया धामानि यत्र वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथासि यत्र देवानामाज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि यत्राग्नेर्होतुः प्रिया धामानि तत्रैतान् प्रस्तुत्येवोपस्तुत्येवोपावस्रक्षद् रभीयसऽइव कृत्वी करदेवं देवो वनस्पतिर्जुषता हविर्होतर्यज ॥४६ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî. He has held with a very well formed and very strong rope. There where the favourite stations of the Asvins are, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there where the favourite stations of Agni are, of Soma, of Indra the Good Deliverer, of Savitar, of Varuna, the favourite places of Vanaspatî, the favourite stations of Gods who drink clarified butter, and of Agni the Hotar, there let him arrange these victims when he has praised and lauded them, and perform when he has made them very strong. Let divine Vanaspatî accept. Hotar, offer oblation. 91
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता यक्षदग्निꣳ स्विष्टकृतमयाडग्निरश्विनोश्छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्ययाट्सरस्वत्या मेषस्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्ययाडिन्द्रस्यऽऋषभस्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्ययाडग्नेः प्रिया धामान्ययाट्सोमस्य प्रिया धामान्ययाडिन्द्रस्य सुत्राम्णः प्रिया धामान्ययाट्सवितुः प्रिया धामान्ययाड् वरुणस्य प्रिया धामान्ययाड् वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथास्ययाड् देवानामाज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि यक्षदग्नेर्होतुः प्रिया धामानि यक्षत्स्वं महिमानमायजतामेज्याऽइषः कृणोतु सोऽअध्वरा जातवेदा जुषता हविर्होतर्यज ॥४७ ॥
translation: Let the Hotar worship Agni Svishtakrit. Let Agni worship the favourite stations of the Asvins, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there, etc., to ‘butter’ as in 46. Let him worship the favourite stations of Agni the Hotar. Let him worship his own majesty. Let him win for himself by sacrifice food worthy of sacrifice. Let him, Knower of Beings, perform the sacred rites. Let him accept the sacrificial food. Hotar, offer oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवं बर्हिः सरस्वती सुदेवमिन्द्रेऽअश्विना। तेजो न चक्षुरक्ष्योर्बर्हिषा दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥४८ ॥
translation: The Grass divine, for the right Gods, Sarasvatî, the Asvins Twain, Give Indra splendour, with the Grass, sight of his eyes and mighty strength! For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Thou, Hotar, offer sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवीर्द्वारोऽअश्विना भिषजेन्द्रे सरस्वती। प्राणं न वीर्य्यं नसि द्वारो दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥४९ ॥
translation: The Doors, the Doors divine, the Two Asvins, Leeches, Sarasvatî— May they give breath to Indra in his nostrils, and heroic strength. For gain of wealth, etc., as in verse 48.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवीऽउषासावश्विना सुत्रामेन्द्रे सरस्वती। बलं न वाचमास्यऽउषाभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५० ॥
translation: May Dawn and Night, the Goddesses, both Asvins, and Sarasvatî Lay, with both Dawns, strength, voice within Indra the Good Deliverer’s mouth. For gain of wealth, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवी जोष्ट्री सरस्वत्यश्विनेन्द्रमवर्धयन्। श्रोत्रं न कर्णयोर्यशो जोष्ट्रीभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५१ ॥
translation: Both nursing Goddesses, the Pair of Asvins, and Sarasvatî Have with both nurses given strength to Indra, fame, and power to hear. For gain of wealth, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवीऽऊर्जाहुती दुघे सुदुघेन्द्रे सरस्वत्यश्विना भिषजावतः। शुक्रं न ज्योति स्तनयोराहुती धत्तऽइन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५२ ॥
translation: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, both Goddesses, well-yielding cows, Sarasvatî, both Asvins, the Physicians, these are Indra’s guards. Forth from their breasts by sacrifice they give him brilliant light and power. For gain of wealth, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवा देवानां भिषजा होताराविन्द्रमश्विना। वषट्कारैः सरस्वती त्विषिं न हृदये मतिꣳ होतृभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५३ ॥
translation: Both Gods, the Hotars of the Gods, the Asvins the Physicians and Sarasvatî with Vashat- calls, with the two Hotars have bestowed on Indra brilliant light and power, and planted wisdom in his heart. For gain of wealth, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवीस्तिस्रस्तिस्रो देवीरश्विनेडा सरस्वती। शूषं न मध्ये नाभ्यामिन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५४ ॥
translation: Goddesses three, three Goddesses—Asvins, Idâ, Sarasvatî In Indra’s midmost navel have laid store of energy and power. For gain of wealth, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवऽइन्द्रो नराशꣳसस्रिवरूथः सरस्वत्याश्विभ्यामीयते रथः। रेतो न रूपममृतं जनित्रमिन्द्राय त्वष्टा दधदिन्द्रियाणि वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५५ ॥
translation: God Narâsamsa, Indra thrice-protecting, whose car moves by Sarasvatî and Asvins May Tvashtar lay seed, deathless form in Indra, a fitting place of birth and mighty powers. For gain of wealth, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवो देवैर्वनस्पतिर्हिरण्यपर्णोऽअश्विभ्या सरस्वत्या सुपिप्पलऽइन्द्राय पच्यते मधु। ओजो न जूतिर्ऋषभो न भामं वनस्पतिर्नो दधदिन्द्रियाणि वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५६ ॥
translation: God with the Gods, Vanaspatî of golden leaves and goodly fruit Ripens till Indra finds it sweet, with Asvins and Sarasvatî.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनामध्वरे स्तीर्णमश्विभ्यामूर्णम्रदाः सरस्वत्या स्योनमिन्द्र ते सदः। ईशायै मन्युꣳ राजानं बर्हिषा दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५७ ॥
translation: Strewn, soft as wool, in sacrifice, with Asvins and Sarasvatî, The sacred robe of water- plants be, Indra, a fair seat for thee! Together with the sacred grass limy they, for sovranty, bestow King Passion and great power on thee. For gain of wealth, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवोऽअग्निः स्विष्टकृद्देवान् यक्षद् यथायथꣳ होताराविन्द्रमश्विना वाचा वाचꣳ सरस्वतीमग्निꣳ सोम स्विष्टकृत्स्विष्टऽइन्द्रः सुत्रामा सविता वरुणो भिषगिष्टो देवो वनस्पतिः स्विष्टा देवाऽआज्यपाः स्विष्टोऽअग्निरग्निना होता होत्रे स्विष्टकृद् यशो न दधदिन्द्रियमूर्जमपचिति स्वधां वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज ॥५८ ॥
translation: Let the God Agni Svishtakrit worship the Gods as is meet and right for each, the two Hotars, Indra, the Asvins, Vâk with speech, Sarasvatî, Agni, Soma. Svishtakrit has been well worshipped, Indra Good Deliverer, Savitar, Varuna the Physician have been worshipped. The God Vanaspatî, the Gods who drink clarified butter have been well worshipped, Agni by Agni. Let the Hotar Svishtakrit give the Hotar fame, great power, energy, honour, Ancestral libation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निमद्य होतारमवृणीतायं यजमानः पचन् पक्तीः पचन् पुरोडाशान् बध्नन्नश्विभ्यां छागꣳ सरस्वत्यै मेषमिन्द्रायऽऋषभꣳ सुन्वन्नश्विभ्या सरस्वत्याऽइन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे सुरासोमान् ॥५९ ॥
translation: To-day this Sacrificer cooking viands, cooking sacrificial rice-cakes, binding a goat for the Asvins, a ram for Sarasvatî, a hull for Indra, pressing Surâ and Soma juices for the Asvins, Sarasvatî, and Indra the Good Deliverer, has chosen Agni as Hotar.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सूपस्थाऽअद्य देवो वनस्पतिरभवदश्विभ्यां छागेन सरस्वत्यै मेषेणेन्द्रायऽऋषभेणाक्षँस्तान् मेदस्तः प्रति पचतागृभीषतावीवृधन्त पुरोडाशैरपुरश्विना सरस्वतीन्द्रः सुत्रामा सुरासोमान् ॥६० ॥
translation: To-day the divine Vanaspatî has done good service to the Asvins with a goat, to Sarasvatî with a ram, to Indra with a bull. They have eaten these from the marrow onwards, they have accepted the cooked viands, they have waxed strong with the rice-cakes. The Agnis, Sarasvatî, and Indra have drunk the Surâ and Soma draughts. 92
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामद्यऽऋषऽआर्षेयऽऋषीणां नपादवृणीतायं यजमानो बहुभ्यऽआ सङ्गतेभ्यऽएष मे देवेषु वसु वार्यायक्ष्यतऽइति ता या देवा देव दानान्यदुस्तान्यस्माऽआ च शास्स्वा च गुरस्वेषितश्च होतरसि भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय सूक्ता ब्रूहि ॥६१ ॥
translation: Thee, to-day, O Rishi, Rishi’s son, descendant of Rishis, hath this Sacrificer chosen for many collected, saying: This (Agni) shall win by sacrifice for me choice-worthy treasures among the Gods. O God, what gifts the Gods have given, these do thou desire and approve. And thou art a commissioned Hotar, a human Hotar sent forward for benediction, for good speech, Speak thou good words. 93
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तेजोऽसि शुक्रममृतमायुष्पाऽआयुर्मे पाहि। देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामाददे ॥१ ॥
translation: SPLENDOUR art thou, bright, deathless, life-protector. Protector of my life be thou. By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमामगृभ्णन् रशनामृतस्य पूर्वऽआयुषि विदथेषु कव्या। सा नोऽअस्मिन्त्सुतऽआबभूवऽऋतस्य सामन्त्सरमारपन्ती ॥२ ॥
translation: This girdle, which in their religious meetings sages assumed in earlier time of worship, Is present with us here at this libation, in the Law’s hymn, proclaiming rich abundance.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभिधाऽअसि भुवनमसि यन्तासि धर्त्ता। स त्वमग्निं वैश्वानरꣳ सप्रथसं गच्छ स्वाहाकृतः ॥३ ॥
translation: Famous art thou, thou art the world, controller and upholder thou. Go, consecrate by Svâhâ to Agni Vaisvânara widely-famed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वगा त्वा देवेभ्यः प्रजापतये ब्रह्मन्नश्वं भन्त्स्यामि देवेभ्यः प्रजापतये तेन राध्यासम्। तं बधान देवेभ्यः प्रजापतये तेन राध्नुहि ॥४ ॥
translation: For Gods and for Prajâpati I fit thee. For Gods and for Prajâpati, O Brahman, Will I tie up the horse. Thence may I prosper! Binding him for Prajâpati and Gods be thou successful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामीन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि वायवे त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यो जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि सर्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यो जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि। योऽअर्वन्तं जिघासति तमभ्यमीति वरुणः। परो मर्त्तः परः श्वा ॥५ ॥
translation: Thee welcome to Prajâpati I sprinkle. I sprinkle thee welcome to Indra-Agni. I sprinkle thee acceptable to Vâyu. Thee welcome to the All-Gods I besprinkle. Thee welcome to all Deities I sprinkle. With fury Varuna attacks the man who fain would slay the steed. Avaunt the man! Avaunt the dog!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहापां मोदाय स्वाहा सवित्रे स्वाहा वायवे स्वाहा विष्णवे स्वाहेन्द्राय स्वाहा बृहस्पतये स्वाहा मित्राय स्वाहा वरुणाय स्वाहा ॥६ ॥
translation: To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! Hail to the Waters’ Joy! Hail to Savitar! Hail to Vâyu! Hail to Vishnu! Hail to Indra! Hail to Brihaspati! Hail to Mitra! Hail to Varuna!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिङ्काराय स्वाहा हिङ्कृताय स्वाहा क्रन्दते स्वाहाऽवक्रन्दाय स्वाहा प्रोथते स्वाहा प्रप्रोथाय स्वाहा गन्धाय स्वाहा घ्राताय स्वाहा निविष्टाय स्वाहोपविष्टाय स्वाहा सन्दिताय स्वाहा वल्गते स्वाहासीनाय स्वाहा शयानाय स्वाहा स्वपते स्वाहा जाग्रते स्वाहा कूजते स्वाहा प्रबुद्धाय स्वाहा विजृम्भमाणाय स्वाहा विचृताय स्वाहा सꣳहानाय स्वाहोपस्थिताय स्वाहाऽयनाय स्वाहा प्रायणाय स्वाहा ॥७ ॥
translation: Hail to the sound hiṅ! Hail to the uttered hiṅ! Hail to the neigh! Hail to the down-neigh! Hail to the snort! Hail to the roar! Hail to his smell! Hail to him smelt at! Hail to him seated! Hail to him seated down! Hail to him weary! Hail to him going! Hail to him sitting! Hail to him lying! Hail to him sleeping! Hail to him waking! Hail to him whinnying! Hail to him wakened! Hail to him yawning! Hail to him outstretched! Hail to him drawn together! Hail to him risen! Hail to his going! Hail to his good going! Hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यते स्वाहा धावते स्वाहोद्द्रावाय स्वाहोद्द्रुताय स्वाहा शूकाराय स्वाहा शूकृताय स्वाहा निषण्णाय स्वाहोत्थिताय स्वाहा जवाय स्वाहा बलाय स्वाहा विवर्त्तमानाय स्वाहा विवृत्ताय स्वाहा विधून्वानाय स्वाहा विधूताय स्वाहा शुश्रूषमाणाय स्वाहा शृण्वते स्वाहेक्षमाणाय स्वाहेक्षिताय स्वाहा वीक्षिताय स्वाहा निमेषाय स्वाहा यदत्ति तस्मै स्वाहा यत्पिबति तस्मै स्वाहा यन्मूत्रं करोति तस्मै स्वाहा कुर्वते स्वाहा कृताय स्वाहा ॥८ ॥
translation: Hail to him as he goes! Hail to him running! Hail to him running away! Hail to him when he has run away! Hail to the cry Shoo! Hail to him scared with Shoo! Hail to him seated! Hail to him risen! Hail to his speed! Hail to his strength! Hail to him rolling! Hail to him when he has rolled! Hail to him tossing about! Hail to him when he has tossed about! Hail to him listening! Hail to him hearing. Hail to him looking! Hail to him looked at! Hail to him closely looked at! Hail to his closing his eye! Hail to his food! Hail to his drink! Hail to his stale! Hail to him in action! Hail to what he has done!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि। धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥९ ॥
translation: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्यपाणिमूतये सवितारमुपह्वये। स चेत्ता देवता पदम् ॥१० ॥
translation: For our protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar: He knoweth, as a God, the place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवस्य चेततो महीं प्र सवितुर्हवामहे। सुमतिꣳ सत्यराधसम् ॥११ ॥
translation: We specially invoke the grace of Savitar, observant God, The great good-will that gives true boons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुष्टुतिꣳ सुमतीवृधो रातिꣳ सवितुरीमहे। प्र देवाय मतीविदे ॥१२ ॥
translation: We seek the eulogy and gift of Savitar who strengthens grace, Yea, of the God who knows our thoughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रातिꣳ सत्पतिं महे सवितारमुप ह्वये। आसवं देववीतये ॥१३ ॥
translation: I invocate the heroes’ Lord, free-giving Savitar, and call The Cheerer to the feast of Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवस्य सवितुर्मतिमासवं विश्वदेव्यम्। धिया भगं मनामहे ॥१४ ॥
translation: The judgment of bright Savitar, that cheers the All-Gods’ company, With prayer we estimate as bliss.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निꣳ स्तोमेन बोधय समिधानोऽअमर्त्यम्। हव्या देवेषु नो दधत्॥१५ ॥
translation: Wake Agni with thy laud and set the Immortal One aflame, let him Bestow our offerings on the Gods. 94
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स हव्यवाडमर्त्यऽउशिग्दूतश्चनोहितः। अग्निर्धिया समृण्वति ॥१६ ॥
translation: Oblation-bearer, well-inclined, immortal, eager Messenger, Agni comes near us with the thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं पुरो दधे हव्यवाहमुपब्रुवे। देवाँ२ऽआ सादयादिह ॥१७ ॥
translation: Agni, Envoy, I place in front, the oblation-bearer I address: Here let him seat the Deities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्य्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः। गोजीरया रꣳहमाणः पुरन्ध्या ॥१८ ॥
translation: Yea, Pavamâna, thou didst generate the Sun and spread the moisture out with power, Basting to us with plenty vivified with milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभूर्मात्रा प्रभूः पित्राश्वोऽसि हयोऽस्यत्योऽसि मयोऽस्यर्वासि सप्तिरसि वाज्यसि वृषासि नृमणाऽअसि। ययुर्नामाऽसि शिशुर्नामास्यादित्यानां पत्वान्विहि देवाऽआशापालाऽएतं देवेभ्योऽश्वं मेधाय प्रोक्षितꣳ रक्षतेह रन्तिरिह रमतामिह धृतिरिह स्वधृतिः स्वाहा ॥१९ ॥
translation: Mighty through thy dam, eminent through thy sire, thou art a horse, thou art a steed, thou art a courser, thou art a comfort, thou art a racer, thou art a yoke-horse, thou art a strong steed, thou art a stallion, thou art manly-minded. Thou art called Yayu, thou art called Sisu. Follow thou the flight of the Âdityas. Gods, Warders of the Regions, protect for the Gods this horse besprinkled for sacrifice. Here is delight. Here take thy pleasure. Here is content. Here is self-content.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: काय स्वाहा कस्मै स्वाहा कतमस्मै स्वाहा स्वाहाधिमाधीताय स्वाहा मनः प्रजापतये स्वाहा चित्तं विज्ञातायादित्यै स्वाहादित्यै मह्यै स्वाहादित्यै सुमृडीकायै स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै पावकायै स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै बृहत्यै स्वाहा पूष्णे स्वाहा पूष्णे प्रपथ्याय स्वाहा पूष्णे नरन्धिषाय स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे तुरीपाय स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे पुरुरूपाय स्वाहा विष्णवे स्वाहा विष्णवे निभूयपाय स्वाहा विष्णवे शिपिविष्टाय स्वाहा ॥२० ॥
translation: Hail to Ka! Hail to Who?! Hail to Which?! Hail to him who has experienced pain! Hail to Prajâpati who knows the mind! Hail to him who discerns the thought! Hail to Aditi! Hail to good Aditi! Hail to gracious Aditi! Hail to Sarasvatî! Hail to purifying Sarasvatî! Hail to great Sarasvatî! Hail to Pûshan! Hail to Pûshan of the highways! Hail to Pûshan observer of men! Hail to Tvashtar! Hail to swift Tvashtar! Hail to Tvashtar of many forms! Hail to Vishnu! Hail to Vishnu Nibhûyapa! Hail to Vishnu Sipivishta!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर्मर्त्तो वुरीत सख्यम्। विश्वो रायऽइषुध्यति द्युम्नं वृणीत पुष्यसे स्वाहा ॥२१ ॥
translation: Let every mortal man elect, etc., repeated from IV. 8.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ब्रह्मन् ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चसी जायतामा राष्ट्रे राजन्यः शूरऽइषव्योऽतिव्याधी महारथो जायतां दोग्ध्री धेनुर्वोढानड्वानाशुः सप्तिः पुरन्धिर्योषा जिष्णू रथेष्ठाः सभेयो युवास्य यजमानस्य वीरो जायतां निकामे निकामे नः पर्जन्यो वर्षतु फलवत्यो नऽओषधयः पच्यन्तां योगक्षेमो नः कल्पताम् ॥२२ ॥
translation: O Brahman, let there be born in the kingdom the Brahman illustrious for religious knowledge; let there be born the Râjanya, heroic, skilled archer, piercing with shafts, mighty warrior; the cow giving abundant milk; the ox good at carrying; the swift courser; the industrious woman. May Parjanya send rain according to our desire; may our fruit-bearing plants ripen; may acquisition and preservation of property be secured to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राणाय स्वाहाऽपानाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहा चक्षुषे स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा वाचे स्वाहा मनसे स्वाहा ॥२३ ॥
translation: Hail to vital breath! Hail to out-breathing! Hail to diffusive breath! Hail to the eye! Hail to the ear! Hail to Speech! Hail to Mind!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राच्यै दिशे स्वाहाऽर्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहा दक्षिणायै दिशे स्वाहाऽर्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहा प्रतीच्यै दिशे स्वाहाऽर्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहोदीच्यै दिशे स्वाहाऽर्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहोर्ध्वायै दिशे स्वाहाऽर्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहाऽवाच्यै दिशे स्वाहाऽर्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहा ॥२४ ॥
translation: Hail to the Eastern Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Southern Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Western Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Northern Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Upward Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Downward Region! Hail to the hitherward Region!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अद्भ्यः स्वाहा वार्भ्यः स्वाहोदकाय स्वाहा तिष्ठन्तीभ्यः स्वाहा स्रवन्तीभ्यः स्वाहा स्यन्दमानाभ्यः स्वाहा कूप्याभ्यः स्वाहा सूद्याभ्यः स्वाहा धार्याभ्यः स्वाहार्णवाय स्वाहा समुद्राय स्वाहा सरिराय स्वाहा ॥२५ ॥
translation: Hail to waters! Hail to floods! Hail to water! Hail to standing waters! flail to flowing waters! Hail to trickling waters! Hail to well waters! Hail to spring waters! Hail to the foaming sea! Hail to the ocean! Hail to the deep!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाताय स्वाहा धूमाय स्वाहाभ्राय स्वाहा मेघाय स्वाहा विद्योतमानाय स्वाहा स्तनयते स्वाहावस्फूर्जते स्वाहा वर्षते स्वाहाववर्षते स्वाहोग्रं वर्षते स्वाहा शीघ्रं वर्षते स्वाहोद्गृह्णते स्वाहोद्गृहीताय स्वाहा प्रुष्णते स्वाहा शीकायते स्वाहा प्रुष्वाभ्यः स्वाहा ह्रादुनीभ्यः स्वाहा नीहाराय स्वाहा ॥२६ ॥
translation: Hail to wind! Hail to mist! Hail to vapour! Hail to cloud! Hail to cloud lightening! Hail to cloud thundering! Hail to it bursting! Hail to it raining! Hail to it pouring! Hail to it violently raining! Hail to it swiftly raining! Hail to it holding up! Hail to it when it has held up! Hail to it sprinkling! Hail to it drizzling! Hail to its drops! Hail to thunderbolts! Hail to hoar frosts!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहेन्द्राय स्वाहा पृथिव्यै स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा दिवे स्वाहा दिग्भ्यः स्वाहाऽऽशाभ्यः स्वाहोर्व्यै दिशे स्वाहार्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहा ॥२७ ॥
translation: Hail to Agni! Hail to Soma! Hail to Indra! Hail to Earth! Hail to Firmament! Hail to Sky! Hail to Regions? Hail to Quarters! Hail to the Upward Region! Hail to the Downward Region!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नक्षत्रेभ्यः स्वाहा नक्षत्रियेभ्यः स्वाहाहोरात्रेभ्यः स्वाहार्द्धमासेभ्यः स्वाहा मासेभ्यः स्वाहऽऋतुभ्यः स्वाहार्त्तवेभ्यः स्वाहा संवत्सराय स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्या स्वाहा चन्द्राय स्वाहा सूर्याय स्वाहा रश्मिभ्यः स्वाहा वसुभ्यः स्वाहा रुद्रेभ्यः स्वाहादित्येभ्यः स्वाहा मरुद्भ्यः स्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा मूलेभ्यः स्वाहा शाखाभ्यः स्वाहा वनस्पतिभ्यः स्वाहा पुष्पेभ्यः स्वाहा फलेभ्यः स्वाहौषधीभ्यः स्वाहा ॥२८ ॥
translation: Hail to the lunar asterisms! Hail to those connected with the lunar asterisms! Hail to Day and Night! Hail to the half-months! Hail to the mouths! Hail to the Seasons! Hail to the Season-groups! Hail to the Year! Hail to Heaven and Earth! Hail to the Moon! Hail to the Sun! Hail to his rays! Hail to the Vasus! Hail to the Rudras! Hail to the Âdityas! Hail to the Maruts! Earl to the All-Gods! Hail to roots! Hail to branches! Hail to forest trees! Hail to flowers! Hail to fruits! Hail to herbs! 95
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पृथिव्यै स्वाहान्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा दिवे स्वाहा सूर्याय स्वाहा चन्द्राय स्वाहा नक्षत्रेभ्यः स्वाहाद्भ्यः स्वाहौषधीभ्यः स्वाहा वनस्पतिभ्यः स्वाहा परिप्लवेभ्यः स्वाहा चराचरेभ्यः स्वाहा सरीसृपेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥२९ ॥
translation: Hail to Earth! Hail to Firmament t Hail to Sky! Hail to Sun! Hail to Moon! Hail to lunar asterisms! Hail to waters! Hail to herbs! Hail to forest trees! Hail to creatures that swim! Hail to things moving and stationary! Hail to things that creep and crawl!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असवे स्वाहा वसवे स्वाहा विभुवे स्वाहा विवस्वते स्वाहा गणश्रिये स्वाहा गणपतये स्वाहाभिभुवे स्वाहाधिपतये स्वाहा शूषाय स्वाहा सꣳसर्पाय स्वाहा चन्द्राय स्वाहा ज्योतिषे स्वाहा मलिम्लुचाय स्वाहा दिवा पतये स्वाहा ॥३० ॥
