translation: O thou who slewest Vritra, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty One with thy mighty aids.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्त्तिष्वभि विश्वाऽअसि स्पृधः। अशस्तिहा जनिता विश्वतूरसि त्वं तूर्य्य तरुष्यतः ॥६६ ॥
translation: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse: vanquish the men who fight with us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा। विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि ॥६७ ॥
translation: Heaven and Earth cling close to thy victorious might As sire and mother to their child.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञो देवानां प्रत्येति सुम्नमादित्यासो भवता मृडयन्तः। आ वोऽर्वाची सुमतिर्ववृत्यादꣳहोश्चिद्या वरिवोवित्तरासत् ॥६८ ॥
translation: The sacrifice obtains the Gods’ acceptance, etc., as in VIII. 4.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदब्धेभिः सवितः पायुभिष्ट्वꣳ शिवेभिरद्य परि पाहि नो गयम्। हिरण्यजिह्वः सुविताय नव्यसे रक्षा माकिर्नोऽअघशꣳसऽ ईशत ॥६९ ॥
translation: Protect our habitation, Savitar, this day with guardian aids around, propitious, ne’er beguiled. God of the golden tongue, keep us for newest bliss: let not the evil-wisher have us in his power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वीरया शुचयो दद्रिरे वामध्वर्युभिर्मधुमन्तः सुतासः। वह वायो नियुतो याह्यच्छा पिबा सुतस्यान्धसो मदाय ॥७० ॥
translation: For you have flowed, through noble ministration, pressed by Adhvaryus, bright sweet- flavoured juices. Drive on thy team and come thou hither, Vâyu: drink for thy rapture of the sap of Soma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गावऽउपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा। उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥७१ ॥
translation: Ye Cows, protect, etc., as in verse 14.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: काव्ययोराजानेषु क्रत्वा दक्षस्य दुरोणे। रिशादसा सधस्थऽआ ॥७२ ॥
translation: Come ye foe-slayers to the place of meeting, to the birth-places of the two great Sages, With force of intellect unto the dwelling.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दैव्यावध्वर्यू आ गतꣳ रथेन सूर्यत्वचा। मध्वा यज्ञꣳ समञ्जाथे। तं प्रत्नथा। अयं वेनः ॥७३ ॥
translation: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, etc., as in verse 33. Thou in the time of old. See, Vena.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिरश्चीनो विततो रश्मिरेषामधः स्विदासी३दुपरि स्विदासी३त्। रेतोधाऽआसन् महिमानऽआसन्त्स्वधाऽअवस्तात् प्रयतिः परस्तात् ॥७४ ॥
translation: Transversely was the severing line extended: was it above, or was it, haply, under? There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ रोदसीऽअपृणदा स्वर्महज्जातं यदेनमपसोऽअधारयन्। सोऽअध्वराय परि णीयते कविरत्यो न वाजसातये चनोहितः ॥७५ ॥
translation: He hath filled heaven and earth and the great realm of light, when at his birth the skilful held him in their hold. He like a steed is led forth to the sacrifice, Sage, graciously inclined, that he may win us wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्थेभिर्वृत्रहन्तमा या मन्दाना चिदा गिरा। आङ्गूषैराविवासतः ॥७६ ॥
translation: Call hither with the song and lauds the two best slayers of the foe, Delighting even in our hymn. 128
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये। सुमृडीका भवन्तु नः ॥७७ ॥
translation: All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing, And be exceeding good to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्माणि मे मतयः शꣳसुतासः शुष्मऽइयर्त्ति प्रभृतो मेऽअद्रिः। आ शासते प्रति हर्य्यन्त्युक्थेमा हरी वहतस्ता नोऽअच्छ ॥७८ ॥
translation: Mine are devotions, hymns, sweet are libations. Strength stirs, and hurled forth is my rocky weapon. They call for me, for me their lauds are longing. To their libations these my Bay Steeds bear me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनुत्तमा ते मघवन्नकिर्नु न त्वावाँ२ऽअस्ति देवता विदानः। न जायमानो नशते न जातो यानि करिष्या कृणुहि प्रवृद्ध ॥७९ ॥
translation: Nothing, O Bounteous Lord, stands firm before thee: among the Gods not one is found thine equal. None born or springing into life comes near thee. Do what thou hast to do, exceeding mighty!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञऽ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः। सद्यो जज्ञानो निरिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः ॥८० ॥
translation: In all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence sprang the mighty God of splendid valour. Quickly when born he overcomes his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमाऽउ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्द्धन्तु या मम। पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥८१ ॥
translation: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth. Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्यायं विश्वऽआर्यो दासः शेवधिपाऽअरिः। तिरश्चिदर्य्ये रुशमे पवीरवि तुभ्येत्सोऽअज्यते रयिः ॥८२ ॥तिरश्चिदर्य्ये रुशमे पवीरवि तुभ्येत्सोऽअज्यते रयिः ॥८२ ॥
translation: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Âryas, Dâsas here belong. E’en over unto thee, the pious Rusama Pavîru, is that wealth brought nigh.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयंꣳ सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्रऽइव पप्रथे। सत्यः सोऽअस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये ॥८३ ॥
translation: He, with his might advanced by Rishis thousandfold, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदब्धेभिः सवितः पायुभिष्ट्वꣳ शिवेभिरद्य परि पाहि नो गयम्। हिरण्यजिह्वः सुविताय नव्यसे रक्षा माकिर्नोऽअघशꣳसऽईशत ॥८४ ॥
translation: Protect our habitation, Savitar, etc., as in verse 69.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिः। अन्तः पवित्रऽउपरि श्रीणानोऽयꣳ शुक्रोऽअयामि ते ॥८५ ॥
translation: Come, Vâyu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven. Poured on the middle of the straining-cloth and dressed, this bright drink hath been offered thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू सुसन्दृशा सुहवेह हवामहे। यथा नः सर्वऽइज्जनोऽनमीवः सङ्गमे सुमनाऽअसत् ॥८६ ॥
translation: Indra and Vâyu, fair to see and swift to hear, we call to us, That in assembly all, yea, all the folk may be benevolent to us and free from malady.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋधगित्था स मर्त्यः शशमे देवतातये। यो नूनं मित्रावरुणावभिष्टयऽआचक्रे हव्यदातये ॥८७ ॥
translation: Yea, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods, Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuna to share his sacrificial gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यातमुप भूषतं मध्वः पिबतमश्विना। दुग्धं पयो वृषणा जेन्यावसू मा नो मर्धिष्टमा गतम् ॥८८ ॥
translation: Approach ye, and be near to us. Drink, O ye Asvins, of the mead. Draw forth the milk, ye mighty, rich in genuine wealth! Injure us not, and come to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता। अच्छा वीरं नर्य्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः ॥८९ ॥
translation: May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, may Sûnritâ the Goddess come, And Gods bring to our rite which gives the fivefold gift the Hero, lover of mankind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चन्द्रमाऽअप्स्वन्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि। रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहꣳ हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥९० ॥
translation: Within the Waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous wings, in heaven. To yellow- hued abundant wealth, object of many a man’s desire, loud-neighing goes the tawny Steed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवन्देवं वोऽवसे देवन्देवमभिष्टये। देवन्देवꣳ हुवेम वाजसातये गृणन्तो देव्या धिया ॥९१ ॥
translation: Singing their praise with godlike hymn let us invoke each God for grace, Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवि पृष्टोऽअरोचताग्निर्वैश्वानरो बृहन्। क्ष्मया वृधानऽओजसा चनोहितो ज्योतिषा बाधते तमः ॥९२ ॥
translation: Agni Vaisvânara, set in heaven, with mighty splendour hath shone forth. Increasing in his power on earth, benevolent, he quells the darkness with his light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नीऽअपादियं पूर्वागात् पद्वतीभ्यः। हित्वी शिरो जिह्वया वावदच्चरत् त्रिꣳशत् पदा न्यक्रमीत् ॥९३ ॥
translation: First, Indra Agni! hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवासो हि ष्मा मनवे समन्यवो विश्वे साकꣳसरातयः। ते नोऽअद्य ते अपरं तुचे तु नो भवन्तु वरिवोविदः ॥९४ ॥
translation: For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts. May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing ease and ample room.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाथेन्द्रो द्युम्न्याभवत्। देवास्तऽइन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण ॥९५ ॥
translation: Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us. Indra, refulgent with the Marut host! the Gods eagerly strove to win thy love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वऽइन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत। वृत्रꣳ हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥९६ ॥
translation: To Indra, to your mighty Chief, Maruts, sing forth a mighty prayer. Let Satakratu, Vritra- slayer, kill the fiend with hundred-knotted thunderbolt. 129
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यꣳ शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि। अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा। इमा उ त्वा। यस्यायम्। अयꣳ सहस्रम्। ऊर्ध्वऽऊ षु णः ॥९७ ॥
translation: Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this juice; And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty. May these. Good Lord of wealth. He with his might. Stand up erect. 130
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्जाग्रतो दूरमुदैति दैवं तदु सुप्तस्य तथैवैति। दूरङ्गमं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरेकं तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥१ ॥
translation: THAT which, divine, mounts far when man is waking, that which returns to him when he is sleeping, The lights’ one light that goeth to a distance, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येन कर्माण्यपसो मनीषिणो यज्ञे कृण्वन्ति विदथेषु धीराः। यदपूर्वं यक्षमन्तः प्रजानां तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥२ ॥
translation: Whereby the wise and thoughtful in assemblies, active in sacrifice, perform their duties, The peerless spirit stored in living creatures, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्प्रज्ञानमुत चेतो धृतिश्च यज्ज्योतिरन्तरमृतं प्रजासु। यस्मान्नऽऋते किं चन कर्म क्रियते तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥३ ॥
translation: That which is wisdom, intellect, and firmness, immortal light which creatures have within them, That without which men do no single action, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येनेदं भूतं भुवनं भविष्यत् परिगृहीतममृतेन सर्वम्। येन यज्ञस्तायते सप्तहोता तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥४ ॥
translation: Whereby, immortal, all is comprehended, the world which is, and what shall be hereafter, Whereby spreads sacrifice with seven Hotars, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मिन्नृचः साम यजूषि यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठिता रथनाभाविवाराः। यस्मिँश्चित्तꣳ सर्वमोतं प्रजानां तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥५ ॥
translation: Wherein the Richas, Sâmans, Yajur-verses, like spokes within a car’s nave, are included, And all the thought of creatures is inwoven, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुषारथिरश्वानिव यन्मनुष्यान्नेनीयतेऽभीशुभिर्वाजिनऽइव। हृत्प्रतिष्ठं यदजिरं जविष्ठं तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥६ ॥
translation: Controlling men, as, with the reins that guide them, a skilful charioteer drives fleet-foot horses, Which dwells within the heart, agile, most rapid, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पितुं नु स्तोषं महो धर्माणं तविषीम्। यस्य त्रितो व्योजसा वृत्रं विपर्वमर्द्दयत् ॥७ ॥
translation: Now will I glorify great strength’s upholder, Food, By whose invigorating might Trita rent Vritra limb from limb.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्विदनुमते त्वं मन्यासै शं च नस्कृधि। क्रत्वे दक्षाय नो हिनु प्र णऽआयूषि तारिषः ॥८ ॥
translation: Do thou, in truth, Anumati, assent and grant us happiness. Urge us to strength and energy: prolong the days we have to live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु नोऽद्यानुमतिर्यज्ञं देवेषु मन्यताम्। अग्निश्च हव्यवाहनो भवतं दाशुषे मयः ॥९ ॥
translation: Anumati this day approve our sacrifice among the Gods! Oblation-bearing Agni be, and thou, bliss to the worshipper!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सिनीवालि पृथुष्टुके या देवानामसि स्वसा। जुषस्व हव्यमाहुतं प्रजां देवि दिदिड्ढि नः ॥१० ॥
translation: O broad-tressed Sinîvâlî, thou who art the sister of the Gods, Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पञ्च नद्यः सरस्वतीमपि यन्ति सस्रोतसः। सरस्वती तु पञ्चधा सो देशेऽभवत् सरित् ॥११ ॥
translation: Five rivers flowing on their way speed onward to Sarasvatî, But then became Sarasvatî a fivefold river in the land.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रथमोऽअङ्गिराऽऋषिर्देवो देवानामभवः शिवः सखा। तव व्रते कवयो विद्मनापसोऽजायन्त मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः ॥१२ ॥
translation: O Agni, thou the earliest Angiras, the Seer, hast, God thyself, become the Gods’ auspicious Friend. After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, with their glittering spears, were born.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं नोऽअग्ने तव देव पायुभिर्मघोनो रक्ष तन्वश्च वन्द्य। त्राता तोकस्य तनये गवामस्यनिमेषꣳ रक्षमाणस्तव व्रते ॥१३ ॥
translation: Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves. Guard art thou of our seed and progeny and cows, incessantly protecting in thy holy law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्तानायामव भरा चिकित्वान्त्सद्यः प्रवीता वृषणं जजान। अरुषस्तूपो रुशदस्य पाजऽइडायास्पुत्रो वयुनेऽजनिष्ट ॥१४ ॥
translation: Lay this with care on her who lies extended: straight, when impregned, hath she brought forth the Hero. With his bright pillar—radiant is his lustre—in our skilled task is born the Son of Idâ.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इडायास्त्वा पदे वयं नाभा पृथिव्याऽअधि। जातवेदो नि धीमह्यग्ने हव्याय वोढवे ॥१५ ॥
translation: In Idâ’s place, the centre of the earth, will we deposit thee, That, Agni Jâtavedas, thou mayst bear our offerings to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र मन्महे शवसानाय शूषमाङ्गूषं गिर्वणसेऽअङ्गिरस्वत्। सुवृक्तिभिः स्तुवतऽऋग्मियायार्चामार्कं नरे विश्रुताय ॥१६ ॥
translation: Like Angiras a gladdening laud we ponder to him who loveth song, exceeding mighty. Let us sing glory to the far-famed Hero who must be praised with fair hymns by the singer. 131
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वो महे महि नमो भरध्वमाङ्गूष्यꣳ शवसानाय साम। येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाऽअर्चन्तोऽअङ्गिरसो गाऽअविन्दन् ॥१७ ॥
translation: Unto the Great One bring great adoration, a chant of praise to him the very potent, Through whom our sires, Angirases, singing praises, and knowing well the places, found the cattle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इच्छन्ति त्वा सोम्यासः सखायः सुन्वन्ति सोमं दधति प्रयासि। तितिक्षन्तेऽअभिशस्तिं जनानामिन्द्र त्वदा कश्चन हि प्रकेतः ॥१८ ॥
translation: The friends who offer Soma long to find thee: they pour forth Soma and present their viands. They bear, Unmoved, the cursing of the people, for all our wisdom comes from thee, O Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न ते दूरे परमा चिद् रजास्या तु प्र याहि हरिवो हरिभ्याम्। स्थिराय वृष्णे सवना कृतेमा युक्ता ग्रावाणः समिधानेऽअग्नौ ॥१९ ॥
translation: Not far for thee are mid-air’s loftiest regions: start hither, Lord of Bays, with both Bay Horses. Pressed for the Firm and Strong are these libations. The pressing-stones are set, the fire is kindled.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अषाढं युत्सु पृतनासु पप्रिꣳ स्वर्षामप्सां वृजनस्य गोपाम्। भरेषुजा सुक्षितिꣳ सुश्रवसं जयन्तं त्वामनु मदेम सोम ॥२० ॥
translation: Invincible in fight, saviour in battles, guard of our camp, winner of light and water, Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in thee may we rejoice, O Soma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमो धेनुꣳ सोमोऽअर्वन्तमाशुꣳ सोमो वीरं कर्मण्यं ददाति। सादन्यं विदथ्यꣳ सभेयं पितृश्रवणं यो ददाशदस्मै ॥२१ ॥
translation: To him who worships Soma gives a milch cow, a fleet steed, and a man of active knowledge, Skilled in home duties, competent in council, meet for the court, the glory of his father.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिमाऽओषधीः सोम विश्वास्त्वमपोऽअजनयस्त्वं गाः। त्वमा ततन्थोर्वन्तरिक्षं त्वं ज्योतिषा वि तमो ववर्थ ॥२२ ॥
translation: These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all these, O Soma, thou hast generated. The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the light thou hast dispelled the darkness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवेन नो मनसा देव सोम रायो भागꣳ सहसावन्नभि युध्य। मा त्वा तनदीशिषे वीर्य्यस्योभयेभ्यः प्र चिकित्सा गविष्टौ ॥२३ ॥
translation: Do thou, God Soma, with thy God-like spirit, victorious, win for us a share of riches. Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide for these and those in fight for cattle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अष्टौ व्यख्यत् ककुभः पृथिव्यास्त्री धन्व योजना सप्त सिन्धून्। हिरण्याक्षः सविता देवऽआगाद् दधद् रत्ना दाशुषे वार्य्याणि ॥२४ ॥
translation: The earth’s eight points his brightness hath illumined, three desert regions, and the Seven Rivers. God Savitar the gold-eyed hath come hither, giving choice treasures to the man who worships.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्यपाणिः सविता विचर्षणिरुभे द्यावापृथिवीऽअन्तरीयते। अपामीवां बाधते वेति सूर्य्यमभि कृष्णेन रजसा द्यामृणोति ॥२५ ॥
translation: Savitar, golden-handed, swiftly moving, goes on his way between the earth and heaven, Drives away sickness, bids the Sun approach us, and spreads the bright sky through the darksome region.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्यहस्तोऽअसुरः सुनीथः सुमृडीकः स्ववाँ यात्वर्वाङ्। अपसेधन् रक्षसो यातुधानानस्थाद् देवः प्रतिदोषं गृणानः ॥२६ ॥
translation: May, he, gold-handed Asura, kind leader, come hitherward to us with help and favour. Driving off Râkshasas and Yâtudhânas, the God is present, praised in hymns at evening.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये ते पन्थाः सवितः पूर्व्यासोऽरेणवः सुकृताऽअन्तरिक्षे। तेभिर्नोऽअद्य पथिभिः सुगेभी रक्षा च नोऽअधि च ब्रूहि देव ॥२७ ॥
translation: O Savitar, thine ancient dustless pathways are well established in the air’s mid-region. O God, come by those paths so fair to travel: preserve thou us from harm this day and bless us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभा पिबतमश्विनोभा नः शर्म यच्छतम्। अविद्रियाभिरूतिभिः ॥२८ ॥
translation: Drink our libations, Asvins twain, grant us protection, both of you, With aids which none may interrupt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्नस्वतीमश्विना वाचमस्मे कृतं नो दस्रा वृषणा मनीषाम्। अद्यूत्येऽवसे नि ह्वये वां वृधे च नो भवतं वाजसातौ ॥२९ ॥
translation: Make ye our speech effectual, O Asvins, and this our hymn, ye mighty Wonder-workers. In luckless game I call on you for succour: strengthen us also on the field of battle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्युभिरक्तुभिः परि पातमस्मानरिष्टेभिरश्विना सौभगेभिः। तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवीऽउत द्यौः ॥३० ॥
translation: With undiminished blessings, O ye Asvins, through days and nights on every side protect us. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ कृष्णेन रजसा वर्त्तमानो निवेशयन्नमृतं मर्त्यं च। हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेना देवो याति भुवनानि पश्यन् ॥३१ ॥
translation: Throughout the dusky firmament, etc., as in XXXIII. 43. 32 Night! the terrestrial realm hath been filled with the Father’s power and might. Thou spreadest thee on high unto the seats of heaven: terrific darkness cometh nigh.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति। येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ॥३३ ॥
translation: O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us that wondrous gift Wherewith we may support children and children’s sons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रातरग्निं प्रातरिन्द्रꣳ हवामहे प्रातर्मित्रावरुणा प्रातरश्विना। प्रातर्भगं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं प्रातः सोममुत रुद्रꣳ हुवेम ॥३४ ॥
translation: Agni at dawn, and Indra we invoke at dawn, and Varuna and Mitra and the Asvins twain, Bhaga at dawn, Pûshan and Brahmanaspati, Soma at dawn, Rudra may we invoke at dawn. 132
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रातर्जितं भगमुग्रꣳ हुवेम वयं पुत्रमदितेर्यो विधर्त्ता। आध्रश्चिद्यं मन्यमानस्तुरश्चिद् राजा चिद्यं भगं भक्षीत्याह ॥३५ ॥
translation: May we invoke strong early-conquering Bhaga, the Son of Aditi, the great Arranger, Thinking of whom the poor, yea, even the mighty, even the King says, Let me share in Bhaga.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भग प्रणेतर्भग सत्यराधो भगेमां धियमुदवा ददन्नः। भग प्र नो जनय गोभिरश्वैर्भग प्र नृभिर्नृवन्तः स्याम ॥३६ ॥
translation: Bhaga our guide, Bhaga whose gifts are faithful, favour this prayer and give us wealth, O Bhaga. Bhaga, increase our store of kine and horses: Bhaga, may we be rich in men and heroes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उतेदानीं भगवन्तः स्यामोत प्रपित्वऽउत मध्येऽअह्नाम्। उतोदिता मघवन्त्सूर्य्यस्य वयं देवाना सुमतौ स्याम ॥३७ ॥
translation: So may felicity be ours at present, and when the day approaches, and at noontide; And may we still, O Bounteous One, at sunset be happy in the Deities’ loving-kindness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भगऽएव भगवाँ२ऽअस्तु देवास्तेन वयं भगवन्तः स्याम। तं त्वा भग सर्वऽइज्जोहवीति स नो भग पुरऽएता भवेह ॥३८ ॥
translation: May Bhaga verily he Bliss-bestower, and through him, Gods! may happiness attend us. As such, O Bhaga, all with might invoke thee: as such be thou our Champion here, O Bhaga.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समध्वरायोषसो नमन्त दधिक्रावेव शुचये पदाय। अर्वाचीनं वसुविदं भगं नो रथमिवाश्वा वाजिनऽआ वहन्तु ॥३९ ॥
translation: To this our worship may the Dawns incline them, and come to the pure place like Dadhikrâvan. As strong steeds draw a chariot shay they bring us hitherward Bhaga who discovers treasure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्नऽउषासो वीरवतीः सदमुच्छन्तु भद्राः। घृतं दुहाना विश्वतः प्रपीता यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥४० ॥
translation: May friendly Mornings dawn on us for ever, with wealth of kine, of horses, and of heroes, Streaming with all abundance, pouring fatness. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पूषन्तव व्रते वयं न रिष्येम कदा चन। स्तोतारस्तऽइह स्मसि ॥४१ ॥
translation: Secure in thy protecting care, O Pûshan, never may we fail: We here are singers of thy praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पथस्पथः परिपतिं वचस्या कामेन कृतोऽअभ्यानडर्कम्। स नो रासच्छुरुधश्चन्द्राग्रा धियं धियꣳ सीषधाति प्र पूषा ॥४२ ॥
translation: I praise with eloquence hire who guards all pathways. He, when his love impelled him, went to Arka. May he vouchsafe us gear with gold to grace it: may Pûshan make each prayer of ours effective.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रीणि पदा विचक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपाऽअदाभ्यः। अतो धर्माणि धारयन् ॥४३ ॥
translation: Vishnu the undeceivable Protector strode three steps, thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवासः समिन्धते। विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम् ॥४४ ॥
translation: This, Vishnu’s station most sublime, the singers ever vigilant. Lovers of holy song, light up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घृतवती भुवनानामभिश्रियोर्वी पृथ्वी मधुदुघे सुपेशसा। द्यावापृथिवी वरुणस्य धर्मणा विष्कभितेऽअजरे भूरिरतेसा ॥४५ ॥
translation: Filled full of fatness, compassing all things that be, wide, spacious, dropping meath, beautiful in their form, The Heaven and the Earth by Varuna’s decree, unwasting, rich in seed, stand parted each from each.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये नः सपत्नाऽअप ते भवन्त्विन्द्राग्निभ्यामव बाधामहे तान्। वसवो रुद्राऽआदित्याऽउपरिस्पृशं मोग्रं चेत्तारमधिराजमक्रन् ॥४६ ॥
translation: Let those who are our foemen stand afar from us: with Indra and with Agni we will drive them off. Vasus, Âdityas, Rudras have exalted me, made me preëminent, mighty, thinker, sovran lord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नासत्या त्रिभिरेकादशैरिह देवेभिर्यातं मधुपेयमश्विना। प्रायुस्तारिष्टं नी रपासि मृक्षतꣳ सेधतं द्वेषो भवतꣳ सचाभुवा ॥४७ ॥
translation: Come, O Nâsatyas, with the thrice eleven Gods: come, O ye Asvins, to the drinking of the meath. Prolong our days of life, and wipe out all our sins: ward off our enemies; be with us evermore.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष व स्तोमो मरुतऽइयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः। एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥४८ ॥
translation: May this your praise, may this your song, O Maruts, sung by the poet, Mâna’s son, Mândârya, Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहस्तोमाः सहच्छन्दसऽआवृतः सहप्रमाऽऋषयः सप्त दैव्याः। पूर्वेषां पन्थामनुदृश्य धीराऽअन्वालेभिरे रथ्यो̫ न रश्मीन् ॥४९ ॥
translation: They who were versed in ritual and metre, in hymns and rules, were the Seven godlike Rishis. Viewing the path of those of old, the sages have taken up the reins like chariot- drivers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयुष्यं वर्च्चस्यꣳ रायस्पोषमौद्भिदम्। इदꣳ हिरण्यं वर्च्चस्वज्जैत्रायाविशतादु माम् ॥५० ॥
translation: Bestowing splendour, length of life, increase of wealth, and conquering power, This brightly shining gold shall be attached to me for victory. 133
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न तद्रक्षासि न पिशाचास्तरन्ति देवानामोजः प्रथमजꣳ ह्येतत्। यो बिभर्ति दाक्षायणꣳ हिरण्यꣳस देवेषु कृणुते दीर्घमायुः स मनुष्येषु कृणुते दीर्घमायुः ॥५१ ॥
translation: This gold no demons injure, no Pisâchas; for this is might of Gods, their primal offspring. Whoever wears the gold of Daksha’s children lives a long life among the Gods, lives a long life among mankind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदाबध्नन् दाक्षायणा हिरण्यꣳ शतानीकाय सुमनस्यमानाः। तन्मऽआ बध्नामि शतशारदायायुष्माञ्जरदष्टिर्यथासम् ॥५२ ॥
translation: This ornament of gold which Daksha’s children bound, with benevolent thoughts, on Satânîka, I bind on me for life through hundred autumns, that I may live till ripe old age o’ertakes me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणोत्वजऽएकपात् पृथिवी समुद्रः। विश्वे देवाऽऋतावृधो हुवानाः स्तुता मन्त्राः कविशस्ताऽअवन्तु ॥५३ ॥
translation: Let Ahibudhnya also hear our calling, and Aja-Ekapâd and Earth and Ocean. All Gods Law-strengtheners, invoked and lauded, and Texts recited by the sages, help us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा गिरऽआदित्येभ्यो घृतस्नूः सनाद्राजभ्यो जुह्वा जुहोमि। शृणोतु मित्रोऽअर्यमा भगो नस्तुविजातो वरुणो दक्षोऽअꣳशः ॥५४ ॥
translation: These hymns that drop down fatness, with the ladle I ever offer to the Kings Âdityas. May Mitra, Aryaman, and Bhaga hear us, the mighty Varuna, Daksha, and Amsa.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सप्तऽऋषयः प्रतिहिताः शरीरे सप्त रक्षन्ति सदमप्रमादम्। सप्तापः स्वपतो लोकमीयुस्तत्र जागृतोऽअस्वप्नजौ सत्रसदौ च देवौ ॥५५ ॥
translation: Seven Rishis are established in the body: seven guard it evermore with care unceasing. Seven waters seek the world of him who lies asleep: two sleepless Gods are feast-fellows of him who wakes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देवयन्तस्त्वेमहे। उप प्र यन्तु मरुतः सुदानवऽइन्द्र प्राशूर्भवा सचा ॥५६ ॥
translation: O Brahmanaspati, arise. God-fearing men, we pray to thee. May they who give good gifts, the Maruts, come to us. Indra, be thou most swift with them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र नूनं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्मन्त्रं वदत्युक्थ्यम्। यस्मिन्निन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रोऽअर्यमा देवाऽओकासि चक्रिरे ॥५७ ॥
translation: Now Brahmanaspati speaks forth aloud the solemn hymn of praise. Wherein Indra and Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, the Gods have made their dwelling-place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्पते त्वमस्य यन्ता सूक्तस्य बोधि तनयं च जिन्व। विश्वं तद्भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः। य इमा विश्वा। विश्वकर्म्मा। यो नः पिता। अन्नपतेऽन्नस्य नो देहि ॥५८ ॥
translation: O Brahmanaspati, be thou controller of this our hymn, and prosper thou our children. All that the Gods regard with love is blessèd. Loud may we speak, with brave sons, in assembly. He who sate down. Mighty in mind. Father who made us. A share of good, O Lord of Food. 134
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपेतो यन्तु पणयोऽसुम्ना देवपीयवः। अस्य लोकः सुतावतः। द्युभिरहोभिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्ववसानमस्मै ॥१ ॥
translation: BEGONE the Panis, hence away, rebellious, scorners of the Gods! The place is his who poured the juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सविता ते शरीरेभ्यः पृथिव्यां लोकमिच्छतु। तस्मै युज्यन्तामुस्रियाः ॥२ ॥
translation: Let Savitar approve a spot upon the earth for thy remains: And let the bulls be yoked for it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायुः पुनातु सविता पुनात्वग्नेर्भ्राजसा सूर्यस्य वर्चसा। वि मुच्यन्तामुस्रियाः ॥३ ॥
translation: Let Vâyu purify. Let Savitar purify. With Agni’s glitter. With Savitar’s lustre. Let the bulls be unyoked.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वत्थे वो निषदनं पर्णे वो वसतिष्कृता। गोभाजऽइत्किलासथ यत्सनवथ पूरुषम् ॥४ ॥
translation: The Holy Fig Tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna Tree: Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सविता ते शरीराणि मातुरुपस्थऽआ वपतु। तस्मै पृथिवि शं भव ॥५ ॥
translation: Let Savitar lay down thy bones committed to the Mother’s lap. Be pleasant to this man, O Earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रजापतौ त्वा देवतायामुपोदके लोके नि दधाम्यसौ। अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥६ ॥
translation: Here in the God Prajâpati, near water, Man, I lay thee down: May his light drive mishap from us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परं मृत्योऽ अनु परेहि पन्थां यस्तेऽ अन्यऽ इतरो देवयानात्। चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमि मा नः प्रजा रीरिषो मोत वीरान् ॥७ ॥
translation: Go hence, O Death, pursue thy special pathway apart from that which Gods are wont to travel. To thee I say it who hast eyes and hearest: Touch not our offspring, injure not our heroes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शं वातः शꣳ हि ते घृणिः शं ते भवन्त्विष्टकाः। शं ते भवन्त्वग्नयः पार्थिवासो मा त्वाभि शूशुचन् ॥८ ॥
translation: Pleasant to thee be wind and sun, and pleasant be the bricks to thee. Pleasant to thee be the terrestrial fires: let them not scorch thee in their flames.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कल्पन्तां ते दिशस्तुभ्यमापः शिवतमास्तुभ्यं भवन्तु सिन्धवः। अन्तरिक्षꣳ शिवं तुभ्यं कल्पन्तां ते दिशः सर्वाः ॥९ ॥
translation: Prosper for thee the regions and the waters, and let the seas for thee be most propitious. Auspicious unto thee be Air. Prosper all Quarters well for thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्मन्वती रीयते सꣳरभध्वमुत्तिष्ठत प्र तरता सखायः। अत्रा जहीमोऽशिवा येऽ असञ्छिवान्वयमुत्तरेमाभि वाजान् ॥१० ॥
translation: On flows the stony flood: hold fast each other, keep yourselves up, my friends, and pass the river. Here let us leave the powers that brought no profit, and cross the flood to Powers that are auspicious.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपाघमप किल्विषमप कृत्यामपो रपः। अपामार्ग त्वमस्मदप दुःष्वप्न्यꣳ सुव ॥११ ॥
translation: Drive away evil, drive away fault, sorcery, and guiltiness. Do thou, O Apâmârga, drive the evil dream away from us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुमित्रिया नऽआपऽओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु। योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः ॥१२ ॥
translation: To us let waters and the plants be friendly, to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनड्वाहमन्वारभामहे सौरभेयꣳ स्वस्तये। स नऽइन्द्रऽइव देवेभ्यो वह्निः सन्तरणो भव ॥१३ ॥
translation: For our prosperity we touch the ox the son of Surabhi. Be bearer and deliverer to us as Indra to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्वयन्तमसस्परि स्वः पश्यन्तऽउत्तरम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्य्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम् ॥१४ ॥
translation: Looking upon the loftiest light, etc., as in XX. 21.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मैषां नु गादपरोऽअर्थमेतम्। शतं जीवन्तु शरदः पुरूचीरन्तर्मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेन ॥१५ ॥
translation: Here I erect this rampart for the living: let none of these, none other, reach this limit. May they survive a hundred lengthened autumns, and may they bury Death beneath this mountain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्नऽआयूषि पवसऽ आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः। आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् ॥१६ ॥
translation: Agni, thou pourest life, etc., as in XIX. 38.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयुष्मानग्ने हविषा वृधानो घृतप्रतीको घृतयोनिरेधि। घृतं पीत्वा मधु चारु गव्यं पितेव पुत्रमभि रक्षतादिमान्त्स्वाहा ॥१७ ॥
translation: Waxing with sacrifice live long, O Agni, with butter on thy face and homed in fatness. When thou hast drunk the cows’ fair savoury butter, guard, as a father guards his son, these people.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परीमे गामनेषत पर्यग्निमहृषत। देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः कऽ इमाँ२ऽ आ दधर्षति ॥१८ ॥
translation: These men have led about the ox, have duly carried Agni round, And raised their glory to the Gods. Who will attack them with success?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्रव्यादमग्निं प्र हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्यं गच्छतु रिप्रवाहः। इहैवायमितरो जातवेदा देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन् ॥१९ ॥
translation: I drive Corpse-eating Agni to a distance: sin-laden let him go to Yama’s kingdom. Here let this other, Jâtavedas, carry oblation to the Deities, foreknowing. 135
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वह वपां जातवेदः पितृभ्यो यत्रैनान् वेत्थ निहितान् पराके। मेदसः कुल्याऽ उप तान्त्स्रवन्तु सत्याऽ एषामाशिषः सं नमन्ता स्वाहा ॥२० ॥
translation: Carry the fat to Fathers, Jâtavedas, where, far away, thou knowest, them established. Let rivulets of marrow flow to meet them, and let their truthful wishes be accomplished. All-hail!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्योना पृथिवि नो भवानृक्षरा निवेशनी। यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथाः। अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥२१ ॥
translation: Pleasant be thou to us, O Earth, without a thorn, our resting-place. Vouchsafe us shelter reaching far. May thy light drive mishap from us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मात्त्वमधि जातोऽसि त्वदयं जायतां पुनः। असौ स्वर्गाय लोकाय स्वाहा ॥२२ ॥
translation: Born art thou, Agni, from this man: let him again be born from thee, For Svarga’s world, the man I name. All-hail! 136
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋचं वाचं प्र पद्ये मनो यजुः प्र पद्ये साम प्राणं प्र पद्ये चक्षुः श्रोत्रं प्र पद्ये। वागोजः सहौजो मयि प्राणापानौ ॥१ ॥
translation: REFUGE I take in Speech as Rich: refuge in Mind as Yajus-text; refuge in Breath as Sâma- chant; refuge in Hearing and in Sight. Speech-energy endowed with strength, inbreath and outbreath are in me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यन्मे छिद्रं चक्षुषो हृदयस्य मनसो वातितृण्णं बृहस्पतिर्मे तद्दधातु। शं नो भवतु भुवनस्य यस्पतिः ॥२ ॥
translation: Whatever deeply-sunk defect I have of eye, or mind, or heart, that way Brihaspati amend! Gracious to us be he, Protector of the world.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भूर्भुवः स्वः। तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि। धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥३ ॥
translation: Earth! Ether! Heaven! May we attain that excellent, etc., as in III. 33.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कया नश्चित्रऽ आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा। कया शचिष्ठया वृता ॥४ ॥
translation: With what help will he come to us etc., as in XXVII. 39.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मꣳहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः। दृढा चिदारुजे वसु ॥५ ॥
translation: What genuine, etc., as in XXVII. 40.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम्। शतं भवास्यूतिभिः ॥६ ॥
translation: Do thou who art, etc., as in XXVII. 41.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कया त्वं नऽ ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन्। कया स्तोतृभ्यऽ आ भर ॥७ ॥
translation: O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring Riches to those who worship thee?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो विश्वस्य राजति। शन्नोऽअस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥८ ॥
translation: Indra is king of all that is: may weal attend our bipeds and our quadrupeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शन्नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शन्नो भवत्वर्यमा। शन्नऽ इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः शन्नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः ॥९ ॥
translation: Gracious he Mitra unto us, and Varuna and Aryaman; Indra, Brihaspati be kind, and Vishnu of the mighty stride.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शन्नो वातः पवता शन्नस्तपतु सूर्यः। शन्नः कनिक्रदद्देवः पर्जन्योऽअभि वर्षतु ॥१० ॥
translation: Pleasantly blow the wind for us, may Sûrya warm us pleasantly. Pleasantly, with a roar, the God Parjanya send the rain on us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहानि शं भवन्तु नः शꣳ रात्रीः प्रति धीयताम्। शन्नऽ इन्द्राग्नी भवतामवोभिः शन्नऽ इन्द्रावरुणा रातहव्या। शन्नऽ इन्द्रापूषणा वाजसातौ शमिन्द्रासोमा सुविताय शंयोः ॥११ ॥
translation: May days pass pleasantly for us, may nights draw near delightfully. Befriend us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and Varuna who taste oblations. Indra and Pûshan be our help in battle, Indra and Soma give health, strength, and comfort.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शन्नो देवीरभिष्टयऽआपो भवन्तु पीतये। शंयोरभि स्रवन्तु नः ॥१२ ॥
translation: May the celestial Waters, our helpers, be sweet for us to drink, And flow with health and strength to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्योना पृथिवि नो भवानृक्षरा निवेशनी। यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथाः ॥१३ ॥
translation: Pleasant be thou to us, O Earth, etc., as in XXXV. 21.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता नऽ ऊर्जे दधातन। महे रणाय चक्षसे ॥१४ ॥
translation: Ye, Waters, are, etc., as in XL 50.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः। उशतीरिव मातरः ॥१५ ॥
translation: Give us a portion, etc., as in XI. 51.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्माऽ अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ। आपो जनयथा च नः ॥१६ ॥
translation: To you we gladly come, etc., as in XI. 52,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्यौः शान्तिरन्तरिक्षꣳ शान्तिः पृथिवी शान्तिरापः शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिः। वनस्पतयः शान्तिर्विश्वे देवाः शान्तिर्ब्रह्म शान्तिः सर्वꣳ शान्तिः शान्तिरेव शान्तिः सा मा शान्तिरेधि ॥१७ ॥
translation: Sky alleviation, Air alleviation, Earth alleviation, Plants alleviation, Trees alleviation, All- Gods alleviation, Brahma alleviation, Universe alleviation, just Alleviation alleviation—may that alleviation come to me!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दृते दृꣳह मा मित्रस्य मा चक्षुषा सर्वाणि भूतानि समीक्षन्ताम्। मित्रस्याऽहं चक्षुषा सर्वाणि भूतानि समीक्षे। मित्रस्य चक्षुषा समीक्षामहे ॥१८ ॥
translation: Caldron, strengthen me. May all beings regard me with the eye of a friend. May I regard all beings with the eye of a friend. With the eye of a friend do we regard one another.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दृते दृꣳह मा। ज्योक्ते संदृशि जीव्यासं ज्योक्ते संदृशि जीव्यासम् ॥१९ ॥
translation: Do thou, O Caldron, strengthen me. Long may I live to look on thee. Long may I live to look on thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमस्ते हरसे शोचिषे नमस्तेऽअस्त्वर्चिषे। अन्याँस्तेऽअस्मत्तपन्तु हेतयः पावकोऽअस्मभ्यꣳशिवो भव ॥२० ॥
translation: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow, etc., as in XXII. 11.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमस्तेऽअस्तु विद्युते नमस्ते स्तनयित्नवे। नमस्ते भगवन्नस्तु यतः स्वः समीहसे ॥२१ ॥
translation: Homage to thee the lightning flash, homage to thee the thunder’s roar! Homage, O Bounteous Lord, to thee whereas thou fain wouldst win to heaven!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यतोयतः समीहसे ततो नोऽअभयं कुरु। शं नः कुरु प्रजाभ्योऽभयं नः पशुभ्यः ॥२२ ॥
translation: From whatsoever trouble thou desirest, give us safety thence. Give to our children happiness and to our beasts security. 137
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुमित्रिया नऽआपऽओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु। योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः ॥२३ ॥
translation: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly, etc., as in VI. 23.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तच्चक्षुर्देवहितं पुरस्ताच्छुक्रमुच्चरत्। पश्येम शरदः शतं जीवेम शरदः शतꣳ शृणुयाम शरदः शतं प्र ब्रवाम शरदः शतमदीनाः स्याम शरदः शतं भूयश्च शरदः शतात् ॥२४ ॥
translation: Through hundred autumns may we see that bright Eye, God-appointed, rise, A hundred autumns may we live. Through hundred autumns may we hear; through hundred autumns clearly speak: through hundred autumns live content; a hundred autumns, yea, beyond a hundred autumns may we see. 138
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददे नारिरसि ॥१ ॥
translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, etc. Spade art thou. Woman art thou, etc., as in XI. 9, 10.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जते मनऽउत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः। वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेकऽइन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः ॥२ ॥
translation: The priests of him the lofty Priest, etc., as in V. 14.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवी द्यावापृथिवी मखस्य वामद्य शिरो राध्यासं देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे ॥३ ॥
translation: O Heaven and Earth divine, may I duly prepare for you this day the head of Makha on the place of earth where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देव्यो वम्र्यो भूतस्य प्रथमजा मखस्य वोऽद्य शिरो राध्यासं देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे ॥४ ॥
translation: Ye who were born the earliest of creation, Ants divine, may I duly prepare for you this day the head of Makha on the place of earth where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इयत्यग्रऽआसीन्मखस्य तेऽद्य शिरो राध्यासं देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे ॥५ ॥
translation: Only so large was it at first. Duly may I prepare for you this day the head of Makha on earth’s place where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्यौज स्थ मखस्य वोऽद्य शिरो राध्यासं देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे ॥६ ॥
translation: Indra’s effective might are ye. Duly may I prepare for you this day the head of Makha on earth’s place where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता। अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे ॥७ ॥
translation: May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, etc., as in XXXIII. 89. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha, etc., as in verse 6.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मखस्य शिरोऽसि। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखस्य शिरोऽसि। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखस्य शिरोऽसि। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे ॥८ ॥
translation: Thou art the head of Makha. Thee for Makha, thee for Makha’s head! Thou art the head of Makha. Thee for Makha, thee for Makha’s head! Thou art the head of Makha, thee for Makha, thee for Makha’s head! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha, etc., as in verse 6.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वस्य त्वा वृष्णः शक्ना धूपयामि देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। अश्वस्य त्वा वृष्णः शक्ना धूपयामि देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। अश्वस्य त्वा वृष्णः शक्ना धूपयामि देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे ॥९ ॥
translation: Thee on Gods’ sacrificial ground with stallion’s dung I fumigate. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋजवे त्वा साधवे त्वा सुक्षित्यै त्वा। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे ॥१० ॥
translation: Thee for the True. Thee for the Good. Thee for the place of happy rest. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमाय त्वा मखाय त्वा सूर्य्यस्य त्वा तपसे। देवस्त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु पृथिव्याः सꣳस्पृशस्पाहि। अर्चिरसि शोचिरसि तपोऽसि ॥११ ॥
translation: For Yama thee. For Makha thee. For Sûrya’s fervent ardour thee. May Savitar the God with balm anoint thee. Guard thou the touches of the earth. Flame art thou; thou art radiance; thou art heat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनाधृष्टा पुरस्तादग्नेराधिपत्यऽआयुर्मे दाः। पुत्रवती दक्षिणतऽइन्द्रस्याऽधिपत्ये प्रजां मे दाः। सुषदा पश्चाद्देवस्य सवितुराधिपत्ये चक्षुर्मे दाः। आश्रुतिरुत्तरतो धातुराधिपत्ये रायस्पोषं मे दाः। विधृतिरुपरिष्टाद् बृहस्पतेराधिपत्यऽओजो मे दाः। विश्वाभ्यो मा नाष्ट्राभ्यस्पाहि मनोरश्वासि ॥१२ ॥
translation: Unconquerable, eastward, in Agni’s overlordship, give me life. Rich in sons, southward, in Indra’s overlordship give me offspring. Fair-seated, westward, in God. Savitar’s overlordship, give me sight. Range of hearing, northward, in Dhâtar’s overlordship, give me increase of wealth. Arrangement, upward, in Brihaspati’s overlordship, give me energy. From all destructive spirits guard us. Thou art Manu’s mare.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वाहा मरुद्भिः परि श्रीयस्व दिवः सꣳस्पृशस्पाहि। मधु मधु मधु ॥१३ ॥
translation: All-hail! By Maruts be thou compassed round. Guard the sky’s touches. Mead, mead, mead.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गर्भो देवानां पिता मतीनां पतिः प्रजानाम्। सं देवो देवेन सवित्रा गत सꣳसूर्य्येण रोचते ॥१४ ॥
translation: Germ of the Gods, Father of hymns, all living creatures’ guardian Lord, Radiant, with radiant Savitar united, with the Sun he shines.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समग्निरग्निना गत सं दैवेन सवित्रा सꣳ सूर्य्येणारोचिष्ट। स्वाहा समग्निस्तपसा गत सं दैव्येन सवित्रा सꣳसूर्य्येणारूरुचत ॥१५ ॥
translation: Agni combined with flaming fire, combined with Savitar divine, hath shone together with the Sun. 139
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धर्त्ता दिवो वि भाति तपसस्पृथिव्यां धर्त्ता देवो देवानाममर्त्यस्तपोजाः। वाचमस्मे नि यच्छ देवायुवम् ॥१६ ॥
translation: He shines on earth upholder of the sky and heat, the Gods upholder, God, immortal, born of heat. To him address a speech devoted to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम्। स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसानऽआ वरीवर्त्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः ॥१७ ॥
translation: I saw the Herdsman, him who never stumbles, approaching by his pathways and departing. He, clothed with gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वासां भुवां पते विश्वस्य मनसस्पते विश्वस्य वचसस्पते सर्वस्य वचसस्पते। देवश्रुत्त्वं देव घर्म देवो देवान् पाह्यत्र प्रावीरनु वां देववीतये। मधु माध्वीभ्यां मधु माधूचीभ्याम् ॥१८ ॥
translation: Lord of all earths, Lord of all mind, Lord of all speech, thou Lord of speech entire. Heard by the Gods, Caldron divine, do thou, a God, protect the Gods. Here, after, let it speed you twain on to the banquet of the Gods. Sweetness for both the sweetness-lovers! Sweetness for those the twain who take delight in sweetness!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हृदे त्वा मनसे त्वा दिवे त्वा सूर्य्याय त्वा। ऊर्ध्वोऽअध्वरं दिवि देवेषु धेहि ॥१९ ॥
translation: Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the sky, for Sûrya thee. Standing erect lay thou the sacrifice in heaven among the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिता नोऽसि पिता नो बोधि नमस्तेऽअस्तु मा मा हिꣳसीः। त्वष्टृमन्तस्त्वा सपेम पुत्रान् पशून् मयि धेहि प्रजामस्मासु धेह्यरिष्टाहꣳ सह पत्या भूयासम् ॥२० ॥
translation: Thou art our Father, father-like regard us. Obeisance be to thee. Do not thou harm us. May we, accompanied by Tvashtar, win thee. Vouchsafe me sons and cattle. Grant us offspring. Safe may I be together with my husband.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहः केतुना जुषता सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषा स्वाहा। रात्रिः केतुना जुषता सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषा स्वाहा ॥२१ ॥
translation: May Day together with his sheen, pair-lighted with his light, accept. All-hail! May Night together with her sheen, fair lighted with her. light, accept. All-hail! 140
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददेऽदित्यै रास्नाऽसि ॥१ ॥
translation: BY impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the Hands of Pûshan. A zone for Aditi art thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इडऽएह्यदितऽएहि सरस्वत्येहि। असावेह्यसावेह्यसावेहि ॥२ ॥
translation: Idâ, come hither. Aditi, come hither. Sarasvatî, come hither. Come hither, So-and-So. Come hither, So-and-So. Come hither, So-and-So.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदित्यै रास्नासीन्द्राण्याऽउष्णीषः। पूषासि घर्माय दीष्व ॥३ ॥
translation: Thou art a zone for Aditi, a diadem for Indrânî. Pûshan art thou. Spare some for the Gharma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विभ्यां पिन्वस्व सरस्वत्यै पिन्वस्वेन्द्राय पिन्वस्व। स्वाहेन्द्रवत् स्वाहेन्द्रवत् स्वाहेन्द्रवत् ॥४ ॥
translation: Overflow for the Asvins. Overflow for Sarasvatî. Overflow for Indra All-hail, what belongs to Indra! All-hail, what belongs to Indra! All-hail, what belongs to Indra!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते स्तनः शशयो यो मयोभूर्यो रत्नधा वसुविद्यः सुदत्रः। येन विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्य्याणि सरस्वति तमिह धातवेऽकः। उर्वन्तरिक्षमन्वेमि ॥५ ॥
translation: That breast of thine, exhaustless, fount of pleasure, wealth-giver, treasure-finder, free- bestower, Wherewith thou rearest all things that are choicest,—bring that, Sarasvatî, that we may drain it. Throughout the spacious middle air I travel.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गायत्रं छन्दोऽसि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दोऽसि द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां त्वा परि गृह्णाम्यन्तरिक्षेणोप यच्छामि। इन्द्राश्विना मधुनः सारघस्य घर्मं पात वसवो यजत वाट्। स्वाहा सूर्य्यस्य रश्मये वृष्टिवनये ॥६ ॥
translation: Thou art Gâyatra metre. Thou art Trishtup metre. With Heaven and Earth I grasp thee. With the Firmament I raise thee up. Indra and Asvins, drink ye the hot draught of sweet honey: sacrifice, ye Vasus. Vât! All-hail to the rain-winning beam of the Sun!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्राय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा। सरिराय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा। अनाधृष्याय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा। अप्रतिधृष्याय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा। अवस्यवे त्वा वाताय स्वाहा। अशिमिदाय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा ॥७ ॥
translation: Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the sea. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the flood. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the unconquerable. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the irresistible. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the protection-seeker. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the non-destructive.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय त्वा वसुमते रुद्रवते स्वाहेन्द्राय त्वादित्यवते स्वाहेन्द्राय त्वाभिमातिघ्ने स्वाहा। सवित्रे त्वऽऋभुमते विभुमते वाजवते स्वाहा बृहस्पतये त्वा विश्वदेव्यावते स्वाहा ॥८ ॥
translation: Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Vasus. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Rudras. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra killer of foes. Thee with Svâhâ to Savitar attended by Ribhu, Vibhu, and Vâja. Thee with Svâhâ to Brihaspati beloved of all the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमाय त्वाङ्गिरस्वते पितृमते स्वाहा। स्वाहा घर्माय स्वाहा घर्मः पित्रे ॥९ ॥
translation: Svâhâ to Yama attended by the Angirases, attended by the Fathers! Svâhâ to the Gharma! The Gharma for the Father!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वाऽआशा दक्षिणसद् विश्वान् देवानयाडिह। स्वाहाकृतस्य घर्मस्य मधोः पिबतमश्विना ॥१० ॥
translation: Here hath he worshipped, seated south, all the sky-regions, all the Gods. Drink, Asvins, of the heated draught, the Svâhâ-consecrated mead.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवि धाऽइमं यज्ञमिमं यज्ञं दिवि धाः। स्वाहाऽग्नये यज्ञियाय शं यजुर्भ्यः ॥११ ॥
translation: In heaven lay thou this sacrifice; lay thou this sacrifice in heaven. To sacrificial Agni hail! May bliss be ours from Yajus texts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना घर्मं पातꣳ हार्द्वानमहर्दिवाभिरूतिभिः। तन्त्रायिणे नमो द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम् ॥१२ ॥
translation: Drink, Asvins, with your daily helps, the Gharma, strengthener of hearts. To him who draweth out the thread be homage, and to Heaven and Earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपातामश्विना घर्ममनु द्यावापृथिवी अमꣳसाताम्। इहैव रातयः सन्तु ॥१३ ॥
translation: The Gharma have the Asvins drunk: with Heaven and Earth have they agreed. Here, verily, be their boons bestowed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषे पिन्वस्वोर्जे पिन्वस्व ब्रह्मणे पिन्वस्व क्षत्राय पिन्वस्व द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां पिन्वस्व। धर्मासि सुधर्मामेन्यस्मे नृम्णानि धारय ब्रह्म धारय क्षत्रं धारय विशं धारय ॥१४ ॥
translation: Overflow for food. Overflow for energy. Overflow for the Priesthood. Overflow for the Nobility. Overflow for Heaven and Earth. Thou, O duteous one, art Duty. Innocent one, in us establish manly powers; establish the People.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वाहा पूष्णे शरसे स्वाहा ग्रावभ्यः स्वाहा प्रतिरवेभ्यः। स्वाहा पितृभ्यऽ ऊर्ध्वबर्हिर्भ्यो घर्मपावभ्यः स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्या स्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः ॥१५ ॥
translation: All-hail to Pûshan, to the milk’s skin! All-hail to the press-stones! All-hail to their echoes! All-hail to the Fathers who are above the grass, who drink the Gharma! All-hail to Heaven and Earth! All-hail to the All-Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वाहा रुद्राय रुद्रहूतये स्वाहा सं ज्योतिषा ज्योतिः। अहः केतुना जुषता सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषा स्वाहा। रात्रिः केतुना जुषता सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषा स्वाहा। मधु हुतमिन्द्रतमेऽअग्नावश्याम ते देव घर्म नमस्तेऽअस्तु मा मा हिꣳसीः ॥१६ ॥
translation: All-hail to Rudra invoked by worshippers! All-hail! Let light combine with light. May Day together with his sheen, fair-lighted with his light, accept. All hail! May Night together 141 with her sheen, fair-lighted with her light, accept. All-hail! May we enjoy the mead offered in most Indra-like Agni. Homage to thee, divine Gharma! Do not thou injure me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभीमं महिमा दिवं विप्रो बभूव सप्रथाः। उत श्रवसा पृथिवी सꣳ सीदस्व महाँ२ऽ असि रोचस्व देववीतमः। वि धूममग्नेऽअरुषं मियेद्ध्य सृज प्रशस्त दर्शतम् ॥१७ ॥
translation: Thy far-spread majesty, instinct with wisdom, hath surpassed this heaven, And, with its glorious fame, the earth. Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke ruddy and beautiful to see.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या ते घर्म दिव्या शुग्या गायत्र्या हविर्धाने। सा तऽ आ प्यायतान्निष्ट्यायतां तस्यै ते स्वाहा। या ते घर्मान्तरिक्षे शुग्या त्रिष्टुभ्याग्नीध्रे। सा तऽ आ प्यायतान्निष्ट्यायतां तस्यै ते स्वाहा। या ते घर्म पृथिव्या शुग्या जगत्या सदस्या। सा तऽ आ प्यायतान्निष्ट्यायतां तस्यै ते स्वाहा ॥१८ ॥
translation: Gharma, that heavenly light of thine in Gâyatrî, in the Soma-store,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine in air, in Trishtup, in the sacred hearth,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine on earth, in Jagatî, of the priest’s shed,— May that increase and be confirmed for thee, that light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्षत्रस्य त्वा परस्पाय ब्रह्मणस्तन्वं पाहि। विशस्त्वा धर्मणा वयमनु क्रामाम सुविताय नव्यसे ॥१९ ॥
translation: Thee for the sure protection of the Nobles. Guard thou from injury the Brahman’s body. We follow thee in interest of the People, for the renewal of our peace and comfort.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चतुःस्रक्तिर्नाभिर्ऋतस्य सप्रथाः स नो विश्वायुः सप्रथाः स नः सर्वायुः सप्रथाः। अप द्वेषोऽअप ह्वरोऽन्यव्रतस्य सश्चिम ॥२० ॥
translation: Square, far-spread is the sacrifice’s navel: it spreads for us wide, full of all existence, spreads wide for us full of complete existence. We turn against the hate and guiles of him who keeps an alien law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घर्मैतत्ते पुरीषं तेन वर्द्धस्व चा च प्यायस्व। वर्द्धिषीमहि च वयमा च प्यासिषीमहि ॥२१ ॥
translation: This, Gharma! is thy liquid store. Swell out and wax in strength thereby. May we too grow in strength and wax to greatness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अचिक्रदद् वृषा हरिर्महान् मित्रो न दर्शतः। सꣳ सूर्य्येण दिद्युतदुदधिर्निधिः ॥२२ ॥
translation: Loudly the tawny Stallion neighed, mighty, like Mitra fair to see. Together with the Sun the sea, the store shone out with flashing light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुमित्रिया नऽ आपऽ ओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु। योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः ॥२३ ॥
translation: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्वयन्तमसस्परि स्वः पश्यन्तऽ उत्तरम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम् ॥२४ ॥
translation: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एधोऽस्येधिषीमहि समिदसि तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धेहि ॥२५ ॥
translation: A brand art thou, fain would we thrive, Fuel art thou, and splendour: Give me splendour,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यावती द्यावापृथिवी यावच्च सप्त सिन्धवो वितस्थिरे। तावन्तमिन्द्र ते ग्रहमूर्जा गृह्णाम्यक्षितं मयि गृह्णाम्यक्षितम् ॥२६ ॥
translation: Far as the heaven and earth are spread in compass, far as the Seven Rivers are extended, So vast thy cup which I with strength am taking, Indra, unharmed in me, uninjured ever.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मयि त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहन्मयि दक्षो मयि क्रतुः। घर्मस्त्रिशुग्वि राजति विराजा ज्योतिषा सह ब्रह्मणा तेजसा सह ॥२७ ॥
translation: In me be that great hero power, in me be strength and mental force: The Gharma shines with triple light, with lustre fulgent far away, with holy lore, with brilliancy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पयसो रेतऽआभृतं तस्य दोहमशीमह्युत्तरामुत्तरा समाम्। त्विषः संवृक् क्रत्वे दक्षस्य ते सुषुम्णस्य ते सुषुम्णाग्निहुतः। इन्द्रपीतस्य प्रजापतिभक्षितस्य मधुमतऽ उपहूतऽ उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि ॥२८ ॥
translation: Brought hither is the seed of milk. Through each succeeding year may we enjoy the bliss of draining it. Invited, I enjoy a share of that which hath been offered me, the savoury draught by Indra drunk and tasted by Prajâpati. 142
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वाहा प्राणेभ्यः साधिपतिकेभ्यः। पृथिव्यै स्वाहाऽग्नये स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा वायवे स्वाहा। दिवे स्वाहा। सूर्याय स्वाहा ॥१ ॥
translation: SVÂHÂ to the Vital Breathings with their Controlling Lord! To Earth Svâhâ! To Agni Svâhâ! To Firmament, Svâhâ! To Vâyu Svâhâ! To Sky Svâhâ! To Sûrya Svâhâ!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिग्भ्यः स्वाहा चन्द्राय स्वाहा नक्षत्रेभ्यः स्वाहाऽद्भ्यः स्वाहा वरुणाय स्वाहा। नाभ्यै स्वाहा पूताय स्वाहा ॥२ ॥
translation: To the Quarters Svâhâ! To the Moon Svâhâ! To the Stars Svâhâ! To the Waters Svâhâ! To Varuna Svâhâ! To the Navel Svâhâ! To the Purified Svâhâ!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाचे स्वाहा प्राणाय स्वाहा प्राणाय स्वाहा। चक्षुषे स्वाहा चक्षुषे स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा ॥३ ॥
translation: To Speech Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मनसः काममाकूतिं वाचः सत्यमशीय। पशूना रूपमन्नस्य रसो यशः श्रीः श्रयतां मयि स्वाहा ॥४ ॥
translation: The wish and purpose of the mind and truth of speech may I obtain. Bestowed on me be cattle’s form, swept taste of food, and fame and grace. Svâhâ!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रजापतिः सम्भ्रियमाणः सम्राट् सम्भृतो वैश्वदेवः सꣳसन्नो घर्मः प्रवृक्तस्तेजऽउद्यतऽआश्विनः पयस्यानीयमाने पौष्णो विष्यन्दमाने मारुतः क्लथन्। मैत्रः शरसि सन्ताय्यमाने वायव्यो ह्रियमाणऽआग्नेयो हूयमानो वाग्घुतः ॥५ ॥
translation: Prajâpati while in preparation; Samrâj when prepared; All-Gods’ when seated; Gharma when heated with fire; Splendour when lifted up; the Asvins’ while milk is poured in; Pûshan’s when the butter trickles down it; the Maruts’ when the milk is clotting; Mitra’s when the milk’s skin is spreading; Vâyu’s when it is carried off; Agni’s while offered as oblation; Vâk when it has been offered.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सविता प्रथमेऽहन्नग्निर्द्वितीये वायुस्तृतीयऽआदित्यश्चतुर्थे। चन्द्रमाः पञ्चमऽऋतुः षष्ठे मरुतः सप्तमे बृहस्पतिरष्टमे मित्रो नवमे वरुणो दशमऽइन्द्रऽएकादशे विश्वे देवा द्वादशे ॥६ ॥
translation: Savitar on the first day; Agni on the second; Vâyu on the third; Âditya (the Sun) on the fourth; Chandramâs (the Moon) on the fifth; Ritu on the sixth; the Maruts on the seventh; Brihaspati on the eighth; Mitra on the ninth; Varuna on the tenth; Indra on the eleventh; the All-Gods on the twelfth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उग्रश्च भीमश्च ध्वान्तश्च धुनिश्च। सासह्वाँश्चाभियुग्वा च विक्षिपः स्वाहा ॥७ ॥
translation: Fierce; Terrible; The Resonant; The Roarer; Victorious; Assailant; and Dispeller. Svâhâ.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निꣳ हृदयेनाशनिꣳहृदयाग्रेण पशुपतिं कृत्स्नहृदयेन भवं यक्ना। शर्वं मतस्नाभ्यामीशानं मन्युना महादेवमन्तःपर्शव्येनोग्रं देवं वनिष्ठुना वसिष्ठहनुः शिङ्गीनि कोश्याभ्याम् ॥८ ॥
translation: Agni with the heart; Lightning with the heart’s point; Pasupati with the whole heart; Bhava with the liver. Sarva with the two cardiac bones; Îsâna with Passion; Mahâdeva with the intercostal flesh; the Fierce God with the rectum; Vasishtha-hanuh, Singis with two lumps of flesh near the heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उग्रं लोहितेन मित्रꣳ सौव्रत्येन रुद्रं दौर्व्रत्येनेन्द्रं प्रक्रीडेन मरुतो बलेन साध्यान् प्रमुदा। भवस्य कण्ठ्यꣳ रुद्रस्यान्तः पार्श्व्यं महादेवस्य यकृच्छर्वस्य वनिष्ठुः पशुपतेः पुरीतत् ॥९ ॥
translation: The Fierce with blood; Mitra with obedience, Rudra with disobedience; Indra with pastime; the Maruts with strength; the Sâdhyas with enjoyment. Bhava’s is what is on the throat; Rudra’s what is between the ribs; Mahâdeva’s is the liver; Sarva’s the rectum; Pasupati’s the pericardium.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: लोमभ्यः स्वाहा लोमभ्यः स्वाहा त्वचे स्वाहा त्वचे स्वाहा लोहिताय स्वाहा लोहिताय स्वाहा मेदोभ्यः स्वाहा मेदोभ्यः स्वाहा। मासेभ्यः स्वाहा मासेभ्यः स्वाहा स्नावभ्यः स्वाहा स्नावभ्यः स्वाहाऽस्थभ्यः स्वाहाऽस्थभ्यः स्वाहा मज्जभ्यः स्वाहा मज्जभ्यः स्वाहा। रेतसे स्वाहा पायवे स्वाहा ॥१० ॥
translation: To the hair Svâhâ! To the hair Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! Svâhâ to the bones! Svâhâ to the bones! To the marrows Svâhâ! To the marrows Svâhâ! To the seed Svâhâ! To the anus Svâhâ!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयासाय स्वाहा प्रायासाय स्वाहा संयासाय स्वाहा वियासाय स्वाहोद्यासाय स्वाहा। शुचे स्वाहा शोचते स्वाहा शोचमानाय स्वाहा शोकाय स्वाहा ॥११ ॥
translation: To Effort Svâhâ! To Exertion Svâhâ! To Endeavour Svâhâ! To Viyâsa Svâhâ! To Attempt Svâhâ!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तपसे स्वाहा तप्यते स्वाहा तप्यमानाय स्वाहा तप्ताय स्वाहा घर्माय स्वाहा। निष्कृत्यै स्वाहा प्रायश्चित्यै स्वाहा भेषजाय स्वाहा ॥१२ ॥
translation: To Grief Svâhâ! To the Grieving Svâhâ! To the Sorrowing Svâhâ! To Sorrow Svâhâ! To Heat Svâhâ! To him who grows hot Svâhâ! To him who is being heated Svâhâ! To him who has been heated Svâhâ! To Gharma Svâhâ! To Atonement Svâhâ! To Expiation Svâhâ! To Remedy Svâhâ!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमाय स्वाहाऽन्तकाय स्वाहा मृत्यवे स्वाहा ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा ब्रह्महत्यायै स्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्या स्वाहा ॥१३ ॥
translation: To Yama Svâhâ! To the Finisher Svâhâ! To Death Svâhâ! To the Priesthood Svâhâ! To Brâhmanicide Svâhâ! To the All-Gods Svâhâ! To Heaven and Earth Svâhâ! 143
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईशा वास्यमिदंꣳ सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत्। तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्य स्विद्धनम् ॥१ ॥
translation: ENVELOPED by the Lord must be This All—each thing that moves on earth. With that renounced enjoy thyself. Covet no wealth of any man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुर्वन्नेवेह कर्माणि जिजीविषेच्छतꣳ समाः। एवं त्वयि नान्यथेतोऽस्ति न कर्म लिप्यते नरे ॥२ ॥
translation: One, only doing Karma here, should wish to live a hundred years. No way is there for thee but this. So Karma cleaveth not to man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असुर्य्या नाम लोकाऽअन्धेन तमसावृताः। ताँस्ते प्रेत्यापि गच्छन्ति ये के चात्महनो जनाः ॥३ ॥
translation: Aye, to the Asuras belong those worlds enwrapt in blinding gloom. To them, when life on earth is done, depart the men who kill the Self.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनेजदेकं मनसो जवीयो नैनद्देवाऽआप्नुवन् पूर्वमर्षत्। तद्धावतोऽन्यानत्येति तिष्ठत्तस्मिन्नपो मातरिश्वा दधाति ॥४ ॥
translation: Motionless, one, swifter than Mind—the Devas failed to o’ertake it speeding on before them. It, standing still, outstrips the others running. Herein Both Mâtarisvan stablish Action.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदेजति तन्नैजति तद् दूरे तद्वन्तिके। तदन्तरस्य सर्वस्य तदु सर्वस्यास्य बाह्यतः ॥५ ॥
translation: It moveth; it is motionless. It is far distant; it is near. It is within This All; and it surrounds This All externally.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मन्नेवानुपश्यति। सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ततो न वि चिकित्सति ॥६ ॥
translation: The man who in his Self beholds all creatures and all things that be, And in all beings sees his Self, thence doubts no longer, ponders not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मिन्त्सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मैवाभूद्विजानतः। तत्र को मोहः कः शोकऽएकत्वमनुपश्यतः ॥७ ॥
translation: When, in the man who clearly knows, Self hath become all things that are, What wilderment, what grief is there in him who sees the One alone?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पर्यगाच्छुक्रमकायमव्रणमस्नाविरꣳ शुद्धमपापविद्धम्। कविर्मनीषी परिभूः स्वयम्भूर्याथातथ्यतोऽर्थान् व्यदधाच्छाश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः ॥८ ॥
translation: He hath attained unto the Bright, Bodiless, Woundless, Sinewless, the Pure which evil hath not pierced. Far-sighted, wise, encompassing, he self-existent hath prescribed aims, as propriety demands, unto the everlasting Years.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्धन्तमः प्र विशन्ति येऽसम्भूतिमुपासते। ततो भूयऽइव ते तमो यऽउ सम्भूत्या रताः ॥९ ॥
translation: Deep into shade of blinding gloom fall Asambhûti’s worshippers. They sink to darkness deeper yet who on Sambhûti are intent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्यदेवाहुः सम्भवादन्यदाहुरसम्भवात्। इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे ॥१० ॥
translation: One fruit, they say, from Sambhava, another from Asambhava. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सम्भूतिं च विनाशं च यस्तद्वेदोभयꣳ सह। विनाशेन मृत्युं तीर्त्वा सम्भूत्यामृतमश्नुते ॥११ ॥
translation: The man who knows Sambhûti and Vinâsa simultaneously, He, by Vinâsa passing death, gains by Sambhûti endless life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्धन्तमः प्र विशन्ति येऽविद्यामुपासते। ततो भूयऽइव ते तमो यऽउ विद्याया रताः ॥१२ ॥
translation: To blinding darkness go the men who make a cult of Nescience. The devotees of Science enter darkness that is darker still.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्यदेवाहुर्विद्यायाऽअन्यदाहुरविद्यायाः। इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे ॥१३ ॥
translation: Different is the fruit, they say, of Science and of Nescience. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्यां चाविद्यां च यस्तद्वेदोभयꣳ सह। अविद्यया मृत्युं तीर्त्वा विद्ययामृतमश्नुते ॥१४ ॥
translation: The man who knoweth well these two, Science and Nescience, combined, O’ercoming death by Nescience by Science gaineth endless life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायुरनिलममृतमथेदं भस्मान्तꣳ शरीरम्। ओ३म् क्रतो स्मर। क्लिबे स्मर। कृतꣳ स्मर ॥१५ ॥
translation: My breath reach everlasting Air! In ashes let my body end. OM! Mind, remember thou; remember thou my sphere; remember thou my deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने नय सुपथा रायेऽअस्मान् विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान्। युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भूयिष्ठां ते नमऽउक्तिं विधेम ॥१६ ॥
translation: By goodly path lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest all our works and wisdom. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्मयेन पात्रेण सत्यस्यापिहितं मुखम्। योऽसावादित्ये पुरुषः सोऽसावहम्। ओ३म् खं ब्रह्म ॥१७ ॥
translation: The Real’s face is hidden by a vessel formed of golden light. The Spirit yonder in the Sun, the Spirit dwelling there am I. OM! Heaven! Brahma!
